title: Pentateuhul Samaritean — Numeri
description: Numeri din Pentateuhul Samaritean, păstrând textul samaritean, versetele și traducerea engleză disponibilă în sursa de bază, cu traducere română adaptată.

samaritan_hebrew.dataset: DT-UCPH/sp - Text-Fabric Dataset of the Samaritan Pentateuch
samaritan_hebrew.project: Samaritanus project, Martin-Luther-Universitat Halle-Wittenberg (dir. Stefan Schorch)
manuscripts: MS Dublin Chester Beatty Library 751 (Genesis 1 - Deuteronomy 32:36)
samaritan_hebrew.critical_edition: Stefan Schorch (ed.), The Samaritan Pentateuch: A Critical editio maior, Berlin: de Gruyter, 2018-
samaritan_hebrew.processing: Verse text rendered via the Text-Fabric text API (T.text); NFKC normalisation; combining marks (vowel/consonant-disambiguation points) stripped; whitespace collapsed to produce clean consonantal Hebrew in standard square script.

english_translation.alignment_method: For each verse, the Alamo Polyglot Samaritan Hebrew column was compared (after the same normalisation) to the Chester Beatty 751/Garizim 1 Hebrew at the same (book, chapter, verse). English was attached only when the two Hebrew texts matched closely (identical or minor orthographic variants). Where the Samaritan verse divisions diverge from the English source's verse scheme (observed in parts of Genesis 32, Exodus 7-8 and 20, Leviticus 5-6, Numbers 16-17 and 21), the source English describes a different, shifted verse, so it was withheld rather than misattached.

verse_scheme: Samaritan Pentateuch verse divisions, as transcribed in DT-UCPH/sp from the source manuscripts

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה במדבר סיני באהל מועד באחד לחדש השני בשנה השנית לצאתם מארץ מצרים לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first [day] of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise in the pustie of Sinai, in the Cortul of the obște, on the întâi [zi] of the al doilea lună, in the al doilea an după they erau a veni out of the țară of Egypt, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שאו את ראש עדת בני ישראל למשפחותם לבית אבותם במספר שמות כל זכר לגלגלותם
verses.english: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of [their] names, every male by their polls;
verses.romanian: a lua voi the sum of toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, după lor families, by the house of lor părinți, cu the numărătoare of [lor] names, fiecare male by lor polls;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כל יצא צבא בישראל תפקד אתם לצבאתם אתה ואהרן
verses.english: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.romanian: din douăzeci ani old și upward, toți că sunt able to a merge forth to război in Israel: tu și Aaron va numărătoare them by lor armies.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתכם יהיו איש איש למטה איש ראש לבית אבתיו הוא
verses.english: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.romanian: și cu you acolo va fi a om of fiecare seminție; fiecare unu cap of the house of lui părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה שמות האנשים אשר יעמדו אתכם לראובן אליצור בן שדיאור
verses.english: And these [are] the names of the men that shall stand with you: of [the tribe of] Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the names of the oameni că va a sta cu you: of [the seminție of] Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לשמעון שלמיאל בן צורישדה
verses.english: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.romanian: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ליהודה נחשון בן עמינדב
verses.english: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.romanian: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ליששכר נתנאל בן צוער
verses.english: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.romanian: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לזבולן אליאב בן חילן
verses.english: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.romanian: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבני יוסף לאפרים אלישמע בן עמיהוד למנשה גמלאל בן פדהצור
verses.english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.romanian: Of the copiii lui Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבנימים אבידן בן גדעוני
verses.english: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.romanian: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לדן אחיעזר בן עמישדי
verses.english: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.romanian: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לאשר פגעאל בן עכרן
verses.english: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.romanian: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לגד אליסף בן דעואל
verses.english: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.romanian: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לנפתלי אחירע בן עינן
verses.english: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.romanian: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה קריאי העדה נשיאי מטות אבותם ראשי אלפי ישראל הם
verses.english: These [were] the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.romanian: These [erau] the renowned of the obște, căpetenii of the seminții of lor părinți, capete of mii in Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה ואהרן את האנשים האלה אשר נקבו בשמות
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by [their] names:
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron a luat these oameni care sunt expressed by [lor] names:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל העדה הקהלו באחד לחדש השני ויתילדו על משפחותם לבית אבותם במספר שמות מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה לגלגלותם
verses.english: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first [day] of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.romanian: și they assembled toți the obște together on the întâi [zi] of the al doilea lună, și they declared lor pedigrees după lor families, by the house of lor părinți, după the numărătoare of the names, din douăzeci ani old și upward, by lor polls.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר צוה יהוה את משה ויפקדם במדבר סיני
verses.english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.romanian: As DOMNUL commanded Moise, astfel he numărat them in the pustie of Sinai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו בני ראובן בכור ישראל תולדתם למשפחותם לבית אבותם במספר שמות כל זכר לגלגלתם מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כל יצא צבא
verses.english: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by lor generations, după lor families, by the house of lor părinți, după the numărătoare of the names, by lor polls, fiecare male din douăzeci ani old și upward, toți că erau able to a merge forth to război;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פקדיהם למטה ראובן ששה וארבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Reuben, [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, [even] of the seminție of Reuben, [erau] patruzeci și șase mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבני שמעון תולדתם למשפחותם לבית אבותם פקדיהם במספר שמות לגלגלתם כל זכר מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כל יצא צבא
verses.english: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;

verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, [even] of the seminție of Benjamin, [erau] treizeci și cinci mie și patru sută.

verses.english: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.romanian: Of the copiii lui Dan, by lor generations, după lor families, by the house of lor părinți, după the numărătoare of the names, din douăzeci ani old și upward, toți că erau able to a merge forth to război;

verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, [even] of the seminție of Dan, [erau] threescore și doi mie și șapte sută.

verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, [even] of the seminție of Asher, [erau] patruzeci și unu mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבני נפתלי תולדתם למשפחותם לבית אבותם במספר שמות מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כל יצא צבא
verses.english: To the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.romanian: To the copiii lui Naphtali, throughout lor generations, după lor families, by the house of lor părinți, după the numărătoare of the names, din douăzeci ani old și upward, toți că erau able to a merge forth to război;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פקדיהם למטה נפתלי שלשה וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: Those that were numbered of them, [even] of the tribe of Naphtali, [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, [even] of the seminție of Naphtali, [erau] cincizeci și trei mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה הפקדים אשר פקד משה ואהרן ונשיאי ישראל שנים עשר איש איש אחד למטה אחד למטה בית אבותם היו
verses.english: These [are] those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, [being] twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] those că erau numărat, care Moise și Aaron numărat, și the căpetenii of Israel, [fiind] doisprezece oameni: fiecare unu era căci the house of lui părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו כל פקדי בני ישראל לצבאתם מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כל יצא צבא בישראל
verses.english: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their hosts, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.romanian: astfel erau toți those că erau numărat of the copiii lui Israel, by the house of lor oștiri, din douăzeci ani old și upward, toți că erau able to a merge forth to război in Israel;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו כל הפקדים שש מאות אלף ושלשת אלפים וחמש מאות וחמשים
verses.english: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.romanian: Even toți they că erau numărat erau șase sută mie și trei mie și cinci sută și cincizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלוים למטה אבותם לא התפקדו בתוכם
verses.english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.romanian: dar the leviți după the seminție of lor părinți erau nu numărat între them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: For the LORD had spoken unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL had spoken lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך את מטה הלוי לא תפקד ואת ראשם לא תשא בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.romanian: numai tu vei nu numărătoare the seminție of Levi, neither a lua the sum al lor între the copiii lui Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתה הפקד את הלוים על משכן העדות ועל כל כליו ועל כל אשר לו הם ישאו את המשכן ואת כל כליו והם ישרתהו וסביב למשכן יחנו
verses.english: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that [belong] to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: dar tu vei appoint the leviți peste the Cortul of mărturie, și peste toți the vessels al acestuia, și peste toți things că [belong] to it: they va bear the Cortul, și toți the vessels al acestuia; și they va minister lui it, și va a tăbărî de jur împrejur the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובנסע המשכן יורידו אתו הלוים ובהחנות המשכן יקימו אתו הלוים והזר הקרב יומת
verses.english: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: și când the Cortul setteth forward, the leviți va a lua it down: și când the Cortul este to fi pitched, the leviți va a așeza it up: și the străin că cometh nigh va fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחנו בני ישראל איש על מחנהו ואיש על ידו לצבאתם
verses.english: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own hand, throughout their hosts.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel va pitch lor tents, fiecare om by lui own tabără, și fiecare om by lui own mână, throughout lor oștiri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלוים יחנו סביב למשכן העדות ולא יהיה קצף על עדת בני ישראל ושמרו הלוים את משמרת משכן העדות
verses.english: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.romanian: dar the leviți va pitch de jur împrejur the Cortul of mărturie, că acolo fi no mânie upon the obște of the copiii lui Israel: și the leviți va a păzi the charge of the Cortul of mărturie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעשו בני ישראל ככל אשר צוה יהוה את משה כן עשו
verses.english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a făcut după toți că DOMNUL commanded Moise, astfel a făcut they.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש על דגליו באתות לבית אבותם יחנו בני ישראל מנגד סביב לאהל מועד יחנו
verses.english: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.romanian: fiecare om of the copiii lui Israel va pitch by lui own standard, cu the ensign of lor tată's house: far off about the Cortul of the obște va they pitch.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והחנים קדמה מזרחה דגל מחנה יהודה לצבאתם ונשיא לבני יהודה נחשון בן עמינדב
verses.english: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab [shall be] captain of the children of Judah.
verses.romanian: și on the east side toward the rising of the sun va they of the standard of the tabără of Judah pitch throughout lor armies: și Nahshon the son of Amminadab [va fi] captain of the copiii lui Judah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו ארבעה ושבעים אלף ושש מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] threescore și fourteen mie și șase sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והחנים עליו מטה יששכר ונשיא לבני יששכר נתנאל בן צוער
verses.english: And those that do pitch next unto him [shall be] the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar [shall be] captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.romanian: și those că a face pitch next lui him [va fi] the seminție of Issachar: și Nethaneel the son of Zuar [va fi] captain of the copiii lui Issachar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו ארבעה וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al acestuia, [erau] cincizeci și patru mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומטה זבולן ונשיא לבני זבולן אליאב בן חילן
verses.english: And [then] the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon [shall be] captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.romanian: și [atunci] the seminție of Zebulun: și Eliab the son of Helon [va fi] captain of the copiii lui Zebulun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו שבעה וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al acestuia, [erau] cincizeci și șapte mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הפקדים למחנה יהודה מאת אלף ושמנים אלף וששת אלפים וארבע מאות לצבאתם ראישונה יסעו
verses.english: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah [were] an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.romanian: toți că erau numărat in the tabără of Judah [erau] an sută mie și fourscore mie și șase mie și patru sută, throughout lor armies. These va întâi a așeza forth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דגל מחנה ראובן תימנה לצבאתם ונשיא לבני ראובן אליצור בן שדיאור
verses.english: On the south side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben [shall be] Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.romanian: On the south side [va fi] the standard of the tabără of Reuben după lor armies: și the captain of the copiii lui Reuben [va fi] Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו ששה וארבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, [were] forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al acestuia, [erau] patruzeci și șase mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והחנים עליו מטה שמעון ונשיא לבני שמעון שלמיאל בן צורישדי
verses.english: And those which pitch by him [shall be] the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon [shall be] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.romanian: și those care pitch de el [va fi] the seminție of Simeon: și the captain of the copiii lui Simeon [va fi] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו תשעה וחמשים אלף ושלש מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] cincizeci și nouă mie și trei sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומטה גד ונשיא לבני גד אליסף בן דעואל
verses.english: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.romanian: atunci the seminție of Gad: și the captain of the fiii lui Gad [va fi] Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו חמשה וארבעים אלף ושש מאות וחמשים
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] patruzeci și cinci mie și șase sută și cincizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הפקדים למחנה ראובן מאת אלף ואחד וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות וחמשים לצבאתם ושנים יסעו
verses.english: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.romanian: toți că erau numărat in the tabără of Reuben [erau] an sută mie și cincizeci și unu mie și patru sută și cincizeci, throughout lor armies. și they va a așeza forth in the al doilea rank.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסע אהל מועד מחנה הלוים בתוך המחנות כאשר יחנו כן יסעו איש על ידו לדגליהם
verses.english: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.romanian: atunci the Cortul of the obște va a așeza forward cu the tabără of the leviți in the mijloc of the tabără: as they a tăbărî, astfel va they a așeza forward, fiecare om in lui place după steagurile lor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דגל מחנה אפרים לצבאתם ימה ונשיא לבני אפרים אלישמע בן עמיהוד
verses.english: On the west side [shall be] the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim [shall be] Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.romanian: On the west side [va fi] the standard of the tabără of Ephraim după lor armies: și the captain of the fiii lui Ephraim [va fi] Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו ארבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] patruzeci mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועליו מטה מנשה ונשיא לבני מנשה גמליאל בן פדהצור
verses.english: And by him [shall be] the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh [shall be] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.romanian: și de el [va fi] the seminție of Manasseh: și the captain of the copiii lui Manasseh [va fi] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו שנים ושלשים אלף ומאתים
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] treizeci și doi mie și doi sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומטה בנימים ונשיא לבני בנימים אבידן בן גדעוני
verses.english: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin [shall be] Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.romanian: atunci the seminție of Benjamin: și the captain of the fiii lui Benjamin [va fi] Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו חמשה ושלשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] treizeci și cinci mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הפקדים למחנה אפרים מאת אלף ושמנת אלפים ומאה לצבאתם ושלישים יסעו
verses.english: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim [were] an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.romanian: toți că erau numărat of the tabără of Ephraim [erau] an sută mie și opt mie și an sută, throughout lor armies. și they va a merge forward in the al treilea rank.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דגל מחנה דן צפונה לצבאתם ונשיא לבני דן אחיעזר בן עמישדי
verses.english: The standard of the camp of Dan [shall be] on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan [shall be] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.romanian: The standard of the tabără of Dan [va fi] on the north side by lor armies: și the captain of the copiii lui Dan [va fi] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו שנים וששים אלף ושבע מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] threescore și doi mie și șapte sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והחנים עליו מטה אשר ונשיא לבני אשר פגעאל בן עכרן
verses.english: And those that encamp by him [shall be] the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher [shall be] Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.romanian: și those că a tăbărî de el [va fi] the seminție of Asher: și the captain of the copiii lui Asher [va fi] Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו אחד וארבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] patruzeci și unu mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומטה נפתלי ונשיא לבני נפתלי אחירע בן עינן
verses.english: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali [shall be] Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.romanian: atunci the seminție of Naphtali: și the captain of the copiii lui Naphtali [va fi] Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצבאו ופקדיו שלשה וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: And his host, and those that were numbered of him, [were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: și lui oștire, și those că erau numărat al lui, [erau] cincizeci și trei mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הפקדים למחנה דן מאת אלף ושבעה וחמשים אלף ושש מאות לאחרנה יסעו לדגליהם
verses.english: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan [were] an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.romanian: toți they că erau numărat in the tabără of Dan [erau] an sută mie și cincizeci și șapte mie și șase sută. They va a merge hindmost cu lor standards.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי בני ישראל לבית אבותם כל פקדי המחנות לצבאתם שש מאות אלף ושלשת אלפים וחמש מאות וחמשים
verses.english: These [are] those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts [were] six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] those care erau numărat of the copiii lui Israel by the house of lor părinți: toți those că erau numărat of the tabere throughout lor oștiri [erau] șase sută mie și trei mie și cinci sută și cincizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלוים לא התפקדו בתוך בני ישראל כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: dar the leviți erau nu numărat între the copiii lui Israel; as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעשו בני ישראל ככל אשר צוה יהוה את משה כן חנו לדגליהם וכן נסעו איש למשפחותיו על בית אבותיו
verses.english: And the children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a făcut după toți că DOMNUL commanded Moise: astfel they pitched după steagurile lor, și astfel they a așeza forward, fiecare unu după lor families, după the house of lor părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה תולדת אהרן ומשה ביום דבר יהוה את משה בהר סיני
verses.english: These also [are] the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day [that] the LORD spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.romanian: These de asemenea [sunt] the generations of Aaron și Moise in the zi [că] DOMNUL a vorbit cu Moise in mount Sinai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה שמות בני אהרן הבכור נדב ואביהוא אלעזר ואיתמר
verses.english: And these [are] the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the names of the fiii lui Aaron; Nadab the întâi-născut, și Abihu, Elazar, și Ithamar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה שמות בני אהרן הכהנים המשחים אשר מלא ידם לכהן
verses.english: These [are] the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the names of the fiii lui Aaron, the preoți care erau anointed, pe care he consecrated to minister in the preot's office.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימת נדב ואביהוא בהקריבם אש זרה לפני יהוה במדבר סיני ובנים לא היו להם ויכהן אלעזר ואיתמר על פני אהרן אביהם
verses.english: And Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD, when they offered strange fire before the LORD, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.romanian: și Nadab și Abihu a murit înainte DOMNUL, când they a adus ca jertfă strange foc înainte DOMNUL, in the pustie of Sinai, și they had no copii: și Elazar și Ithamar ministered in the preot's office in the sight of Aaron lor tată.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הקרב את מטה לוי והעמדת אתו לפני אהרן הכהן ושרתו אתו
verses.english: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.romanian: a aduce the seminție of Levi lângă, și present them înainte Aaron the preot, că they poate minister lui him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרו את משמרתו ואת משמרת כל העדה לפני אהל מועד לעבד את עבדת המשכן
verses.english: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și they va a păzi lui charge, și the charge of the întreg obște înainte the Cortul of the obște, to a face the service of the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרו את כל כלי אהל מועד ואת משמרת בני ישראל לעבד את עבדת המשכן
verses.english: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și they va a păzi toți the instruments of the Cortul of the obște, și the charge of the copiii lui Israel, to a face the service of the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה את הלוים לאהרן ולבניו נתנים נתנים הם לי מתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they [are] wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a da the leviți lui Aaron și to lui sons: they [sunt] wholly given lui him out of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת אהרן ואת בניו תפקד ושמרו את כהנתם והזר הקרב יומת
verses.english: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: și tu vei appoint Aaron și lui sons, și they va wait on lor preot's office: și the străin că cometh nigh va fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואני הנה לקחתי את הלוים מתוך בני ישראל תחת כל בכור פטר רחם בבני ישראל פדויהם יהיו והיו לי הלוים
verses.english: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel they will be ransomed and become instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.romanian: și I, iată, I au taken the leviți din între the copiii lui Israel they va fi ransomed și become instead of toți the întâi-născut că openeth the matrix între the copiii lui Israel: de aceea the leviți va fi al meu;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לי כל בכור ביום הכיתי כל בכור בארץ מצרים הקדשתי לי כל בכור בישראל מאדם עד בהמה לי יהיו אני יהוה
verses.english: Because all the firstborn [are] mine; [for] on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: pentru că toți the întâi-născut [sunt] al meu; [căci] on the zi că I a lovit toți the întâi-născut in the țară of Egypt I hallowed lui me toți the întâi-născut in Israel, both om și beast: al meu va they fi: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה במדבר סיני לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise in the pustie of Sinai, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פקד את בני לוי לבית אבותם למשפחותם כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה תפקדם
verses.english: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.romanian: numărătoare the copiii lui Levi după the house of lor părinți, după familiile lor: fiecare male din a lună old și upward shalt tu numărătoare them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפקד אתם משה על פי יהוה כאשר צוהו
verses.english: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he was commanded.
verses.romanian: și Moise numărat them după the cuvânt of DOMNUL, as he era commanded.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו אלה בני לוי בשמותם גרשון קהת ומררי
verses.english: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.romanian: și these erau the fiii lui Levi by lor names; Gershon, Kohath, și Merari.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה שמות בני גרשון למשפחותם לבני ושמעי
verses.english: And these [are] the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the names of the fiii lui Gershon după familiile lor; Libni, și Shimei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני קהת למשפחותם עמרם ויצהר חברון ועזיאל
verses.english: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Kohath după familiile lor; Amram, și Izehar, Hebron, și Uzziel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני מררי למשפחותם מחלי ומושי אלה הם משפחות הלוי לבית אבותם
verses.english: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These [are] the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Merari după familiile lor; Mahli, și Mushi. These [sunt] the families of the leviți după the house of lor părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לגרשון משפחת הלבני ומשפחת השמעי אלה הם משפחות הגרשוני
verses.english: Of Gershon [was] the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these [are] the families of the Gershonites.
verses.romanian: Of Gershon [era] the family of the Libnites, și the family of the Shimites: these [sunt] the families of the gherșoniți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדיהם במספר כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה פקדיהם שבעת אלפים וחמש מאות
verses.english: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [even] those that were numbered of them [were] seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: Those că erau numărat al lor, după the numărătoare of toți the males, din a lună old și upward, [even] those că erau numărat al lor [erau] șapte mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: משפחת הגרשוני אחרי המשכן יחנו ימה
verses.english: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.romanian: The families of the gherșoniți va pitch behind the Cortul westward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשיא בית אב לגרשוני אליסף בן לאל
verses.english: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites [shall be] Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the house of the tată of the gherșoniți [va fi] Eliasaph the son of Lael.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומשמרת בני גרשון באהל מועד המשכן והאהל ומכסהו ומסך פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation [shall be] the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
verses.romanian: și the charge of the fiii lui Gershon in the Cortul of the obște [va fi] the Cortul, și the cort, the învelitoare al acestuia, și the hanging căci the door of the Cortul of the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקלעי החצר ואת מסך פתח החצר אשר על המשכן ועל המזבח סביב ואת מיתריו לכל עבדתו
verses.english: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.romanian: și the hangings of the court, și the perdea căci the door of the court, care [este] by the Cortul, și by the altar de jur împrejur, și the cords of it căci toți the service al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקהת משפחת העמרמי ומשפחת היצהרי ומשפחת החברוני ומשפחת העזאלי אלה הם משפחות הקהתי
verses.english: And of Kohath [was] the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these [are] the families of the Kohathites.
verses.romanian: și of Kohath [era] the family of the Amramites, și the family of the Izeharites, și the family of the Hebronites, și the family of the Uzzielites: these [sunt] the families of the chehatiți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: במספר כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה שמנת אלפים ושש מאות שמרי משמרת הקדש
verses.english: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [were] eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: In the numărătoare of toți the males, din a lună old și upward, [erau] opt mie și șase sută, keeping the charge of the loc sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: משפחת בני קהת יחנו על ירך המשכן תימנה
verses.english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.romanian: The families of the fiii lui Kohath va pitch on the side of the Cortul southward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשיא בית אב למשפחות הקהתי אליצפן בן עזיאל
verses.english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites [shall be] Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the house of the tată of the families of the chehatiți [va fi] Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומשמרתם הארון והשלחן והמנורה והמזבחות וכלי הקדש אשר ישרתו בהם והמסך והכיור וכנו וכל עבדתם
verses.english: And their charge [shall be] the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.romanian: și lor charge [va fi] the chivot, și the table, și the candlestick, și the altars, și the vessels of the loc sfânt wherewith they minister, și the hanging, și toți the service al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשיא נשיאי הלוים אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן פקדת שמרי משמרת הקדש
verses.english: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest [shall be] chief over the chief of the Levites, [and have] the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: și Elazar the son of Aaron the preot [va fi] căpetenie peste the căpetenie of the leviți, [și au] the oversight al lor că a păzi the charge of the loc sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למררי משפחת המחלי ומשפחת המושי אלה הם משפחות מררי
verses.english: Of Merari [was] the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these [are] the families of Merari.
verses.romanian: Of Merari [era] the family of the Mahlites, și the family of the Mushites: these [sunt] the families of Merari.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדיהם במספר כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה ששת אלפים ומאתים
verses.english: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, [were] six thousand and two hundred.
verses.romanian: și those că erau numărat al lor, după the numărătoare of toți the males, din a lună old și upward, [erau] șase mie și doi sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשיא בית אב למשפחות מררי צוראל בן אבחהל על ירך המשכן יחנו צפונה
verses.english: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari [was] Zuriel the son of Abihail: [these] shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the house of the tată of the families of Merari [era] Zuriel the son of Abihail: [these] va pitch on the side of the Cortul northward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדת משמרת בני מררי קרשי המשכן ובריחיו ועמודיו ואדניו וכל כליו וכל עבדתו
verses.english: And [under] the custody and charge of the sons of Merari [shall be] the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto
verses.romanian: și [sub] the custody și charge of the fiii lui Merari [va fi] the scânduri of the Cortul, și the drugii al acestuia, și the stâlpi al acestuia, și the suporți al acestuia, și toți the vessels al acestuia, și toți că serveth thereto

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועמודי החצר סביב ואדניהם ויתדתם ומיתריהם
verses.english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.romanian: și the stâlpi of the court de jur împrejur, și lor suporți, și lor pins, și lor cords.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והחנים את פני המשכן קדמה לפני אהל מועד מזרחה משה אהרן ובניו שמרי משמרת הקדש למשמרת בני ישראל והזר הקרב יומת
verses.english: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, [even] before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, [shall be] Moses, Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: dar those că a tăbărî înainte the Cortul toward the east, [even] înainte the Cortul of the obște eastward, [va fi] Moise, Aaron și lui sons, keeping the charge of the loc sfânt căci the charge of the copiii lui Israel; și the străin că cometh nigh va fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל פקדי הלוים אשר פקד משה על פי יהוה למשפחותם כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה שנים ועשרים אלף
verses.english: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the LORD, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, [were] twenty and two thousand.
verses.romanian: toți că erau numărat of the leviți, care Moise și Aaron numărat at the poruncă of DOMNUL, throughout lor families, toți the males din a lună old și upward, [erau] douăzeci și doi mie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה פקד כל בכור זכר לבני ישראל מבן חדש ומעלה ושא את מספר שמותם
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, numărătoare toți the întâi-născut of the males of the copiii lui Israel din a lună old și upward, și a lua the numărătoare of lor names.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחת את הלוים לי אני יהוה תחת כל בכור בבני ישראל ואת בהמת הלוים תחת כל בכור בבהמת בני ישראל
verses.english: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I [am] the LORD) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a lua the leviți căci me (I [am] DOMNUL) instead of toți the întâi-născut între the copiii lui Israel; și the cattle of the leviți instead of toți the firstlings între the cattle of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפקד משה כאשר צוה יהוה אתו את כל בכור בבני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses numbered, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise numărat, as DOMNUL commanded him, toți the întâi-născut între the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו כל בכור זכר במספר שמות מבן חדש ומעלה לפקדיהם שנים ועשרים אלף שלשה ושבעים ומאתים
verses.english: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.romanian: și toți the întâi-născut males by the numărătoare of names, din a lună old și upward, of those că erau numărat al lor, erau douăzeci și doi mie doi sută și threescore și thirteen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח את הלוים תחת כל בכור בבני ישראל ואת בהמת הלוים תחת בהמתם והיו לי הלוים אני יהוה
verses.english: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I [am] the LORD.
verses.romanian: a lua the leviți instead of toți the întâi-născut între the copiii lui Israel, și the cattle of the leviți instead of lor cattle; și the leviți va fi al meu: I [am] DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת פדוי השלשה והשבעים והמאתים העדפים על הלוים מבכורי בני ישראל
verses.english: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.romanian: și căci those că sunt to fi redeemed of the doi sută și threescore și thirteen of the întâi-născut of the copiii lui Israel, care sunt mai mult than the leviți;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחת חמשת חמשת שקלים לגלגלת בשקל הקדש תקח עשרים גרה השקל
verses.english: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take [them]: (the shekel [is] twenty gerahs:)
verses.romanian: tu vei even a lua cinci shekels apiece by the poll, după the shekel of the loc sfânt shalt tu a lua [them]: (the shekel [este] douăzeci gerahs:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה הכסף לאהרן ולבניו פדוי העדפים בהם
verses.english: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a da the money, wherewith the odd numărătoare al lor este to fi redeemed, lui Aaron și to lui sons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה את כסף הפדוים מאת העדפים על פדוי הלוים
verses.english: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat the redemption money al lor că erau peste și deasupra them că erau redeemed by the leviți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מאת בכורי בני ישראל לקח את הכסף חמשה וששים ושלש מאות ואלף בשקל הקדש
verses.english: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.romanian: Of the întâi-născut of the copiii lui Israel a luat he the money; a mie trei sută și threescore și cinci [shekels], după the shekel of the loc sfânt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן משה את כסף הפדוים לאהרן ולבניו על פי יהוה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise a dat the money al lor că erau redeemed lui Aaron și to lui sons, după the cuvânt of DOMNUL, as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נשא את ראש בני קהת מתוך בני לוי למשפחותם לבית אבותם
verses.english: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers
verses.romanian: a lua the sum of the fiii lui Kohath din între the fiii lui Levi, după lor families, by the house of lor părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה כל הבא לצבא לעשות מלאכה באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even until cincizeci ani old, toți că enter into the oștire, to a face the muncă in the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עבדת בני קהת באהל מועד קדש הקדשים
verses.english: This [shall be] the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, [about] the most holy things:
verses.romanian: This [va fi] the service of the fiii lui Kohath in the Cortul of the obște, [about] the preasfânt things:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובא אהרן ובניו בנסע המחנה והורידו את פרכת המסך וכסו בה את ארון העדות
verses.english: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering veil, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.romanian: și când the tabără setteth forward, Aaron va a veni, și lui sons, și they va a lua down the învelitoare văl, și cover the chivot of mărturie cu it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנו עליו כסוי עור תחש ופרשו עליו בגד כליל תכלת מלמעלה ושמו בדיו
verses.english: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.romanian: și va a pune pe el the învelitoare of badgers' skins, și va spread peste it a cloth wholly of blue, și va a pune in the staves al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל שלחן הפנים יפרשו בגד תכלת ונתנו עליו את הקערות ואת הכפות ואת המנקיות ואת קשות הנסך ולחם התמיד עליו יהיה
verses.english: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.romanian: și upon the table of shewbread they va spread a cloth of blue, și a pune pe el the dishes, și the spoons, și the bowls, și covers to cover withal: și the continual bread va fi pe el:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופרשו עליהם כסוי בגד תולעת שני וכסו אתו במכסה עור תחש ושמו בדיו
verses.english: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.romanian: și they va spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, și cover the same cu a învelitoare of badgers' skins, și va a pune in the staves al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו בגד תכלת וכסו את מנורת המאור ואת נרתיה ואת מלקחיה ואת מחתיתיה ואת כל כלי שמנה אשר ישרתו לה בהם
verses.english: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.romanian: și they va a lua a cloth of blue, și cover the candlestick of the light, și lui lamps, și lui tongs, și lui snuffdishes, și toți the a fierbe vessels al acestuia, wherewith they minister lui it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנו אתה ואת כל כליה אל מכסה עור תחש ונתנו על המוט
verses.english: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put [it] upon a bar.
verses.romanian: și they va a pune it și toți the vessels al acestuia în a învelitoare of badgers' skins, și va a pune [it] upon a bar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל מזבח הזהב יפרשו בגד תכלת וכסו אתו במכסה עור תחש ושמו את בדיו
verses.english: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.romanian: și upon the golden altar they va spread a cloth of blue, și cover it cu a învelitoare of badgers' skins, și va a pune to the staves al acestuia:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו את כל כלי השרת אשר ישרתו בהם בקדש ונתנו אל בגד תכלת וכסו אתם במכסה עור תחש ונתנו על המוט
verses.english: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put [them] in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put [them] on a bar:
verses.romanian: și they va a lua toți the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the loc sfânt, și a pune [them] in a cloth of blue, și cover them cu a învelitoare of badgers' skins, și va a pune [them] on a bar:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ודשנו את המזבח ופרשו עליו בגד ארגמן
verses.english: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.romanian: și they va a lua away the ashes din the altar, și spread a purple cloth pe el:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתנו עליו את כל כליו אשר ישרתו עליו בהם את המחתות ואת המזלגות ואת היעים ואת המזרקות כל כלי המזבח ופרשו עליו כסוי עור תחש ושמו בדיו ולקחו בגד ארגמן וכסו את הכיור ואת כנו ונתנו אתם אל מכסה עור תחש ונתנו על המוט
verses.english: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, [even] the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basins, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it. And they will take a purple covering and cover the laver and his foot, and they cover it in Tachash skins, and they put it upon a bar.
verses.romanian: și they va a pune upon it toți the vessels al acestuia, wherewith they minister about it, [even] the censers, the fleshhooks, și the shovels, și the basins, toți the vessels of the altar; și they va spread upon it a învelitoare of badgers' skins, și a pune to the staves of it. și they va a lua a purple învelitoare și cover the laver și lui foot, și they cover it in Tachash skins, și they a pune it upon a bar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכלה אהרן ובניו לכסות את הקדש ואת כל כלי הקדש בנסע המחנה ואחרי כן יבאו בני קהת לשאת ולא יגעו אל הקדש ומתו אלה משאי בני קהת באהל מועד
verses.english: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear [it]: but they shall not touch [any] holy thing, lest they die. These [things are] the burdens of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și când Aaron și lui sons au a făcut an end of învelitoare the loc sfânt, și toți the vessels of the loc sfânt, as the tabără este to a așeza forward; după că, the fiii lui Kohath va a veni to bear [it]: dar they va nu touch [vreun] sfânt thing, lest they a muri. These [things sunt] the burdens of the fiii lui Kohath in the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדת אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן שמן המאור וקטרת הסמים ומנחת התמיד ושמן המשחה פקדת כל המשכן וכל אשר בו בקדש ובכליו
verses.english: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest [pertaineth] the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, [and] the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein [is], in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.romanian: și to the office of Elazar the son of Aaron the preot [pertaineth] the a fierbe căci the light, și the sweet tămâie, și the daily meat prinos, și the anointing a fierbe, [și] the oversight of toți the Cortul, și of toți că în el [este], in the loc sfânt, și in the vessels al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תכריתו את שבט משפחת הקהתי מתוך הלוים
verses.english: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.romanian: Cut voi nu off the seminție of the families of the chehatiți din între the leviți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עשו להם וחיו ולא ימותו בגשתם אל קדש הקדשים אהרן ובניו יבאו ושמו אתם איש על עבדתו ועל משאו
verses.english: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.romanian: dar astfel a face lui them, că they poate a trăi, și nu a muri, când they approach lui the preasfânt things: Aaron și lui sons va a merge in, și appoint them fiecare unu to lui service și to lui burden:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יבאו לראות כבלע את הקדש ומתו
verses.english: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.romanian: dar they va nu a merge in to a vedea când the sfânt things sunt covered, lest they a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נשא את ראש בני גרשון גם הם לבית אבותם למשפחותם
verses.english: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.romanian: a lua de asemenea the sum of the fiii lui Gershon, throughout the houses of lor părinți, după familiile lor;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה תפקד אתם כל הבא לצבא צבא לעבד עבדה באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward and until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward și until cincizeci ani old shalt tu numărătoare them; toți că enter in to perform the service, to a face the muncă in the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עבדת משפחת הגרשוני לעבד ולמשא
verses.english: This [is] the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.romanian: This [este] the service of the families of the gherșoniți, to a sluji, și căci burdens:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשאו את יריעות המשכן ואת אהל מועד מכסהו ומכסה התחש אשר עליו מלמעלה ואת מסך פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that [is] above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation
verses.romanian: și they va bear the curtains of the Cortul, și the Cortul of the obște, lui învelitoare, și the învelitoare of the badgers' skins că [este] deasupra upon it, și the hanging căci the door of the Cortul of the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת קלעי החצר ואת מסך פתח שער החצר אשר על המשכן ועל המזבח סביב ואת מיתריהם ואת כל כלי עבדתם ואת כל אשר יעשה להם ועבדו
verses.english: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which [is] by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.romanian: și the hangings of the court, și the hanging căci the door of the gate of the court, care [este] by the Cortul și by the altar de jur împrejur, și lor cords, și toți the instruments of lor service, și toți că este a făcut căci them: astfel va they a sluji.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי אהרן ובניו תהיה כל עבדת בני הגרשוני לכל משאם ולכל עבדתם ופקדתם עליהם במשמרת את כל משאם
verses.english: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.romanian: At the appointment of Aaron și lui sons va fi toți the service of the fiii lui the gherșoniți, in toți lor burdens, și in toți lor service: și voi va appoint lui them in charge toți lor burdens.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עבדת משפחת בני הגרשוני באהל מועד ומשמרתם ביד איתמר בן אהרן הכהן
verses.english: This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge [shall be] under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.romanian: This [este] the service of the families of the fiii lui Gershon in the Cortul of the obște: și lor charge [va fi] sub the mână of Ithamar the son of Aaron the preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני מררי למשפחותם לבית אבותם תפקד אתם
verses.english: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.romanian: As căci the fiii lui Merari, tu vei numărătoare them după lor families, by the house of lor părinți;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה תפקדם כל הבא לצבא לעבד את עבדת אהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even lui cincizeci ani old shalt tu numărătoare them, fiecare unu că entereth into the service, to a face the muncă of the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת משמרת משאם לכל עבדתם באהל מועד קרשי המשכן ובריחיו ועמודיו ואדניו
verses.english: And this [is] the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof
verses.romanian: și this [este] the charge of lor burden, după toți lor service in the Cortul of the obște; the scânduri of the Cortul, și the drugii al acestuia, și the stâlpi al acestuia, și suporți al acestuia

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועמודי החצר סביב ואדניהם ויתדתם ומיתריהם לכל כליהם ולכל עבדתם ובשמות תפקדו את כל כלי משמרת משאם
verses.english: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of all the charge of their burden.
verses.romanian: și the stâlpi of the court de jur împrejur, și lor suporți, și lor pins, și lor cords, cu toți lor instruments, și cu toți lor service: și by name voi va reckon the instruments of toți the charge of lor burden.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עבדת משפחת בני מררי לכל עבדתם באהל מועד ביד איתמר בן אהרן הכהן
verses.english: This [is] the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.romanian: This [este] the service of the families of the fiii lui Merari, după toți lor service, in the Cortul of the obște, sub the mână of Ithamar the son of Aaron the preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפקד משה ואהרן ונשיאי העדה את בני הקהתי למשפחותם לבית אבותם
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, after the house of their fathers
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron și the căpetenie of the obște numărat the fiii lui the chehatiți după lor families, după the house of lor părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה כל הבא לצבא לעבדה באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even lui cincizeci ani old, fiecare unu că entereth into the service, căci the muncă in the Cortul of the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו פקדיהם למשפחותם אלפים ושבע מאות וחמשים
verses.english: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.romanian: și those că erau numărat al lor după familiile lor erau doi mie șapte sută și cincizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי משפחת הקהתי כל העבד באהל מועד אשר פקד משה ואהרן על פי יהוה ביד משה
verses.english: These [were] they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: These [erau] they că erau numărat of the families of the chehatiți, toți că ar putea a face service in the Cortul of the obște, care Moise și Aaron a făcut numărătoare după the poruncă of DOMNUL by the mână of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדי בני גרשון למשפחותם לבית אבותם
verses.english: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers
verses.romanian: și those că erau numărat of the fiii lui Gershon, throughout lor families, și by the house of lor părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה כל הבא לצבא לעבדה באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even lui cincizeci ani old, fiecare unu că entereth into the service, căci the muncă in the Cortul of the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו פקדיהם למשפחותם לבית אבותם אלפים ושש מאות ושלשים
verses.english: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.romanian: Even those că erau numărat al lor, throughout lor families, by the house of lor părinți, erau doi mie și șase sută și treizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי משפחת בני גרשון כל העבד באהל מועד אשר פקד משה ואהרן על פי יהוה
verses.english: These [are] they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the LORD.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] they că erau numărat of the families of the fiii lui Gershon, of toți că ar putea a face service in the Cortul of the obște, pe care Moise și Aaron a făcut numărătoare după the poruncă of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופקדי משפחת בני מררי למשפחותם לבית אבותם
verses.english: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers
verses.romanian: și those că erau numărat of the families of the fiii lui Merari, throughout lor families, by the house of lor părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה כל הבא לצבא לעבדה באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even lui cincizeci ani old, fiecare unu că entereth into the service, căci the muncă in the Cortul of the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו פקדיהם למשפחותם שלשת אלפים ומאתים
verses.english: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.romanian: Even those că erau numărat al lor după lor families, erau trei mie și doi sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי משפחת בני מררי אשר פקד משה ואהרן על פי יהוה ביד משה
verses.english: These [be] those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: These [fi] those că erau numărat of the families of the fiii lui Merari, pe care Moise și Aaron numărat după the cuvânt of DOMNUL by the mână of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הפקדים אשר פקד משה ואהרן ונשיאי ישראל את הלוים למשפחותם לבית אבותם
verses.english: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, after the house of their fathers
verses.romanian: toți those că erau numărat of the leviți, pe care Moise și Aaron și the căpetenie of Israel numărat, după lor families, după the house of lor părinți

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן שלשים שנה ומעלה ועד בן חמשים שנה כל הבא לעבד עבדת עבדה ועבדת משא באהל מועד
verses.english: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation
verses.romanian: din treizeci ani old și upward even lui cincizeci ani old, fiecare unu că a venit to a face the service of the ministry, și the service of the burden in the Cortul of the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו פקדיהם שמנת אלפים וחמש מאות ושמנים
verses.english: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore.
verses.romanian: Even those că erau numărat al lor, erau opt mie și cinci sută și fourscore.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי יהוה פקד אתם ביד משה איש איש על עבדתו ועל משאו ופקדיו כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as that which the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: după the poruncă of DOMNUL they erau numărat by the mână of Moise, fiecare unu după lui service, și după lui burden: astfel erau they numărat al lui, as că care DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את בני ישראל וישלחו מן המחנה כל צרוע וכל זב וכל טמא לנפש
verses.english: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.romanian: Command the copiii lui Israel, că they a pune out of the tabără fiecare leper, și fiecare unu că sunt an issue, și whosoever este pângărit by the dead:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מזכר ועד נקבה תשלחו אל מחוץ למחנה תשלחום ולא יטמאו את מחניהם אשר אני שכן בתוכם
verses.english: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.romanian: Both male și female va voi a pune out, fără the tabără va voi a pune them; că they a pângări nu lor tabere, in the mijloc whereof I dwell.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעשו כן בני ישראל וישלחו אתם אל מחוץ למחנה כאשר דבר יהוה אל משה כן עשו בני ישראל
verses.english: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the LORD spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a făcut astfel, și a pune them out fără the tabără: as DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, astfel a făcut the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר איש או אשה כי יעשו מכל חטאת האדם למעל מעל ביהוה ואשמה הנפש ההיא
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel to say, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the LORD, and that person be guilty;
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel to a spune, când a om sau femeie va commit vreun păcat că oameni commit, to a face a trespass împotriva DOMNUL, și că person fi guilty;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתודו את חטאתם אשר עשו והשיב את אשמו בראשו וחמישתו יסף עליו ונתן לאשר אשם לו
verses.english: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth [part] thereof, and give [it] unto [him] against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.romanian: atunci they va confess lor păcat care they au done: și he va recompense lui trespass cu the principal al acestuia, și add lui it the al cincilea [part] al acestuia, și a da [it] lui [him] împotriva pe care he sunt trespassed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אין לאיש גאל להשיב האשם אליו האשם המושב ליהוה לכהן מלבד איל הכפורים אשר יכפר בו עליו
verses.english: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the LORD, [even] to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.romanian: dar dacă the om au no kinsman to recompense the trespass lui, let the trespass fi recompensed lui DOMNUL, [even] to the preot; beside the berbec of the atonement, whereby an atonement va fi a făcut căci him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל תרומה לכל קדשי בני ישראל אשר יקריבו לכהן לו יהיה
verses.english: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.romanian: și fiecare prinos of toți the sfânt things of the copiii lui Israel, care they a aduce lui the preot, va fi lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואיש את קדשיו לו יהיה ואיש אשר יתן לכהן לו יהיה
verses.english: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.romanian: și fiecare om's hallowed things va fi lui: whatsoever vreun om giveth the preot, it va fi lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם איש איש כי תשטה אשתו ומעלה בו מעל
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, dacă vreun om's wife a merge aside, și commit a trespass împotriva him

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושכב איש אתה שכבת זרע ונעלם מעיני אישה ונסתרה והיא נטמאה ועד אין בה והיא לא נתפשה
verses.english: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and [there be] no witness against her, neither she be taken [with the manner];
verses.romanian: și a om lie cu ei carnally, și it fi hid din the eyes al ei husband, și fi a păzit close, și she fi pângărit, și [acolo fi] no witness împotriva ei, neither she fi taken [cu the manner];

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבר עליו רוח קנאה וקנא את אשתו והיא נטמאה או עבר עליו רוח קנאה וקנא את אשתו והיא לא נטמאה
verses.english: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.romanian: și the duh of jealousy a veni upon him, și he fi jealous of lui wife, și she fi pângărit: sau dacă the duh of jealousy a veni upon him, și he fi jealous of lui wife, și she fi nu pângărit:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והביא האיש את אשתו אל הכהן והביא את קרבנה עליה עשירת האיפה קמח שערים לא יצק עליה שמן ולא יתן עליה לבונה כי מנחת קנאת היא מנחת זכרון מזכרת עון
verses.english: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth [part] of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it [is] an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.romanian: atunci va the om a aduce lui wife lui the preot, și he va a aduce ei prinos căci ei, the al zecelea [part] of an ephah of barley meal; he va pour no a fierbe upon it, nor a pune tămâie pe el; căci it [este] an prinos of jealousy, an prinos of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב אתה הכהן והעמידה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a aduce ei lângă, și a așeza ei înainte DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מים קדישים בכלי חרש ומן העפר אשר יהיה בקרקע המשכן יקח הכהן ונתן אל המים
verses.english: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put [it] into the water:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a lua sfânt apă in an earthen vessel; și of the dust că este in the floor of the Cortul the preot va a lua, și a pune [it] into the apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעמיד הכהן את האשה לפני יהוה ופרע את ראש האשה ונתן על כפיה את מנחת הזכרון מנחת קנאת היא וביד הכהן יהיו מי המרים המאררים
verses.english: And the priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which [is] the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a așeza the femeie înainte DOMNUL, și uncover the femeie's cap, și a pune the prinos of memorial in ei mâini, care [este] the jealousy prinos: și the preot va au in lui mână the bitter apă că causeth the a blestema:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשביע אתה הכהן ואמר אל האשה אם לא שכב איש אתיך ואם לא שטית טמאה תחת אישיך הנקי ממי המרים המאררים האלה
verses.english: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness [with another] instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.romanian: și the preot va charge ei by an oath, și a spune lui the femeie, dacă no om au lain cu te, și dacă tu ai nu gone aside to uncleanness [cu another] instead of tău husband, fi tu free din this bitter apă că causeth the a blestema:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כי שטית תחת אישיך וכי נטמאת ויתן איש ביך את שכבתו מבלעדי אישיך
verses.english: But if thou hast gone aside [to another] instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.romanian: dar dacă tu ai gone aside [to another] instead of tău husband, și dacă tu fi pângărit, și some om au lain cu te beside al tău husband:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשביע הכהן את האשה בשבועת האלה ואמר הכהן לאשה יתן יהוה אתיך לאלה ולשבועה בתוך עמיך בתת יהוה את ירכיך נפלת ואת בטניך צבא
verses.english: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The LORD make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the LORD doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.romanian: atunci the preot va charge the femeie cu an oath of cursing, și the preot va a spune lui the femeie, DOMNUL a face te a a blestema și an oath între tău popor, când DOMNUL doth a face tău thigh to rot, și tău belly to swell;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאו המים המאררים האלה במעיך לצבת בטן ולנפל ירך ואמרה האשה אמן אמן
verses.english: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make [thy] belly to swell, and [thy] thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.romanian: și this apă că causeth the a blestema va a merge into tău bowels, to a face [tău] belly to swell, și [tău] thigh to rot: și the femeie va a spune, Amen, amen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכתב את האלות האלה הכהן בספר ומחה אל מי המרים
verses.english: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot [them] out with the bitter water:
verses.romanian: și the preot va write these curses in a book, și he va blot [them] out cu the bitter apă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשקה את האשה את מי המרים המאררים ובאו בה המים המאררים למרים
verses.english: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, [and become] bitter.
verses.romanian: și he va cause the femeie to drink the bitter apă că causeth the a blestema: și the apă că causeth the a blestema va enter into ei, [și become] bitter.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן מיד האשה את מנחת הקנאת והניף את המנחה לפני יהוה והקריב אתה אל המזבח
verses.english: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the LORD, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.romanian: atunci the preot va a lua the jealousy prinos out of the femeie's mână, și va wave the prinos înainte DOMNUL, și a aduce ca jertfă it upon the altar:
