verses.samaritan_hebrew: והרים הכהן מן המנחה את אזכרתה והקטיר המזבחה ואחר ישקה את האשה את המים
verses.english: And the priest shall raise an handful of the offering, [even] the memorial thereof, and burn [it] upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.romanian: și the preot va raise an handful of the prinos, [even] the memorial al acestuia, și a arde [it] upon the altar, și afterward va cause the femeie to drink the apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשקה את המים והיה אם נטמאה ותמעל מעל באישה ובאו בה המים המאררים למרים וצבתה בטנה ונפלה ירכה והיתה האשה לאלה בקרב עמה
verses.english: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, [that], if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, [and become] bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.romanian: și când he sunt a făcut ei to drink the apă, atunci it va a veni to a trece, [că], dacă she fi pângărit, și au done trespass împotriva ei husband, că the apă că causeth the a blestema va enter into ei, [și become] bitter, și ei belly va swell, și ei thigh va rot: și the femeie va fi a a blestema între ei popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא נטמאה האשה וטהרה היא ונקתה ונזרעה זרע
verses.english: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.romanian: și dacă the femeie fi nu pângărit, dar fi curat; atunci she va fi free, și va conceive seed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת הקנאת אשר תשטה אשה תחת אישה ונטמאה
verses.english: This [is] the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside [to another] instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege of jealousies, când a wife goeth aside [to another] instead al ei husband, și este pângărit;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או איש אשר תעבר עליו רוח קנאה וקנא את אשתו והעמיד את האשה לפני יהוה ועשה לה הכהן את כל התורה הזאת
verses.english: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.romanian: sau când the duh of jealousy cometh upon him, și he fi jealous peste lui wife, și va a așeza the femeie înainte DOMNUL, și the preot va execute upon ei toți this lege.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונקה האיש מעון והאשה ההיא תשא את עונה
verses.english: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.romanian: atunci va the om fi guiltless din iniquity, și this femeie va bear ei iniquity.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם איש או אשה כי יפלא לנדר נדר נזיר להזיר ליהוה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate [themselves] to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate [themselves] unto the LORD:
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când either om sau femeie va separate [înșiși] to juruință a juruință of a Nazarite, to separate [înșiși] lui DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מיין ושכר יזיר חמץ יין וחמץ שכר לא ישתה וכל משארת ענבים לא ישתה וענבים לחים ויבישים לא יאכל
verses.english: He shall separate [himself] from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.romanian: He va separate [însuși] din wine și puternic drink, și va drink no vinegar of wine, sau vinegar of puternic drink, neither va he drink vreun liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, sau dried.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי נזרו מכל אשר יעשה מגפן היין מחרצנים ועד זג לא יאכל
verses.english: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.romanian: toți the zile of lui separation va he eat nimic că este a făcut of the vine tree, din the kernels even to the husk.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי נדר נזרו תער לא יעבר על ראשו עד מלאת הימים אשר יזיר ליהוה קדוש יהיה גדל פרע שער ראשו
verses.english: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth [himself] unto the LORD, he shall be holy, [and] shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.romanian: toți the zile of the juruință of lui separation acolo va no razor a veni upon lui cap: until the zile fi fulfilled, in the care he separateth [însuși] lui DOMNUL, he va fi sfânt, [și] va let the locks of the hair of lui cap grow.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי הזירו ליהוה על נפש מת לא יבוא
verses.english: All the days that he separateth [himself] unto the LORD he shall come at no dead body.
verses.romanian: toți the zile că he separateth [însuși] lui DOMNUL he va a veni at no dead body.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לאביו ולאמו לאחיו ולאחותו לא יטמא להם במותם כי נזר אלהיו על ראשו
verses.english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God [is] upon his head.
verses.romanian: He va nu a face însuși necurat căci lui tată, sau căci lui mamă, căci lui frate, sau căci lui soră, când they a muri: pentru că the consecration of lui Dumnezeu [este] upon lui cap.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל ימי נזרו קדוש הוא ליהוה
verses.english: All the days of his separation he [is] holy unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: toți the zile of lui separation he [este] sfânt lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי ימות מת עליו בפתע פתאם וטמא ראש נזרו וגלח ראשו ביום טהרתו ביום השביעי יגלחנו
verses.english: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun om a muri foarte suddenly de el, și he sunt pângărit the cap of lui consecration; atunci he va shave lui cap in the zi of lui cleansing, on the al șaptelea zi va he shave it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני יביא שתי תרים או שני בני יונה אל הכהן אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: și on the al optulea zi he va a aduce doi turtles, sau doi young pigeons, to the preot, to the door of the Cortul of the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשה הכהן אחד לחטאת ואחד לעלה וכפר עליו מאשר חטא על הנפש וקדש את ראשו ביום ההוא
verses.english: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.romanian: și the preot va a aduce ca jertfă the unu căci a păcat prinos, și the other căci a burnt prinos, și a face an atonement căci him, căci că he sinned by the dead, și va hallow lui cap că same zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזיר ליהוה את ימי נזרו והביא כבש בן שנתו לאשם והימים הראישונים יפלו כי טמא נזרו
verses.english: And he shall consecrate unto the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.romanian: și he va consecrate lui DOMNUL the zile of lui separation, și va a aduce a miel of the întâi an căci a trespass prinos: dar the zile că erau înainte va fi lost, pentru că lui separation era pângărit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת תורת הנזיר ביום מלאת ימי נזרו יביא אתו אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And this [is] the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: și this [este] the lege of the Nazarite, când the zile of lui separation sunt fulfilled: he va fi a adus lui the door of the Cortul of the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב את קרבנו ליהוה כבש בן שנתו תמים אחד לעלה וכבשה אחת בת שנתה תמימה לחטאת ואיל אחד תמים לשלמים
verses.english: And he shall offer his offering unto the LORD, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings
verses.romanian: și he va a aduce ca jertfă lui prinos lui DOMNUL, unu he miel of the întâi an fără blemish căci a burnt prinos, și unu ewe miel of the întâi an fără blemish căci a păcat prinos, și unu berbec fără blemish căci pace prinoase

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וסל מצות סלת חלות בללות בשמן ורקיקי מצות משחים בשמן ומנחתם ונסכיהם
verses.english: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.romanian: și a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe, și wafers of unleavened bread anointed cu a fierbe, și lor meat prinos, și lor drink prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב הכהן לפני יהוה ועשה את חטאתו ואת עלתו
verses.english: And the priest shall bring [them] before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a aduce [them] înainte DOMNUL, și va a aduce ca jertfă lui păcat prinos, și lui burnt prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת האיל יעשה זבח שלמים ליהוה על סל המצות ועשה הכהן את מנחתו ואת נסכו
verses.english: And he shall offer the ram [for] a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și he va a aduce ca jertfă the berbec [căci] a jertfă of pace prinoase lui DOMNUL, cu the basket of unleavened bread: the preot va a aduce ca jertfă de asemenea lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגלח הנזיר פתח אהל מועד את ראש נזרו ולקח את שער ראש נזרו ונתן על האש אשר תחת זבח השלמים
verses.english: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation [at] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put [it] in the fire which [is] under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.romanian: și the Nazarite va shave the cap of lui separation [at] the door of the Cortul of the obște, și va a lua the hair of the cap of lui separation, și a pune [it] in the foc care [este] sub the jertfă of the pace prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן את הזרוע בשלה מן האיל וחלת מצה אחת מן הסל ורקיק מצה אחד ונתן על כפי הנזיר אחרי התגלח את נזרו
verses.english: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put [them] upon the hands of the Nazarite, after [the hair of] his separation is shaven:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a lua the sodden shoulder of the berbec, și unu unleavened cake out of the basket, și unu unleavened wafer, și va a pune [them] upon the mâini of the Nazarite, după [the hair of] lui separation este shaven:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והניף אתם הכהן תנופה לפני יהוה קדש הוא לכהן יהיה על חזה התנופה ועל שוק התרומה ואחר ישתה הנזיר יין
verses.english: And the priest shall wave them [for] a wave offering before the LORD: this [is] holy for the priest, and it is becoming for the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.romanian: și the preot va wave them [căci] a wave prinos înainte DOMNUL: this [este] sfânt căci the preot, și it este becoming căci the wave breast și heave shoulder: și după că the Nazarite poate drink wine.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת תורת הנזיר אשר ידר קרבנו ליהוה על נזרו מלבד אשר תשיג ידו כפי נדרו אשר ידר כן יעשה על תורת נזרו
verses.english: This [is] the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, [and of] his offering unto the LORD for his separation, beside [that] that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
verses.romanian: This [este] the lege of the Nazarite care sunt a făgăduit, [și of] lui prinos lui DOMNUL căci lui separation, beside [că] că lui mână va get: după the juruință care he a făgăduit, astfel he trebuie a face după the lege of lui separation.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואל בניו לאמר כה תברכו את בני ישראל אמר להם
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron și lui lui sons, saying, On this wise voi va a binecuvânta the copiii lui Israel, saying lui them

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יברכך יהוה וישמרך
verses.english: The LORD bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.romanian: DOMNUL a binecuvânta te, și a păzi te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יאיר יהוה פניו אליך ויחנך
verses.english: The LORD make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.romanian: DOMNUL a face lui față shine upon te, și fi gracious lui te:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ישא יהוה פניו אליך וישם לך שלום
verses.english: The LORD lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.romanian: DOMNUL lift up lui countenance upon te, și a da te pace.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושימו את שמי על בני ישראל ואני אברכם
verses.english: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel; and I will bless them.
verses.romanian: și they va a pune meu name upon the copiii lui Israel; și I va a binecuvânta them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי ביום כלות משה להקים את המשכן וימשח אתו ויקדש אתו ואת כל כליו ואת המזבח ואת כל כליו וימשחם ויקדש אתם
verses.english: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece on the zi că Moise had fully a așeza up the Cortul, și had anointed it, și a sfințit it, și toți the instruments al acestuia, both the altar și toți the vessels al acestuia, și had anointed them, și a sfințit them;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריבו נשיאי ישראל ראשי בית אבותם הם נשיאי המטות הם העמדים על הפקדים
verses.english: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who [were] the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.romanian: că the căpetenii of Israel, capete of the house of lor părinți, care [erau] the căpetenii of the seminții, și erau peste them că erau numărat, a adus ca jertfă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויביאו את קרבנם לפני יהוה שש עגלות צב ושנים עשר בקר עגלה על שני הנשיאים ושור לאחד ויקריבו אתם לפני המשכן
verses.english: And they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și they a adus lor prinos înainte DOMNUL, șase covered wagons, și doisprezece oxen; a wagon căci doi of the căpetenii, și căci fiecare unu an bou: și they a adus them înainte the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח מאתם והיו לעבד את עבדת אהל מועד ונתתה אתם אל הלוים איש כפי עבדתו
verses.english: Take [it] of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.romanian: a lua [it] al lor, că they poate fi to a face the service of the Cortul of the obște; și tu vei a da them lui the leviți, to fiecare om după lui service.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה את העגלות ואת הבקר ויתן אתם אל הלוים
verses.english: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat the wagons și the oxen, și a dat them lui the leviți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את שתי העגלות ואת ארבעת הבקר נתן לבני גרשון כפי עבדתם
verses.english: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.romanian: doi wagons și patru oxen he a dat lui the fiii lui Gershon, după lor service:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת ארבעת העגלות ואת שמנת הבקר נתן לבני מררי כפי עבדתם ביד איתמר בן אהרן הכהן
verses.english: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.romanian: și patru wagons și opt oxen he a dat lui the fiii lui Merari, according lui lor service, sub the mână of Ithamar the son of Aaron the preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולבני קהת לא נתן כי עבדת הקדש עליהם בכתף ישאו
verses.english: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them [was that] they should bear upon their shoulders.
verses.romanian: dar lui the fiii lui Kohath he a dat niciun: pentru că the service of the loc sfânt belonging lui them [era că] they trebuie să bear upon lor shoulders.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריבו הנשיאים את חנכת המזבח ביום המשיח אתו ויקריבו הנשיאים את קרבנם לפני המזבח
verses.english: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenii a adus ca jertfă căci dedicating of the altar in the zi că it era anointed, even the căpetenii a adus ca jertfă lor prinos înainte the altar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה נשיא אחד ליום נשיא אחד ליום יקריבו את קרבנם לחנכת המזבח
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, They va a aduce ca jertfă lor prinos, fiecare căpetenie on lui zi, căci the dedicating of the altar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי המקריב ביום הראישון את קרבנו נחשון בן עמינדב למטה יהודה
verses.english: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.romanian: și he că a adus ca jertfă lui prinos the întâi zi era Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the seminție of Judah:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבנו קערת כסף אחת שלשים ומאה משקלה מזרק אחד כסף שבעים שקל בשקל הקדש שניהם מלאים סלת בלולה בשמן למנחה
verses.english: And his offering [was] one silver charger, the weight thereof [was] an hundred and thirty [shekels], one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them [were] full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.romanian: și lui prinos [era] unu argint charger, the weight al acestuia [era] an sută și treizeci [shekels], unu argint bowl of șaptezeci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt; both al lor [erau] full of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe căci a meat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כף אחת עשרה זהב מלאה קטרת
verses.english: One spoon of ten [shekels] of gold, full of incense:
verses.romanian: unu spoon of zece [shekels] of aur, full of tămâie:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פר אחד בן בקר איל אחד כבש אחד בן שנתו לעלה
verses.english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.romanian: unu young bullock, unu berbec, unu miel of the întâi an, căci a burnt prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבח השלמים בקר שנים אילים חמשה עתודים חמשה כבשים בני שנה חמשה זה קרבן נחשון בן עמינדב
verses.english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.romanian: și căci a jertfă of pace prinoase, doi oxen, cinci rams, cinci he goats, cinci lambs of the întâi an: this [era] the prinos of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כף אחת עשרה זהב מלאה קטרת

verses.romanian: unu golden spoon of zece [shekels], full of tămâie:

verses.english: On the ninth day Abidan the son of Gideoni, prince of the children of Benjamin, [offered]:
verses.romanian: On the al nouălea zi Abidan the son of Gideoni, căpetenie of the copiii lui Benjamin, [a adus ca jertfă]:

verses.romanian: și lui prinos [era] unu argint charger, the weight whereof [era] an sută și treizeci [shekels], unu argint bowl of șaptezeci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt; both al lor full of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe căci a meat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבח השלמים בקר שנים אילים חמשה עתודים חמשה כבשים בני שנה חמשה זה קרבן אבידן בן גדעוני
verses.english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.romanian: și căci a jertfă of pace prinoase, doi oxen, cinci rams, cinci he goats, cinci lambs of the întâi an: this [era] the prinos of Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום העשירי נשיא לבני דן אחיעזר בן עמישדי
verses.english: On the tenth day Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, prince of the children of Dan, [offered]:
verses.romanian: On the al zecelea zi Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai, căpetenie of the copiii lui Dan, [a adus ca jertfă]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבנו קערת כסף אחת שלשים ומאה משקלה מזרק אחד כסף שבעים שקל בשקל הקדש שניהם מלאים סלת בלולה בשמן למנחה

verses.romanian: și lui prinos [era] unu argint charger, the weight whereof [era] an sută și treizeci [shekels], unu argint bowl of șaptezeci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt; both al lor full of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe căci a meat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כף אחת עשרה זהב מלאה קטרת
verses.english: One golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of incense:
verses.romanian: unu golden spoon of zece [shekels], full of tămâie:

verses.english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.romanian: unu young bullock, unu berbec, unu miel of the întâi an, căci a burnt prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבח השלמים בקר שנים אילים חמשה עתודים חמשה כבשים בני שנה חמשה זה קרבן אחיעזר בן עמישדי
verses.english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.romanian: și căci a jertfă of pace prinoase, doi oxen, cinci rams, cinci he goats, cinci lambs of the întâi an: this [era] the prinos of Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום עשתי עשר יום נשיא לבני אשר פגעאל בן עכרן
verses.english: On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ocran, prince of the children of Asher, [offered]:
verses.romanian: On the eleventh zi Pagiel the son of Ocran, căpetenie of the copiii lui Asher, [a adus ca jertfă]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבנו קערת כסף אחת שלשים ומאה משקלה מזרק אחד כסף שבעים שקל בשקל הקדש שניהם מלאים סלת בלולה בשמן למנחה

verses.romanian: și lui prinos [era] unu argint charger, the weight whereof [era] an sută și treizeci [shekels], unu argint bowl of șaptezeci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt; both al lor full of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe căci a meat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כף אחת עשרה זהב מלאה קטרת
verses.english: One golden spoon of ten [shekels], full of incense:
verses.romanian: unu golden spoon of zece [shekels], full of tămâie:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פר אחד בן בקר איל אחד כבש אחד בן שנתו לעלה
verses.english: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.romanian: unu young bullock, unu berbec, unu miel of the întâi an, căci a burnt prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבח השלמים בקר שנים אילים חמשה עתודים חמשה כבשים בני שנה חמשה זה קרבן פגעאל בן עכרן
verses.english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.romanian: și căci a jertfă of pace prinoase, doi oxen, cinci rams, cinci he goats, cinci lambs of the întâi an: this [era] the prinos of Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום שנים עשר יום נשיא לבני נפתלי אחירע בן עינן
verses.english: On the twelfth day Ahira the son of Enan, prince of the children of Naphtali, [offered]:
verses.romanian: On the twelfth zi Ahira the son of Enan, căpetenie of the copiii lui Naphtali, [a adus ca jertfă]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקרבנו קערת כסף אחת שלשים ומאה משקלה מזרק אחד כסף שבעים שקל בשקל הקדש שניהם מלאים סלת בלולה בשמן למנחה

verses.romanian: și lui prinos [era] unu argint charger, the weight whereof [era] an sută și treizeci [shekels], unu argint bowl of șaptezeci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt; both al lor full of fine făină mingled cu a fierbe căci a meat prinos:

verses.romanian: unu golden spoon of zece [shekels], full of tămâie:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולזבח השלמים בקר שנים אילים חמשה עתודים חמשה כבשים בני שנה חמשה זה קרבן אחירע בן עינן
verses.english: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this [was] the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.romanian: și căci a jertfă of pace prinoase, doi oxen, cinci rams, cinci he goats, cinci lambs of the întâi an: this [era] the prinos of Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת חנכת המזבח ביום המשיח אתו מאת נשיאי ישראל קערות כסף שתים עשרה מזרקי כסף שנים עשר כפות זהב שתים עשרה
verses.english: This [was] the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.romanian: This [era] the dedication of the altar, in the zi când it era anointed, by the căpetenii of Israel: doisprezece chargers of argint, doisprezece argint bowls, doisprezece spoons of aur:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שלשים ומאה הקערה האחת הכסף ושבעים המזרק האחד כל כסף הכלים אלפים וארבע מאות בשקל הקדש
verses.english: Each charger of silver [weighing] an hundred and thirty [shekels], each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels [weighed] two thousand and four hundred [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.romanian: fiecare charger of argint [weighing] an sută și treizeci [shekels], fiecare bowl șaptezeci: toți the argint vessels [weighed] doi mie și patru sută [shekels], după the shekel of the loc sfânt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כפות זהב שתים עשרה מלאות קטרת עשרה עשרה הכף בשקל הקדש כל זהב הכפות עשרים ומאה
verses.english: The golden spoons [were] twelve, full of incense, [weighing] ten [shekels] apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons [was] an hundred and twenty [shekels].
verses.romanian: The golden spoons [erau] doisprezece, full of tămâie, [weighing] zece [shekels] apiece, după the shekel of the loc sfânt: toți the aur of the spoons [era] an sută și douăzeci [shekels].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הבקר לעלה שנים עשר פרים אילים שנים עשר כבשים בני שנה שנים עשר ומנחתם ושעירי עזים שנים עשר לחטאת
verses.english: All the oxen for the burnt offering [were] twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.romanian: toți the oxen căci the burnt prinos [erau] doisprezece bullocks, the rams doisprezece, the lambs of the întâi an doisprezece, cu lor meat prinos: și the kids of the goats căci păcat prinos doisprezece.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל בקר זבח השלמים עשרים וארבעה פרים אילים ששים עתודים ששים כבשים בני שנה ששים זאת חנכת המזבח אחרי המשח אתו
verses.english: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings [were] twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This [was] the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.romanian: și toți the oxen căci the jertfă of the pace prinoase [erau] douăzeci și patru bullocks, the rams șaizeci, the he goats șaizeci, the lambs of the întâi an șaizeci. This [era] the dedication of the altar, după că it era anointed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובבא משה אל אהל מועד לדבר אתו וישמע את הקול מדבר אליו מעל הכפרת אשר על ארון העדות מבין שני הכרובים וידבר אליו
verses.english: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that [was] upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.romanian: și când Moise era gone into the Cortul of the obște to a vorbi cu him, atunci he a auzit the glas of unu speaking lui him din off the milă seat că [era] upon the chivot of mărturie, din between the doi cherubims: și he a vorbit lui him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל אהרן ואמרת אליו בהעלותך את הנרות אל מול פני המנורה יאירו שבעת הנרות
verses.english: Speak unto Aaron, and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Aaron, și a spune lui him, când tu lightest the lamps, the șapte lamps va a da light peste împotriva the candlestick.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש כן אהרן אל מול פני המנורה העלה נרתיה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Aaron a făcut astfel; he lighted the lamps al acestuia peste împotriva the candlestick, as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה מעשה המנורה מקשה זהב עד ירכיה ועד פרחיה מקשה היא כמראה אשר הראה יהוה את משה כן עשה את המנורה
verses.english: And this work of the candlestick [was of] beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, and unto the flowers thereof, [was] beaten work: according unto the pattern which the LORD had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.romanian: și this muncă of the candlestick [era of] beaten aur, lui the shaft al acestuia, și lui the flowers al acestuia, [era] beaten muncă: according lui the pattern care DOMNUL had shewed Moise, astfel he a făcut the candlestick.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח את הלוים מתוך בני ישראל וטהרת אתם
verses.english: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.romanian: a lua the leviți din între the copiii lui Israel, și a curăți them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכה תעשה להם לטהרם הזי עליהם מי חטאת והעבירו תער על כל בשרם וכבסו בגדיהם והטהרו
verses.english: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and [so] make themselves clean.
verses.romanian: și astfel shalt tu a face lui them, to a curăți them: Sprinkle apă of purifying upon them, și let them shave toți lor flesh, și let them a spăla lor clothes, și [astfel] a face înșiși curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו פר בן בקר ומנחתו סלת בלולה בשמן ופר שני בן בקר תקח לחטאת
verses.english: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, [even] fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.romanian: atunci let them a lua a young bullock cu lui meat prinos, [even] fine făină mingled cu a fierbe, și another young bullock shalt tu a lua căci a păcat prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבת את הלוים לפני אהל מועד והקהלת את כל עדת בני ישראל
verses.english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.romanian: și tu vei a aduce the leviți înainte the Cortul of the obște: și tu vei gather the întreg adunare of the copiii lui Israel together:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבת את הלוים לפני יהוה וסמכו בני ישראל את ידיהם על הלוים
verses.english: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the LORD: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.romanian: și tu vei a aduce the leviți înainte DOMNUL: și the copiii lui Israel va a pune lor mâini upon the leviți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והניף אהרן את הלוים תנופה לפני יהוה מאת בני ישראל והיו לעבד את עבדת יהוה
verses.english: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD [for] an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Aaron va a aduce ca jertfă the leviți înainte DOMNUL [căci] an prinos of the copiii lui Israel, că they poate execute the service of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והלוים יסמכו את ידיהם על ראש הפרים ועשה את האחד חטאת ואת האחד עלה ליהוה לכפר על הלוים
verses.english: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one [for] a sin offering, and the other [for] a burnt offering, unto the LORD, to make an atonement for the Levites.
verses.romanian: și the leviți va lay lor mâini upon the capete of the bullocks: și tu vei a aduce ca jertfă the unu [căci] a păcat prinos, și the other [căci] a burnt prinos, lui DOMNUL, to a face an atonement căci the leviți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעמדת את הלוים לפני אהרן ולפני בניו והנפת אתם תנופה ליהוה
verses.english: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them [for] an offering unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a așeza the leviți înainte Aaron, și înainte lui sons, și a aduce ca jertfă them [căci] an prinos lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והבדלת את הלוים מתוך בני ישראל והיו לי הלוים
verses.english: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.romanian: astfel shalt tu separate the leviți din între the copiii lui Israel: și the leviți va fi al meu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואחרי כן יבאו הלוים לעבד את עבדת אהל מועד וטהרת אתם והנפת אתם תנופה
verses.english: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the services of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them [for] an offering.
verses.romanian: și după că va the leviți a merge in to a face the service of the services of the Cortul of the obște: și tu vei a curăți them, și a aduce ca jertfă them [căci] an prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי נתנים נתנים הם לי מתוך בני ישראל תחת כל בכור פטר רחם בבני ישראל לקחתי אתם לי
verses.english: For they [are] wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, in [even instead of] the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
verses.romanian: căci they [sunt] wholly given lui me din între the copiii lui Israel; instead of such as open fiecare womb, in [even instead of] the întâi-născut of toți the copiii lui Israel, au I taken them lui me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לי כל בכור בבני ישראל באדם ובבהמה ביום הכיתי כל בכור בארץ מצרים הקדשתי אתם לי
verses.english: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel [are] mine, [both] man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.romanian: căci toți the întâi-născut of the copiii lui Israel [sunt] al meu, [both] om și beast: on the zi că I a lovit fiecare întâi-născut in the țară of Egypt I a sfințit them căci myself.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואקח את הלוים תחת כל בכור בבני ישראל
verses.english: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și I au taken the leviți căci toți the întâi-născut of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתנה את הלוים נתנים לאהרן ולבניו מתוך בני ישראל לעבד את עבדת בני ישראל באהל מועד ולכפר על בני ישראל ולא יהיה בבני ישראל נגף בגשת בני ישראל אל הקדש
verses.english: And I have given the Levites [as] a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
verses.romanian: și I au given the leviți [as] a gift to Aaron și to lui sons din între the copiii lui Israel, to a face the service of the copiii lui Israel in the Cortul of the obște, și to a face an atonement căci the copiii lui Israel: că acolo fi no urgie între the copiii lui Israel, când the copiii lui Israel a veni nigh lui the loc sfânt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה ואהרן וכל עדת בני ישראל ללוים ככל אשר צוה יהוה את משה ללוים כן עשו להם בני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.romanian: și Moise, și Aaron, și toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, a făcut to the leviți according lui toți că DOMNUL commanded Moise concerning the leviți, astfel a făcut the copiii lui Israel lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתחטאו הלוים ויכבסו בגדיהם וינף אהרן אתם תנופה לפני יהוה ויכפר עליהם אהרן לטהרם
verses.english: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them [as] an offering before the LORD; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.romanian: și the leviți erau purified, și they a spălat lor clothes; și Aaron a adus ca jertfă them [as] an prinos înainte DOMNUL; și Aaron a făcut an atonement căci them to a curăți them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואחרי כן באו הלוים לעבד את עבדתם באהל מועד לפני אהרן ולפני בניו כאשר צוה יהוה את משה על הלוים כן עשו להם
verses.english: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.romanian: și după că a mers the leviți in to a face lor service in the Cortul of the obște înainte Aaron, și înainte lui sons: as DOMNUL had commanded Moise concerning the leviți, astfel a făcut they lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת אשר ללוים מבן חמש ועשרים שנה ומעלה יבוא לצבא צבא בעבדת אהל מועד
verses.english: This [is it] that [belongeth] unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.romanian: This [este it] că [belongeth] lui the leviți: din douăzeci și cinci ani old și upward they va a merge in to wait upon the service of the Cortul of the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומבן חמשים שנה ישוב מצבא העבדה ולא יעבד עוד
verses.english: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service [thereof], and shall serve no more:
verses.romanian: și din the age of cincizeci ani they va cease waiting upon the service [al acestuia], și va a sluji no mai mult:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושרת את אחיו באהל מועד לשמר משמרת ועבדה לא יעבד ככה תעשו ללוים במשמרתם
verses.english: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
verses.romanian: dar va minister cu lor brethren in the Cortul of the obște, to a păzi the charge, și va a face no service. astfel shalt tu a face lui the leviți touching lor charge.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה במדבר סיני בשנה השנית לצאתם מארץ מצרים בחדש הראישון לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise in the pustie of Sinai, in the întâi lună of the al doilea an după they erau a veni out of the țară of Egypt, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעשו בני ישראל את הפסח במועדיו
verses.english: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
verses.romanian: Let the copiii lui Israel de asemenea a păzi the passover at lui appointed season.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בארבעה עשר יום בחדש הזה בין הערבים יעשו אתו במועדיו ככל חקתיו וככל משפטיו תעשו אתו
verses.english: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, they shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
verses.romanian: In the fourteenth zi of this lună, at even, they va a păzi it in lui appointed season: după toți the rites of it, și după toți the ceremonies al acestuia, va voi a păzi it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל בני ישראל לעשות הפסח
verses.english: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit lui the copiii lui Israel, că they trebuie să a păzi the passover.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעשו את הפסח בראישון בארבעה עשר יום לחדש בין הערבים במדבר סיני ככל אשר צוה יהוה את משה כן עשו בני ישראל
verses.english: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și they a păzit the passover on the fourteenth zi of the întâi lună at even in the pustie of Sinai: după toți că DOMNUL commanded Moise, astfel a făcut the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו אנשים אשר היו טמאים לנפש אדם ולא יכלו לעשות הפסח ביום ההוא ויקרבו לפני משה ולפני אהרן ביום ההוא
verses.english: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.romanian: și acolo erau certain oameni, care erau pângărit by the dead body of a om, că they could nu a păzi the passover on că zi: și they a venit înainte Moise și înainte Aaron on că zi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו האנשים ההם אליו אנחנו טמאים לנפש אדם למה נגרע לבלתי הקריב את קרבן יהוה במועדיו בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: And those men said unto him, We [are] defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the LORD in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.romanian: și those oameni a spus lui him, We [sunt] pângărit by the dead body of a om: de aceea sunt we a păzit back, că we poate nu a aduce ca jertfă an prinos of DOMNUL in lui appointed season între the copiii lui Israel?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם משה עמדו ואשמעה מה יצוה יהוה לכם
verses.english: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the LORD will command concerning you.
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui them, a sta still, și I va a auzi ce DOMNUL va command concerning you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל לאמר איש איש כי יהיה טמא לנפש או בדרך רחוקה לכם או לדרתיכם ועשה פסח ליהוה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or [be] in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, saying, dacă vreun om al vostru sau of vostru posterity va fi necurat by reason of a dead body, sau [fi] in a călătorie departe off, yet he va a păzi the passover lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בחדש השני בארבעה עשר יום בין הערבים יעשו אתו על מצות ומררים יאכלהו
verses.english: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, [and] eat it with unleavened bread and bitter [herbs].
verses.romanian: The fourteenth zi of the al doilea lună at even they va a păzi it, [și] eat it cu unleavened bread și bitter [herbs].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא ישאירו ממנו עד בקר ועצם לא ישברו בו ככל חקות הפסח יעשו אתו
verses.english: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.romanian: They va leave niciun of it lui the dimineață, nor break vreun bone of it: după toți the rânduieli of the passover they va a păzi it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאיש אשר הוא טהור ובדרך לא היה וחדל לעשות הפסח ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מעמיה כי קרבן יהוה לא הקריב במועדיו חטאו ישא האיש ההוא
verses.english: But the man that [is] clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the LORD in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.romanian: dar the om că [este] curat, și este nu in a călătorie, și forbeareth to a păzi the passover, even the same suflet va fi cut off din între lui popor: pentru că he a adus nu the prinos of DOMNUL in lui appointed season, că om va bear lui păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יגור אתכם גר ועשה פסח ליהוה כחקות הפסח וכמשפטיו כן יעשה חקה אחת יהיה לכם ולגר ולאזרח הארץ
verses.english: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the LORD; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.romanian: și dacă a străin va sojourn între you, și va a păzi the passover lui DOMNUL; după the rânduială of the passover, și după the manner al acestuia, astfel va he a face: voi va au unu rânduială, both căci the străin, și căci him că era born in the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום הוקם את המשכן כסה הענן את המשכן לאהל העדות ובערב יהיה על המשכן כמראה אש עד בקר
verses.english: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, [namely], the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.romanian: și on the zi că the Cortul era reared up the nor covered the Cortul, [namely], the cort of the mărturie: și at even acolo era upon the Cortul as it erau the appearance of foc, until the dimineață.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כן יהיה תמיד הענן יכסנו ומראה אש לילה
verses.english: So it was always: the cloud covered it [by day], and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.romanian: astfel it era always: the nor covered it [by zi], și the appearance of foc by noapte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולפי העלות הענן מעל האהל ואחרי כן יסעו בני ישראל ובמקום אשר ישכן שם הענן שם יחנו בני ישראל
verses.english: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
verses.romanian: și când the nor era taken up din the Cortul, atunci după că the copiii lui Israel au călătorit: și in the place where the nor abode, acolo the copiii lui Israel pitched lor tents.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי יהוה יסעו בני ישראל ועל פי יהוה יחנו כל ימי אשר ישכן הענן על המשכן יחנו
verses.english: At the commandment of the LORD the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the LORD they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
verses.romanian: At the poruncă of DOMNUL the copiii lui Israel au călătorit, și at the poruncă of DOMNUL they pitched: as long as the nor abode upon the Cortul they s-a odihnit in lor tents.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובהאריך הענן על המשכן ימים רבים ושמרו בני ישראל את משמרת יהוה ולא יסעו
verses.english: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the LORD, and journeyed not.
verses.romanian: și când the nor tarried long upon the Cortul many zile, atunci the copiii lui Israel a păzit the charge of DOMNUL, și au călătorit nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויש אשר יהיה הענן ימים במספר על המשכן על פי יהוה יחנו ועל פי יהוה יסעו
verses.english: And [so] it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the LORD they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the LORD they journeyed.
verses.romanian: și [astfel] it era, când the nor era a few zile upon the Cortul; după the poruncă of DOMNUL they abode in lor tents, și după the poruncă of DOMNUL they au călătorit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויש אשר יהיה הענן מערב עד בקר ונעלה הענן בבקר ונסעו או יומם ולילה ונעלה הענן ונסעו
verses.english: And [so] it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and [that] the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether [it was] by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.romanian: și [astfel] it era, când the nor abode din even lui the dimineață, și [că] the nor era taken up in the dimineață, atunci they au călătorit: whether [it era] by zi sau by noapte că the nor era taken up, they au călătorit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או יומים או חדש או ימים בהאריך הענן על המשכן לשכן עליו יחנו בני ישראל ולא יסעו ובהעלותו יסעו
verses.english: Or [whether it were] two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.romanian: sau [whether it erau] doi zile, sau a lună, sau a an, că the nor tarried upon the Cortul, remaining pe el, the copiii lui Israel abode in lor tents, și au călătorit nu: dar când it era taken up, they au călătorit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי יהוה יחנו ועל פי יהוה יסעו את משמרת יהוה שמרו על פי יהוה ביד משה
verses.english: At the commandment of the LORD they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the LORD they journeyed: they kept the charge of the LORD, at the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: At the poruncă of DOMNUL they s-a odihnit in the tents, și at the poruncă of DOMNUL they au călătorit: they a păzit the charge of DOMNUL, at the poruncă of DOMNUL by the mână of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עשה לך שתי חצצרות כסף מקשה תעשה אתם והיו לך למקרא העדה ולמסע את המחנות
verses.english: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.romanian: a face te doi trâmbițe of argint; of a întreg piece shalt tu a face them: că tu mayest use them căci the calling of the adunare, și căci the călătorind of the tabere.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקעו בהן ונועדו אליך כל העדה אל פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și când they va blow cu them, toți the adunare va assemble înșiși to te at the door of the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם באחת יתקעו ונועדו אליך הנשיאים ראשי אלפי ישראל
verses.english: And if they blow [but] with one [trumpet], then the princes, [which are] heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.romanian: și dacă they blow [dar] cu unu [trâmbiță], atunci the căpetenii, [care sunt] capete of the mii of Israel, va gather înșiși lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקעתם תרועה ונסעו המחנות החנים קדמה
verses.english: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.romanian: când voi blow an alarm, atunci the tabere că lie on the east parts va a merge forward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקעתם תרועה שנית ונסעו המחנות החנים צפונה תרועה יתקעו למסעיהם
verses.english: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.romanian: când voi blow an alarm the al doilea time, atunci the tabere că lie on the south side va a lua lor călătorie: they va blow an alarm căci lor călătorii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובהקהל את הקהל תתקעו ולא תריעו
verses.english: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.romanian: dar când the obște este to fi gathered together, voi va blow, dar voi va nu sound an alarm.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני אהרן הכהנים יתקעו בחצצרות והיו לכם לחקות עולם לדרתיכם
verses.english: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Aaron, the preoți, va blow cu the trâmbițe; și they va fi to you căci an rânduială căci ever throughout vostru generations.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תבאו מלחמה בארצכם על הצר הצרר אתכם והרעתם בחצצרות ונזכרתם לפני יהוה אלהיכם ונושעתם מאיביכם
verses.english: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the LORD your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.romanian: și dacă voi a merge to război in vostru țară împotriva the dușman că oppresseth you, atunci voi va blow an alarm cu the trâmbițe; și voi va fi și-a adus aminte înainte DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, și voi va fi saved din vostru dușmani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום שמחתיכם ובמועדיכם ובראשי חדשיכם ותקעתם בחצצרות על עלתיכם ועל זבחי שלמיכם והיו לכם לזכרון לפני יהוה אלהיכם אני יהוה אלהיכם וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר רב לכם שבת בהר הזה פנו וסעו לכם ובאו הר האמרי ואל כל שכינו בערבה בהר ובשפלה בנגב ובחוף הים ארץ הכנעני והלבנון עד הנהר הגדול נהר פרת ראו נתתי לפניכם את הארץ באו ורשו את הארץ אשר נשבעתי לאבתיכם לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב לתת לזרעם אחריהם
verses.english: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your LORD God: I [am] the LORD your God. And the LORD said to Moses: There are many of you dwelling in this mountain. Turn around and journey. And go to the mountain of Amorites and to all dwellers of the deserts, and to mountain, and to the valley of the south, and to the sea shore of the land of Cananites, and unto the Lebanon, unto the great river, river Ephrates. See, I give before you the land. And now come and occupy the land which I swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaach, an to Jacob, to give to the seed after them.
verses.romanian: de asemenea in the zi of vostru gladness, și in vostru solemn zile, și in the beginnings of vostru luni, voi va blow cu the trâmbițe peste vostru burnt prinoase, și peste the jertfe of vostru pace prinoase; că they poate fi to you căci a memorial înainte vostru LORD Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu. și DOMNUL a spus to Moise: acolo sunt many al vostru dwelling in this munte. a se întoarce around și călătorie. și a merge to the munte of Amorites și to toți dwellers of the deserts, și to munte, și to the valley of the south, și to the mare shore of the țară of Cananites, și lui the Lebanon, lui the mare râu, râu Ephrates. a vedea, I a da înainte you the țară. și acum a veni și occupy the țară care I swore to vostru părinți, to Abraham, to Isaach, an to Jacob, to a da to the seed după them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בשנה השנית בחדש השני בעשרים בחדש נעלה הענן מעל משכן העדות
verses.english: And it came to pass on the twentieth [day] of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece on the twentieth [zi] of the al doilea lună, in the al doilea an, că the nor era taken up din off the Cortul of the mărturie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו בני ישראל למסעיהם ממדבר סיני וישכן הענן במדבר פראן
verses.english: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a luat lor călătorii out of the pustie of Sinai; și the nor s-a odihnit in the pustie of Paran.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו בראישונה על פי יהוה ביד משה
verses.english: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: și they întâi a luat lor călătorie după the poruncă of DOMNUL by the mână of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסע דגל מחנה בני יהודה בראישונה לצבאתם ועל צבאו נחשון בן עמינדב
verses.english: In the first [place] went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host [was] Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.romanian: In the întâi [place] a mers the standard of the tabără of the copiii lui Judah după lor armies: și peste lui oștire [era] Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני יששכר נתנאל בן צוער
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar [was] Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Issachar [era] Nethaneel the son of Zuar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני זבולן אליאב בן חילן
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun [was] Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Zebulun [era] Eliab the son of Helon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והורד המשכן ונסעו בני גרשון ובני מררי נשאי המשכן
verses.english: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și the Cortul era taken down; și the fiii lui Gershon și the fiii lui Merari a așeza forward, bearing the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסע דגל מחנה בני ראובן לצבאתם ועל צבאו אליצור בן שדיאור
verses.english: And the standard of the camp of sons of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host [was] Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.romanian: și the standard of the tabără of fiii lui Reuben a așeza forward după lor armies: și peste lui oștire [era] Elizur the son of Shedeur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני שמעון שלמיאל בן צורישדי
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon [was] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Simeon [era] Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני גד אליסף בן דעואל
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad [was] Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Gad [era] Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסעו הקהתים נשאי המקדש והקימו את המשכן עד באם
verses.english: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and [the other] did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.romanian: și the chehatiți a așeza forward, bearing the loc sfânt: și [the other] a făcut a așeza up the Cortul împotriva they a venit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסע דגל מחנה בני אפרים לצבאתם ועל צבאו אלישמע בן עמיהוד
verses.english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host [was] Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.romanian: și the standard of the tabără of the copiii lui Ephraim a așeza forward după lor armies: și peste lui oștire [era] Elishama the son of Ammihud.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני מנשה גמלאל בן פדהצור
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh [was] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Manasseh [era] Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני בנימים אבידן בן גדעוני
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin [was] Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Benjamin [era] Abidan the son of Gideoni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסע דגל מחנה בני דן מאסף לכל המחנות לצבאתם ועל צבאו אחיעזר בן עמישדי
verses.english: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, [which was] the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host [was] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.romanian: și the standard of the tabără of the copiii lui Dan a așeza forward, [care era] the rereward of toți the tabere throughout lor oștiri: și peste lui oștire [era] Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני אשר פגעאל בן עכרן
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher [was] Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Asher [era] Pagiel the son of Ocran.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועל צבא מטה בני נפתלי אחירע בן עינן
verses.english: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali [was] Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.romanian: și peste the oștire of the seminție of the copiii lui Naphtali [era] Ahira the son of Enan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה מסעי בני ישראל לצבאתם ויסעו
verses.english: Thus [were] the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.romanian: astfel [erau] the journeyings of the copiii lui Israel după lor armies, când they a așeza forward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה לחובב בן רעואל המדיני חתן משה נסעים אנחנו אל המקום אשר אמר יהוה אתו אתן לכם לך אתנו והטיבנו לך כי יהוה דבר טוב על ישראל
verses.english: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moise' tată-in-lege, We sunt călătorind lui the place of care DOMNUL a spus, I va a da it you: a veni tu cu us, și we va a face te bun: căci DOMNUL sunt spoken bun concerning Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליו לא אלך כי אם אל ארצי ואל מולדתי אלך
verses.english: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.romanian: și he a spus lui him, I va nu a merge; dar I va a pleca to al meu own țară, și to meu kindred.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אל נא תעזב אתנו כי על כן ידעת חנתינו במדבר והיית לנו לעינים
verses.english: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.romanian: și he a spus, Leave us nu, I pray te; forasmuch as tu knowest cum we sunt to a tăbărî in the pustie, și tu mayest fi to us instead of eyes.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כי תלך עמנו והיה הטוב ההוא אשר ייטב יהוה עמנו והטיבנו לך
verses.english: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the LORD shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.romanian: și it va fi, dacă tu a merge cu us, yea, it va fi, că ce bunătate DOMNUL va a face lui us, the same va we a face lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהר יהוה דרך שלשת ימים וארון ברית יהוה נסע לפניהם דרך שלשת ימים לתור להם מנוחה
verses.english: And they departed from the mount of the LORD three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the LORD went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din the mount of DOMNUL trei zile' călătorie: și the chivot of the legământ of DOMNUL a mers înainte them in the trei zile' călătorie, to search out a resting place căci them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וענן יהוה עליהם יומם בנסעם מן המחנה
verses.english: And the cloud of the LORD [was] upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.romanian: și the nor of DOMNUL [era] upon them by zi, când they a mers out of the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בנסע הארון ויאמר משה קומה יהוה ויפוצו איביך וינסו משנאיך מפניך
verses.english: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, LORD, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece, când the chivot a așeza forward, că Moise a spus, a se ridica up, LORD, și let al tău dușmani fi scattered; și let them că hate te flee înainte te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובמנוחה יאמר שובה יהוה רבבות אלפי ישראל
verses.english: And when it rested, he said, Return, O LORD, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.romanian: și când it s-a odihnit, he a spus, Return, O LORD, lui the many mii of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי העם כמתאננים רע באזני יהוה וישמע יהוה ויחר אפו ותבער בם אש יהוה ותאכל בקצה המחנה
verses.english: And [when] the people complained, it displeased the LORD: and the LORD heard [it]; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the LORD burnt among them, and consumed [them that were] in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.romanian: și [când] the popor s-a plâns, it displeased DOMNUL: și DOMNUL a auzit [it]; și lui mânie era kindled; și the foc of DOMNUL burnt între them, și a mistuit [them că erau] in the uttermost parts of the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצעק העם אל משה ויתפלל משה אל יהוה ותשקע האש
verses.english: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the LORD, the fire was quenched.
verses.romanian: și the popor a strigat lui Moise; și când Moise prayed lui DOMNUL, the foc era quenched.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא שם המקום ההוא תבערה כי בערה בם אש יהוה
verses.english: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the LORD burnt among them.
verses.romanian: și he a chemat the name of the place Taberah: pentru că the foc of DOMNUL burnt între them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והספסף אשר בקרבו התאוו תאוה וישבו ויבכו גם בני ישראל ויאמרו מי יאכילנו בשר
verses.english: And the mixed multitude that [was] among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.romanian: și the mixed multitude că [era] între them a căzut a lusting: și the copiii lui Israel de asemenea a plâns again, și a spus, care va a da us flesh to eat?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זכרנו את הדגה אשר נאכל במצרים חנם את הקשואים ואת הבטחים ואת החציר ואת הבצלים ואת השומים
verses.english: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.romanian: We a-și aduce aminte the fish, care we a făcut eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, și the melons, și the leeks, și the onions, și the garlick:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה נפשנו יבשה אין כל בלתי אל המן עיננו
verses.english: But now our soul [is] dried away: [there is] nothing at all, beside this manna, [before] our eyes.
verses.romanian: dar acum nostru suflet [este] dried away: [acolo este] nimic at toți, beside this manna, [înainte] nostru eyes.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והמן כזרע גד הוא ועינו כעין הבדלח
verses.english: And the manna [was] as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.romanian: și the manna [era] as coriander seed, și the colour al acestuia as the colour of bdellium.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שטו העם ולקטו וטחנו ברחים ודכו במדוכה ובשלו בפרור ועשו אתו עגות והיה טעמו כטעם לשד השמן
verses.english: [And] the people went about, and gathered [it], and ground [it] in mills, or beat [it] in a mortar, and baked [it] in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.romanian: [și] the popor a mers about, și gathered [it], și ground [it] in mills, sau beat [it] in a mortar, și baked [it] in pans, și a făcut cakes of it: și the taste of it era as the taste of fresh a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וברדת הטל על המחנה לילה ירד המן עליו
verses.english: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.romanian: și când the dew a căzut upon the tabără in the noapte, the manna a căzut upon it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע משה את העם בכה למשפחתיו איש לפתח אהלו ויחר אף יהוה מאד ובעיני משה רע
verses.english: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.romanian: atunci Moise a auzit the popor a plânge throughout lor families, fiecare om in the door of lui cort: și the mânie of DOMNUL era kindled greatly; Moise de asemenea era displeased.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל יהוה למה הרעת לעבדך ולמה לא מצאתי חן בעיניך לשים את משא כל העם הזה עלי
verses.english: And Moses said unto the LORD, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui DOMNUL, de aceea hast tu afflicted tău slujitor? și de aceea au I nu found favour in tău sight, că tu layest the burden of toți this popor upon me?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האנכי הרתי את כל העם הזה אם אנכי ילדתיו כי תאמר אלי שאהו בחיקך כאשר ישא האמן את הינק אל האדמה אשר נשבעת לאבתיו
verses.english: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.romanian: au I conceived toți this popor? au I begotten them, că tu shouldest a spune lui me, Carry them in tău bosom, as a nursing tată beareth the sucking copil, lui the țară care tu swarest lui lor părinți?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מאין לי בשר לתת לכל העם הזה כי יבכו עלי לאמר תנה לנו בשר ונאכל
verses.english: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.romanian: Whence trebuie să I au flesh to a da lui toți this popor? căci they a plânge lui me, saying, a da us flesh, că we poate eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא אוכל אנכי לבדי לשאת את כל העם הזה כי כבד ממני
verses.english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because [it is] too heavy for me.
verses.romanian: sunt nu able to bear toți this popor alone, pentru că [it este] too heavy căci me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם ככה אתה עשה לי הרגני נא הרג ואם מצאתי חן בעיניך ואל אראה ברעתי
verses.english: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, and if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.romanian: și dacă tu deal astfel cu me, a ucide me, I pray te, out of mână, și dacă I au found favour in tău sight; și let me nu a vedea meu wretchedness.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה אספה לי שבעים איש מזקני ישראל אשר ידעת כי הם זקני העם ושוטריו ולקחת אתם אל אהל מועד והתיצבו שם עמך
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, Gather lui me șaptezeci oameni of the elders of Israel, pe care tu knowest to fi the elders of the popor, și officers peste them; și a aduce them lui the Cortul of the obște, că they poate a sta acolo cu te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירדתי ודברתי עמך שם והצלתי מן הרוח אשר עליך ושמתי עליהם ונשאו אתך במשא העם ולא תשא אתה לבדך
verses.english: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which [is] upon thee, and will put [it] upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear [it] not thyself alone.
verses.romanian: și I va a veni down și talk cu te acolo: și I va a lua of the duh care [este] upon te, și va a pune [it] upon them; și they va bear the burden of the popor cu te, că tu bear [it] nu thyself alone.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל העם תאמר התקדשו למחר ואכלתם בשר כי בכיתם באזני יהוה לאמר מי יאכילנו בשר כי טוב לנו במצרים ונתן יהוה לכם בשר ואכלתם
verses.english: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for [it was] well with us in Egypt: therefore the LORD will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.romanian: și a spune tu lui the popor, a sfinți yourselves împotriva to morrow, și voi va eat flesh: căci voi au a plâns in the ears of DOMNUL, saying, care va a da us flesh to eat? căci [it era] well cu us in Egypt: de aceea DOMNUL va a da you flesh, și voi va eat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא יום אחד תאכלון ולא יומים ולא חמשה ימים ולא עשרה ימים ולא עשרים יום
verses.english: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.romanian: voi va nu eat unu zi, nor doi zile, nor cinci zile, neither zece zile, nor douăzeci zile;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עד חדש ימים עד אשר יצא מאפכם והיה לכם לזרה יען כי מאסתם את יהוה אשר בקרבכם ותבכו לפניו לאמר למה זה יצאנו ממצרים
verses.english: [But] even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the LORD which [is] among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.romanian: [dar] even a întreg lună, until it a veni out at vostru nostrils, și it fi loathsome lui you: pentru că că voi au despised DOMNUL care [este] între you, și au a plâns înainte him, saying, de ce a venit we forth out of Egypt?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה שש מאות אלף רגלאי העם אשר אנכי בקרבו ואתה אמרת בשר אתן להם ואכלו חדש ימים
verses.english: And Moses said, The people, among whom I [am, are] six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus, The popor, între pe care I [am, sunt] șase sută mie footmen; și tu ai a spus, I va a da them flesh, că they poate eat a întreg lună.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הצאן והבקר ישחט להם ומצא להם אם את כל דגי הים יאסף להם ומצא להם
verses.english: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.romanian: va the flocks și the herds fi ucis căci them, to suffice them? sau va toți the fish of the mare fi gathered together căci them, to suffice them?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה היד יהוה תקצר אתה תראה היקרך דברי אם לא
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Is the LORD's hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, este DOMNUL's mână waxed short? tu vei a vedea acum whether meu cuvânt va a veni to a trece lui te sau nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא משה וידבר אל העם את דברי יהוה ויאסף שבעים איש מזקני העם ויעמד אתם סביבת האהל
verses.english: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the LORD, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.romanian: și Moise a mers out, și told the popor the cuvinte of DOMNUL, și gathered the șaptezeci oameni of the elders of the popor, și a așeza them de jur împrejur the Cortul.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד יהוה בענן וידבר אליו ויצל מן הרוח אשר עליו ויתן על שבעים איש הזקנים ויהי כנוח עליהם הרוח ויתנאבו ולא יאספו
verses.english: And the LORD came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that [was] upon him, and gave [it] unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, [that], when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a venit down in a nor, și a vorbit lui him, și a luat of the duh că [era] upon him, și a dat [it] lui the șaptezeci elders: și it a venit to a trece, [că], când the duh s-a odihnit upon them, they prophesied, și a făcut nu cease.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישארו שני אנשים במחנה שם האחד אלדד ושם השני מודד ותנח עליהם הרוח והם בכתובים ולא יצאו האהלה ויתנאבו במחנה
verses.english: But there remained two [of the] men in the camp, the name of the one [was] Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they [were] of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.romanian: dar acolo remained doi [of the] oameni in the tabără, the name of the unu [era] Eldad, și the name of the other Medad: și the duh s-a odihnit upon them; și they [erau] al lor că erau written, dar a mers nu out lui the Cortul: și they prophesied in the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירץ הנער ויגד למשה ויאמר אלדד ומודד מתנאבים במחנה
verses.english: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.romanian: și acolo ran a young om, și told Moise, și a spus, Eldad și Medad a face prophesy in the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויען יהושע בן נון משרת משה מבחיריו ויאמר אדני משה כלאם
verses.english: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, [one] of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.romanian: și Iosua the son of Nun, the slujitor of Moise, [unu] of lui young oameni, a răspuns și a spus, meu lord Moise, forbid them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר לו משה המקנא אתה לי ומי יתן כל עם יהוה נביאים כי יתן יהוה את רוחו עליהם
verses.english: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the LORD's people were prophets, [and] that the LORD would put his spirit upon them!
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui him, Enviest tu căci meu sake? ar Dumnezeu că toți DOMNUL's popor erau prophets, [și] că DOMNUL ar a pune lui duh upon them!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאסף משה אל המחנה הוא וזקני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise gat him into the tabără, he și the elders of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ורוח נסע מאת יהוה ויגז שלוי מן הים ויטש אל המחנה כדרך יום כה וכדרך יום כה סביבת המחנה וכאמתים על פני הארץ
verses.english: And there went forth a wind from the LORD, and brought quails from the sea, and let [them] fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits [high] upon the face of the earth.
verses.romanian: și acolo a mers forth a wind din DOMNUL, și a adus quails din the mare, și let [them] a cădea by the tabără, as it erau a zi's călătorie on this side, și as it erau a zi's călătorie on the other side, de jur împrejur the tabără, și as it erau doi cubits [high] upon the față of the pământ.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקם העם כל היום ההוא וכל הלילה וכל היום המחרת ויאספו את השלוי הממעיט אסף עשרה חמרים וישחטו להם שחוט סביבת המחנה
