verses.english: And the people stood up all that day, and all [that] night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread [them] all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.romanian: și the popor a stat up toți că zi, și toți [că] noapte, și toți the next zi, și they gathered the quails: he că gathered least gathered zece homers: și they spread [them] toți abroad căci înșiși de jur împrejur the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הבשר עודנו בין שניהם טרם יכרת ואף יהוה חרה בעם ויך יהוה בעם מכה רבה מאד
verses.english: And while the flesh [was] yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the LORD was kindled against the people, and the LORD smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.romanian: și în timp ce the flesh [era] yet between lor teeth, ere it era chewed, the mânie of DOMNUL era kindled împotriva the popor, și DOMNUL a lovit the popor cu a foarte mare urgie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא שם המקום ההוא קברות התאוה כי שם קברו את העם המתאוים
verses.english: And he called the name of that place Kibroth-hattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.romanian: și he a chemat the name of că place Kibroth-hattaavah: pentru că acolo they buried the popor că lusted.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מקברות התאוה נסעו העם החצרות ויהיו בחצרות
verses.english: [And] the people journeyed from Kibroth-hattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.romanian: [și] the popor au călătorit din Kibroth-hattaavah lui Hazeroth; și abode at Hazeroth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותדבר מרים ואהרן במשה על אדות האשה הכשית אשר לקח כי אשה כשית לקח
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו הרק אך במשה דבר יהוה הלוא גם בנו דבר וישמע יהוה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאיש משה ענו מאד מכל האדם אשר על פני האדמה
verses.english: (Now the man Moses [was] very meek, above all the men which [were] upon the face of the earth.)
verses.romanian: (acum the om Moise [era] foarte meek, deasupra toți the oameni care [erau] upon the față of the pământ.)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה פתאם אל משה ואל אהרן ואל מרים צאו שלשתכם אל אהל מועד ויצאו שלשתם
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד יהוה בעמוד הענן ויעמד פתח האהל ויקרא אהרן ומרים ויצאו שניהם
verses.english: And the LORD came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood [in] the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a venit down in the pillar of the nor, și a stat [in] the door of the Cortul, și a chemat Aaron și Miriam: și they both a venit forth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר שמעו נא דברי אם יהיה נביאכם יהוה במראה אליו התודע ובחלום אדבר בו
verses.english: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, [I the LORD will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.romanian: și he a spus, a auzi acum meu cuvinte: dacă acolo fi a prophet între you, [I DOMNUL va a face myself known lui him in a vision, și va a vorbi lui him in a dream.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא כן עבדי משה בכל ביתי נאמן הוא
verses.english: My servant Moses [is] not so, who [is] faithful in all mine house.
verses.romanian: meu slujitor Moise [este] nu astfel, care [este] credincios in toți al meu house.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פה אל פה אדבר בו במראה ולא בחידת ותמונת יהוה יביט ומדוע לא יראתם לדבר בעבדי במשה
verses.english: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the LORD shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.romanian: cu him va I a vorbi mouth to mouth, even apparently, și nu in dark speeches; și the similitude of DOMNUL va he iată: de aceea atunci erau voi nu afraid to a vorbi împotriva meu slujitor Moise?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף יהוה בם וילך
verses.english: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.romanian: și the mânie of DOMNUL era kindled împotriva them; și he a plecat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והענן סר מעל האהל והנה מרים מצרעת כשלג ויפן אהרן אל מרים והנה מצרעת
verses.english: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam [became] leprous, [white] as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, [she was] leprous.
verses.romanian: și the nor a plecat din off the Cortul; și, iată, Miriam [became] leprous, [white] as snow: și Aaron a privit upon Miriam, și, iată, [she era] leprous.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אהרן אל משה בי אדני אל נא תשית עלינו חטאת אשר נואלנו ואשר חטאנו
verses.english: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.romanian: și Aaron i-a spus lui Moise, Alas, meu lord, I beseech te, lay nu the păcat upon us, wherein we au done foolishly, și wherein we au sinned.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל נא תהיה כמת אשר בצאתו מרחם אמו ויאכל חצי בשרו
verses.english: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.romanian: Let ei nu fi as unu dead, of pe care the flesh este half a mistuit când he cometh out of lui mamă's womb.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצעק משה אל יהוה לאמר אל נא רפא נא לה
verses.english: And Moses cried unto the LORD, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.romanian: și Moise a strigat lui DOMNUL, saying, Heal ei acum, O Dumnezeu, I beseech te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה ואביה ירק ירק בפניה הלוא תכלם שבעת ימים תסגר שבעת ימים מחוץ למחנה ואחר תאסף
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in [again].
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, dacă ei tată had dar spit in ei față, trebuie să she nu fi ashamed șapte zile? let ei fi shut out din the tabără șapte zile, și după că let ei fi received in [again].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותסגר מרים מחוץ למחנה שבעת ימים והעם לא נסעו עד האספה מרים
verses.english: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in [again].
verses.romanian: și Miriam era shut out din the tabără șapte zile: și the popor au călătorit nu till Miriam era a adus in [again].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואחר נסעו העם מחצרות ויחנו במדבר פראן ויאמר משה לבני ישראל באתם עד הר האמרי אשר יהוה אלהינו נתן לנו ראה נתן יהוה אלהיך לפניך את הארץ עלה רש כאשר דבר יהוה אלהי אבתיך לך אל תירא ואל תחת ויקרבו אל משה ויאמרו נשלחה אנשים לפנינו ויחפדו לנו את הארץ וישיבו אתנו דבר את הדרך אשר נעלה בה ואת הערים אשר נבוא עליהן וייטב הדבר בעיני משה
verses.english: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran. And Moses is saying to sons of Israel: You came until the mountain of Amorites that LORD God gave to us. See you, LORD God gave you the land. Now rise and occupy so as spoken LORD God of your fathers to you. But they were afraid and they came to Moses and they said: we shall send mortals from us and they are spying out the land for us. And when they will return they will tell us which was we should ascend there and what cities we will pass upon. And this was good in the eyes of Moses.
verses.romanian: și afterward the popor removed din Hazeroth, și pitched in the pustie of Paran. și Moise este saying to fiii lui Israel: You a venit until the munte of Amorites că LORD Dumnezeu a dat to us. a vedea you, LORD Dumnezeu a dat you the țară. acum a se ridica și occupy astfel as spoken LORD Dumnezeu of vostru părinți to you. dar they erau afraid și they a venit to Moise și they a spus: we va send mortals din us și they sunt spying out the țară căci us. și când they va return they va tell us care era we trebuie să ascend acolo și ce cetăți we va a trece upon. și this era bun in the eyes of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שלח לך אנשים ויתורו את ארץ כנען אשר אני נתן לבני ישראל איש אחד איש אחד למטה אבתיו תשלח כל נשיא בהם
verses.english: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.romanian: Send tu oameni, că they poate search the țară of Canaan, care I a da lui the copiii lui Israel: of fiecare seminție of lor părinți va voi send a om, fiecare unu a conducător între them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח אתם משה ממדבר פראן על פי יהוה כלם אנשים ראשי בני ישראל הם
verses.english: And Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men [were] heads of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moise by the poruncă of DOMNUL sent them din the pustie of Paran: toți those oameni [erau] capete of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה שמותם למטה ראובן שמוע בן זכור
verses.english: And these [were] their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.romanian: și these [erau] lor names: of the seminție of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה שמעון שפט בן חורי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה יהודה כלב בן יפנה
verses.english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה יששכר יגאל בן יוסף
verses.english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה אפרים יהושע בן נון
verses.english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה בנימים פלטי בן רפוא
verses.english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה זבולן גדיאל בן סודי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה יוסף למטה מנשה גדי בן סוסי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Joseph, [namely], of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Joseph, [namely], of the seminție of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה דן עמיאל בן גמלי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה אשר סתור בן מיכאל
verses.english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה נפתלי נחבי בן ופסי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה גד גואל בן מיכי
verses.english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה שמות האנשים אשר שלח משה לתור את הארץ ויקרא משה ליהושע בן נון יהושע
verses.english: These [are] the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the names of the oameni care Moise sent to spy out the țară. și Moise a chemat Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח אתם לתור את ארץ כנען ויאמר אליהם עלו זה בנגב ועליתם את ההר
verses.english: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this [way] southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.romanian: și Moise sent them to spy out the țară of Canaan, și a spus lui them, Get you up this [cale] southward, și a merge up into the munte:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראיתם את הארץ מה היא ואת העם הישב עליה החזק או הרפא המעט הוא אם רב
verses.english: And see the land, what it [is]; and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they [be] strong or weak, few or many;
verses.romanian: și a vedea the țară, ce it [este]; și the popor că dwelleth în el, whether they [fi] puternic sau slab, few sau many;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומה הארץ אשר הוא ישב בה הטובה היא אם רעה ומה הערים אשר הוא ישב בהן המבחנים או מבצרים
verses.english: And what the land [is] that they dwell in, whether it [be] good or bad; and what cities [they be] that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.romanian: și ce the țară [este] că they dwell in, whether it [fi] bun sau bad; și ce cetăți [they fi] că they dwell in, whether in tents, sau in puternic holds;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומה הארץ השמנה היא אם רזה היש בה עץ אם אין והתחזקתם ולקחתם מפרי הארץ והימים ימי בכורת ענבים
verses.english: And what the land [is], whether it [be] fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time [was] the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.romanian: și ce the țară [este], whether it [fi] fat sau lean, whether acolo fi lemn în el, sau nu. și fi voi of bun courage, și a aduce of the fruit of the țară. acum the time [era] the time of the firstripe grapes.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילכו ויבאו ויתורו את הארץ ממדבר צן עד רחב לבוא חמתה
verses.english: So they went up, and came and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.romanian: astfel they a mers up, și a venit și searched the țară din the pustie of Zin lui Rehob, as oameni a veni to Hamath.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעלו בנגב ויבאו עד חברון ושם אחימן ששי ותלמי ילידי ענק וחברון שבע שנים נבנתה לפני צען מצרים
verses.english: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, [were]. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.romanian: și they ascended by the south, și a venit lui Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, și Talmai, the copiii lui Anak, [erau]. (acum Hebron era built șapte ani înainte Zoan in Egypt.)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבאו עד נחל אשכול ויכרתו משם זמרה ואשכול ענבים אחד וישאו במוט בשנים ומן הרמונים ומן התאנים
verses.english: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and [they brought] of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.romanian: și they a venit lui the brook of Eshcol, și cut down din de acolo a branch cu unu cluster of grapes, și they bare it between doi upon a staff; și [they a adus] of the pomegranates, și of the figs.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למקום ההוא קראו נחל אשכול על אדות האשכול אשר כרתו משם בני ישראל
verses.english: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.romanian: The place era a chemat the brook Eshcol, pentru că of the cluster of grapes care the copiii lui Israel cut down din de acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישבו מתור את הארץ מקץ ארבעים יום
verses.english: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.romanian: și they returned din searching of the țară după patruzeci zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילכו ויבאו אל משה ואל אהרן ואל כל עדת בני ישראל אל מדבר פראן קדשה וישיבו אתם דבר ואת כל העדה ויראום את פרי הארץ
verses.english: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.romanian: și they a mers și a venit to Moise, și to Aaron, și to toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, lui the pustie of Paran, to Kadesh; și a adus back cuvânt lui them, și lui toți the obște, și shewed them the fruit of the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויספרו לו ויאמרו באנו אל הארץ אשר שלחתנו וגם זבת חלב ודבש היא וזה פריה
verses.english: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this [is] the fruit of it.
verses.romanian: și they told him, și a spus, We a venit lui the țară whither tu sentest us, și negresit it floweth cu milk și honey; și this [este] the fruit of it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אפס כי עז העם הישב בארץ והערים בצרות וגדלות מאד וגם ילידי ענק ראינו שם
verses.english: Nevertheless the people [be] strong that dwell in the land, and the cities [are] walled, [and] very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.romanian: Nevertheless the popor [fi] puternic că dwell in the țară, și the cetăți [sunt] walled, [și] foarte mare: și mai mult we a văzut the copiii lui Anak acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עמלק ישב בארץ הנגב והחתי והחוי והיבוסי והאמרי ישב בהר והכנעני ישב על הים ועל יד הירדן
verses.english: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.romanian: The Amalekites dwell in the țară of the south: și the Hittites, și the Hivites, și the Jebusites, și the Amorites, dwell in the munți: și the Canaanites dwell by the mare, și by the coast of Jordan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחס כלב את העם על משה ויאמר לו עלה נעלה וירשנו אתה כי יכל נכל לה
verses.english: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said to him, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.romanian: și Caleb stilled the popor înainte Moise, și a spus to him, Let us a merge up at once, și a stăpâni it; căci we sunt well able to overcome it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאנשים אשר עלו עמו אמרו לא נוכל לעלות אל העם כי חזק הוא ממנו
verses.english: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they [are] stronger than we.
verses.romanian: dar the oameni că a mers up cu him a spus, We fi nu able to a merge up împotriva the popor; căci they [sunt] stronger than we.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויוציאו דבת הארץ אשר תרו אתה אל בני ישראל לאמר הארץ אשר עברנו בה לתור אתה ארץ אכלת ישביה היא וכל העם אשר ראינו בתוכה אנשי מדות
verses.english: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, [is] a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it [are] men of a great stature.
verses.romanian: și they a adus up an evil report of the țară care they had searched lui the copiii lui Israel, saying, The țară, prin care we au gone to search it, [este] a țară că eateth up the inhabitants al acestuia; și toți the popor că we a văzut in it [sunt] oameni of a mare stature.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושם ראינו את הנפלים בני ענק מן הנפלים ונהיה בעינינו כחגבים וכן היינו בעיניהם וירגנו בני ישראל באהליהם ויאמרו בשנאת יהוה אתנו הוציאנו מארץ מצרים לתת אתנו ביד האמרי להשמידנו אנה אנחנו עלים ואחינו המיסו את לבבנו לאמר עם גדול ורב ממנו ערים גדלות ובצרות בשמים וגם בני ענקים ראינו שם ויאמר משה לבני ישראל לא תערצון ולא תיראון מהם יהוה אלהיכם ההלך לפניכם הוא ילחם לכם ככל אשר עשה אתכם במצרים לעיניכם ובמדבר אשר ראית אשר נשאך יהוה אלהיך כאשר ישא איש את בנו בכל הדרך אשר הלכתם עד באכם עד המקום הזה ובדבר הזה אינכם מאמנים ביהוה אלהיכם ההלך לפניכם בדרך לתור לכם מקום להחנותכם באש לילה להראותכם בדרך אשר תלכו בה ובענן יומם
verses.english: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, [which come] of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight. And they are complaining, sons of Israel, in tents of them. And they are saying: LORD hates us because he brought us out of the land of Egypt to give us in hand of the Amorites to destroy us. How we will ascend, and brothers of us and loads of us? And in their hearts they were saying: great and many they are, and the cities great and built up in heavens. And moreover sons of Nephim we saw there. And he is saying Moses to Israel: not you shall be afraid and not you shall fear them as LORD God is the one going before you. He shall fight for you as he did for you in Egypt before your eyes, and in the wilderness that you see. He will lift you up, the LORD God, as the man lifts up son of him, in all the way which you will go until you come to this place. And speaking so you are not trusting in LORD God, the one going before you. To seek out for you the place of the encampment. In fire by night to meet you in way that you go, and in the cloud by day.
verses.romanian: și acolo we a văzut the giants, the fiii lui Anak, [care a veni] of the giants: și we erau in nostru own sight as grasshoppers, și astfel we erau in lor sight. și they sunt complaining, fiii lui Israel, in tents al lor. și they sunt saying: LORD hates us pentru că he a adus us out of the țară of Egypt to a da us in mână of the Amorites to destroy us. cum we va ascend, și frați of us și loads of us? și in lor inimi they erau saying: mare și many they sunt, și the cetăți mare și built up in ceruri. și mai mult fiii lui Nephim we a văzut acolo. și he este saying Moise to Israel: nu you va fi afraid și nu you va fear them as LORD Dumnezeu este the unu going înainte you. He va a lupta căci you as he a făcut căci you in Egypt înainte vostru eyes, și in the pustie că you a vedea. He va lift you up, DOMNUL Dumnezeu, as the om lifts up son al lui, in toți the cale care you va a merge until you a veni to this place. și speaking astfel you sunt nu trusting in LORD Dumnezeu, the unu going înainte you. To a căuta out căci you the place of the encampment. In foc by noapte to meet you in cale că you a merge, și in the nor by zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותשא כל העדה ויתנו את קולם ויבך העם בלילה ההוא
verses.english: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.romanian: și toți the obște lifted up lor glas, și a strigat; și the popor a plâns că noapte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילנו על משה ועל אהרן כל בני ישראל ויאמרו אליהם כל העדה לו מתנו בארץ מצרים או במדבר הזה לו מתנו
verses.english: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.romanian: și toți the copiii lui Israel a cârtit împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron: și the întreg obște a spus lui them, ar Dumnezeu că we had a murit in the țară of Egypt! sau ar Dumnezeu we had a murit in this pustie!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמה יהוה מביא אתנו אל הארץ הזאת לנפל בחרב נשינו וטפנו יהיו לבוז הלוא טוב לנו שובה מצרימה
verses.english: And wherefore hath the LORD brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.romanian: și de aceea sunt DOMNUL a adus us lui this țară, to a cădea by the sword, că nostru wives și nostru copii trebuie să fi a prey? erau it nu better căci us to return into Egypt?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו איש אל אחיו נתן ראש ונשוב מצרימה
verses.english: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.romanian: și they a spus unu to another, Let us a face a captain, și let us return into Egypt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפל משה ואהרן על פניהם לפני כל קהל עדת בני ישראל
verses.english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: atunci Moise și Aaron a căzut on lor fețe înainte toți the adunare of the obște of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהושע בן נון וכלב בן יפנה מן האתורים את הארץ קרעו בגדיהם
verses.english: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, [which were] of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.romanian: și Iosua the son of Nun, și Caleb the son of Jephunneh, [care erau] al lor că searched the țară, rent lor clothes:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו אל כל עדת בני ישראל לאמר הארץ אשר עברנו בה לתור אתה טובה הארץ מאד מאד
verses.english: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, [is] an exceeding good land.
verses.romanian: și they a vorbit lui toți the company of the copiii lui Israel, saying, The țară, care we a trecut prin to search it, [este] an exceeding bun țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם חפץ בנו יהוה והביא אתנו אל הארץ הזאת ונתנה לנו ארץ אשר היא זבת חלב ודבש
verses.english: If the LORD delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.romanian: dacă DOMNUL delight in us, atunci he va a aduce us into this țară, și a da it us; a țară care floweth cu milk și honey.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך ביהוה אל תמרדו ואתם אל תיראו את עם הארץ כי לחמנו הם סר צלם מעליהם ויהוה אתנו אל תיראום
verses.english: Only rebel not ye against the LORD, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they [are] bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the LORD [is] with us: fear them not.
verses.romanian: numai a se răzvrăti nu voi împotriva DOMNUL, neither fear voi the popor of the țară; căci they [sunt] bread căci us: lor defence este a plecat din them, și DOMNUL [este] cu us: fear them nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו כל העדה לרגם אתם באבנים וכבוד יהוה נראה באהל מועד אל כל בני ישראל
verses.english: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the LORD appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: dar toți the obște bade piatră them cu pietre. și the slavă of DOMNUL appeared in the Cortul of the obște înainte toți the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה עד אנה ינאצני העם הזה ועד הנה לא יאמנו בי בכל האתות אשר עשיתי בקרבו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, cum long va this popor provoke me? și cum long va it fi ere they believe me, căci toți the signs care I au shewed între them?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אכנו בדבר ואורישנו ואעשה אתך ואת בית אביך לגוי גדול ועצום ממנו
verses.english: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee, and the house of your father a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.romanian: I va a lovi them cu the pestilence, și disinherit them, și va a face of te, și the house of vostru tată a greater neam și mightier than they.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל יהוה ושמעו מצרים כי העלית בכחך את העם הזה מקרבו
verses.english: And Moses said unto the LORD, Then the Egyptians shall hear [it], (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui DOMNUL, atunci the Egyptians va a auzi [it], (căci tu broughtest up this popor in tău ar putea din între them;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרו אל יושב הארץ הזאת שמעו כי אתה יהוה בקרב העם הזה אשר עין בעין נראה אתה יהוה ועננך עמד עליהם ובעמוד ענן אתה הלך לפניהם יומם ובעמוד אש לילה
verses.english: And they will tell [it] to the inhabitants of this land: [for] they have heard that thou LORD [art] among this people, that thou LORD art seen face to face, and [that] thy cloud standeth over them, and [that] thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.romanian: și they va tell [it] to the inhabitants of this țară: [căci] they au a auzit că tu LORD [art] între this popor, că tu LORD art seen față to față, și [că] tău nor standeth peste them, și [că] tu goest înainte them, by zi time in a pillar of a nor, și in a pillar of foc by noapte.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והמת את העם הזה כאיש אחד ואמרו הגוים אשר שמעו את שמעך לאמר
verses.english: Now [if] thou shalt kill [all] this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying
verses.romanian: acum [dacă] tu vei a ucide [toți] this popor as unu om, atunci the neamuri care au a auzit the fame of te va a vorbi, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבלתי יכלת יהוה להביא את העם הזה אל הארץ אשר נשבע להם וישחטם במדבר
verses.english: Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.romanian: pentru că DOMNUL era nu able to a aduce this popor into the țară care he sware lui them, de aceea he sunt ucis them in the pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה יגדל נא כח אדני כאשר דברת לאמר
verses.english: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my LORD be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying
verses.romanian: și acum, I beseech te, let the power of meu LORD fi mare, după cum tu ai spoken, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יהוה ארך אפים ורב חסד ואמת נשא עון ופשע וחטאה ונקה לו ינקה פקד עון אבות על בנים על שלישים ועל רביעים
verses.english: The LORD [is] longsuffering, and of great mercy,and of truth, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and by no means clearing [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth [generation].
verses.romanian: DOMNUL [este] longsuffering, și of mare milă,și of adevăr, forgiving iniquity și transgression și păcat, și by no means clearing [the guilty], visiting the iniquity of the părinți upon the copii lui the al treilea și al patrulea [generation].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: סלח נא לעון העם הזה כגדל חסדך וכאשר נשאת לעם הזה ממצרים ועד הנה
verses.english: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.romanian: Pardon, I beseech te, the iniquity of this popor according lui the greatness of tău milă, și as tu ai iertat this popor, din Egypt even until acum.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה סלחתי כדבריך
verses.english: And the LORD said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL a spus, I au pardoned după tău cuvânt:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואולם חי אני וימלא כבוד יהוה את כל הארץ
verses.english: But [as] truly [as] I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar [as] cu adevărat [as] I a trăi, toți the pământ va fi filled cu the slavă of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כל האנשים הראים את כבודי ואת אתותי אשר עשיתי במצרים ובמדבר וינסו אתי זה עשר פעמים ולא שמעו בקולי
verses.english: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.romanian: pentru că toți those oameni care au seen meu slavă, și meu miracles, care I a făcut in Egypt și in the pustie, și au tempted me acum these zece times, și au nu hearkened to meu glas;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם יראו את הארץ אשר נשבעתי לאבותם לתת להם וכל מנאצי לא יראוה
verses.english: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware to give unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.romanian: negresit they va nu a vedea the țară care I sware to a da lui lor părinți, neither va vreun al lor că provoked me a vedea it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבדי כלב עקב היתה רוח אחרת עמו וימלא אחרי והבאתיו אל הארץ אשר בא שמה וזרעו יירשנה
verses.english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.romanian: dar meu slujitor Caleb, pentru că he had another duh cu him, și sunt followed me fully, him va I a aduce into the țară whereinto he a mers; și lui seed va a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעמלקי והכנעני ישב בעמק מחר פנו וסעו לכם המדברה דרך ים סוף
verses.english: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.romanian: (acum the Amalekites și the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) To morrow a se întoarce you, și get you into the pustie by the cale of the Red mare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עד מתי לעדה הרעה הזאת אשר הם מלנים עלי את תלנות בני ישראל אשר הם מלנים עלי שמעתי
verses.english: How long [shall I bear with] this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.romanian: cum long [va I bear cu] this evil obște, care a cârti împotriva me? I au a auzit the murmurings of the copiii lui Israel, care they a cârti împotriva me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אמר אליהם חי אני נאם יהוה אם לא כאשר דברתם באזני כן אעשה לכם
verses.english: Say unto them, [As truly as] I live, saith the LORD, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.romanian: a spune lui them, [As cu adevărat as] I a trăi, spune DOMNUL, as voi au spoken in al meu ears, astfel va I a face to you:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: במדבר הזה יפלו פגריכם וכל פקדיכם לכל מספרכם מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה אשר הלנתם עלי
verses.english: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, which have murmured against me
verses.romanian: vostru carcases va a cădea in this pustie; și toți că erau numărat al vostru, după vostru întreg numărătoare, din douăzeci ani old și upward, care au a cârtit împotriva me

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם אתם תבאו אל הארץ אשר נשאתי את ידי לשכן אתכם בה כי אם כלב בן יפנה ויהושע בן נון
verses.english: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, [concerning] which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.romanian: Doubtless voi va nu a veni into the țară, [concerning] care I sware to a face you dwell în el, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, și Iosua the son of Nun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וטפכם אשר אמרתם לבוז יהיה והבאתי אתם וידעו את הארץ אשר מאסתם בה
verses.english: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.romanian: dar vostru little ones, care voi a spus trebuie să fi a prey, them va I a aduce in, și they va a cunoaște the țară care voi au despised.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופגריכם אתם יפלו במדבר הזה
verses.english: But [as for] you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.romanian: dar [as căci] you, vostru carcases, they va a cădea in this pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובניכם יהיו רעים במדבר ארבעים שנה ונשאו את זונתיכם עד תם פגריכם במדבר
verses.english: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.romanian: și vostru copii va wander in the pustie patruzeci ani, și bear vostru whoredoms, until vostru carcases fi wasted in the pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: במספר הימים אשר תרתם את הארץ ארבעים יום יום לשנה יום לשנה תשאו את עונתיכם ארבעים שנה וידעתם את תנואתי
verses.english: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, [even] forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, [even] forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.romanian: după the numărătoare of the zile in care voi searched the țară, [even] patruzeci zile, fiecare zi căci a an, va voi bear vostru iniquities, [even] patruzeci ani, și voi va a cunoaște meu breach of făgăduință.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אני יהוה דברתי אם לא זאת אעשה לכל העדה הרעה הזאת הנועדים עלי במדבר הזה יתמו ושם ימותו
verses.english: I the LORD have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.romanian: I DOMNUL au a spus, I va negresit a face it lui toți this evil obște, că sunt gathered together împotriva me: in this pustie they va fi a mistuit, și acolo they va a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאנשים אשר שלח משה לתור את הארץ וישבו וילנו עליו את כל העדה להוציא דבה על הארץ
verses.english: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land
verses.romanian: și the oameni, care Moise sent to search the țară, care returned, și a făcut toți the obște to a cârti împotriva him, by bringing up a slander upon the țară

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימתו האנשים מוצאי דבת הארץ רעה במגפה לפני יהוה
verses.english: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the LORD.
verses.romanian: Even those oameni că a făcut a aduce up the evil report upon the țară, a murit by the urgie înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהושע בן נון וכלב בן יפנה חיו מן האנשים ההם ההלכים לתור את הארץ
verses.english: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, [which were] of the men that went to search the land, lived [still].
verses.romanian: dar Iosua the son of Nun, și Caleb the son of Jephunneh, [care erau] of the oameni că a mers to search the țară, a trăit [still].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה את הדברים האלה אל כל בני ישראל ויתאבלו העם מאד
verses.english: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.romanian: și Moise told these sayings lui toți the copiii lui Israel: și the popor mourned greatly.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישכמו בבקר ויעלו אל ראש ההר לאמר הננו ועלינו אל המקום אשר אמר יהוה כי חטאנו ויאמר יהוה אל משה אמר להם לא תעלו ולא תלחמו כי אינני בקרבכם ולא תנגפו לפני איביכם
verses.english: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we [be here], and will go up unto the place which the LORD hath promised: for we have sinned. And the LORD God saying to Moses: speak to them that not you shall ascend and not you shall battle, as there is no me within you and you will be defeated before faces of your enemies.
verses.romanian: și they s-a ridicat up early in the dimineață, și gat them up into the top of the munte, saying, Lo, we [fi aici], și va a merge up lui the place care DOMNUL sunt făgăduit: căci we au sinned. și DOMNUL Dumnezeu saying to Moise: a vorbi to them că nu you va ascend și nu you va battle, as acolo este no me în you și you va fi defeated înainte fețe of vostru dușmani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה למה זה אתם עברים את פי יהוה והיא לא תצליח
verses.english: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? but it shall not prosper.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus, de aceea acum a face voi transgress the poruncă of DOMNUL? dar it va nu prosper.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל תעלו כי אין יהוה בקרבכם ולא תנגפו לפני איביכם
verses.english: Go not up, for the LORD [is] not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.romanian: a merge nu up, căci DOMNUL [este] nu între you; că voi fi nu smitten înainte vostru dușmani.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי העמלקי והכנעני שם לפניכם ונפלתם בחרב כי על כן שבתם מאחרי יהוה ולא יהיה יהוה עמכם
verses.english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites [are] there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the LORD, therefore the LORD will not be with you.
verses.romanian: căci the Amalekites și the Canaanites [sunt] acolo înainte you, și voi va a cădea by the sword: pentru că voi sunt s-a întors away din DOMNUL, de aceea DOMNUL va nu fi cu you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעפלו לעלות אל ראש ההר וארון ברית יהוה ומשה לא משו מקרב המחנה
verses.english: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.romanian: dar they presumed to a merge up lui the hill top: nevertheless the chivot of the legământ of DOMNUL, și Moise, a plecat nu out of the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד העמלקי והכנעני הישב בהר ההוא לקראתם וירדפו אתם כאשר תעשינה הדברים ויכום ויכתום עד חרמה וישבו אל המחנה
verses.english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, to meet them. And they are chasing them according to the words. And smote them, and discomfited them, [even] unto Hormah. And they are returning to the camp
verses.romanian: atunci the Amalekites a venit down, și the Canaanites care dwelt in că hill, to meet them. și they sunt chasing them după the cuvinte. și a lovit them, și discomfited them, [even] lui Hormah. și they sunt returning to the tabără

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי תבאו אל ארץ מושבתיכם אשר אני נתן לכם
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când voi fi a veni into the țară of vostru habitations, care I a da lui you

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשיתם אשה ליהוה עלה או זבח לפלא נדר או נדבה או במועדיכם לעשות ריח ניחח ליהוה מן הבקר או מן הצאן
verses.english: And will make an offering by fire unto the LORD, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock:
verses.romanian: și va a face an prinos by foc lui DOMNUL, a burnt prinos, sau a jertfă in performing a juruință, sau in a freewill prinos, sau in vostru solemn feasts, to a face a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL, of the cireadă, sau of the turmă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב המקריב את קרבנו ליהוה מנחה סלת עשרון בלול ברבעית ההין שמן
verses.english: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the LORD bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth [part] of an hin of oil.
verses.romanian: atunci va he că offereth lui prinos lui DOMNUL a aduce a meat prinos of a al zecelea deal of făină mingled cu the al patrulea [part] of an hin of a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויין לנסך רבעית ההין תעשה על העלה או לזבח לכבש האחד
verses.english: And the fourth [part] of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.romanian: și the al patrulea [part] of an hin of wine căci a drink prinos shalt tu prepare cu the burnt prinos sau jertfă, căci unu miel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או לאיל תעשה מנחה סלת שני עשרנים בלול בשמן שלשית ההין
verses.english: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare [for] a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third [part] of an hin of oil.
verses.romanian: sau căci a berbec, tu vei prepare [căci] a meat prinos doi al zecelea deals of făină mingled cu the al treilea [part] of an hin of a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויין לנסך שלשית ההין תקריב ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third [part] of an hin of wine, [for] a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și căci a drink prinos tu vei a aduce ca jertfă the al treilea [part] of an hin of wine, [căci] a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תעשה בן בקר עלה או זבח לפלא נדר או שלמים ליהוה
verses.english: And when thou preparest a bullock [for] a burnt offering, or [for] a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the LORD:
verses.romanian: și când tu preparest a bullock [căci] a burnt prinos, sau [căci] a jertfă in performing a juruință, sau pace prinoase lui DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריב על בן הבקר מנחה סלת שלשה עשרנים בלול בשמן חצי ההין
verses.english: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.romanian: atunci va he a aduce cu a bullock a meat prinos of trei al zecelea deals of făină mingled cu half an hin of a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויין תקריב לנסך חצי ההין אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, [for] an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a aduce căci a drink prinos half an hin of wine, [căci] an prinos a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ככה יעשה לשור האחד או לאיל האחד או לשה בכשבים או בעזים
verses.english: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.romanian: astfel va it fi done căci unu bullock, sau căci unu berbec, sau căci a miel, sau a kid.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כמספרם אשר תעשו ככה תעשו לאחד במספרם
verses.english: According to the number of them ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.romanian: după the numărătoare al lor voi va prepare, astfel va voi a face to fiecare unu după lor numărătoare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל האזרח יעשה ככה את אלה להקריב אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: toți că sunt born of the country va a face these things după this manner, in prinos an prinos a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי יגור אתכם גר או אשר בתוככם לדרתיכם ועשה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה כאשר תעשו כן יעשה
verses.english: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever [be] among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.romanian: și dacă a străin sojourn cu you, sau whosoever [fi] între you in vostru generations, și va a aduce ca jertfă an prinos a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL; as voi a face, astfel he va a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הקהל חקה אחת לכם ולגר הגר חקת עולם לדרתיכם ככם כגר יהיה לפני יהוה
verses.english: One ordinance [shall be both] for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth [with you], an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye [are], so shall the stranger be before the LORD.
verses.romanian: unu rânduială [va fi both] căci you of the obște, și de asemenea căci the străin că sojourneth [cu you], an rânduială căci ever in vostru generations: as voi [sunt], astfel va the străin fi înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: תורה אחת ומשפט אחד יהיה לכם ולגר הגר אתכם
verses.english: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.romanian: unu lege și unu manner va fi căci you, și căci the străin că sojourneth cu you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם בבאכם אל הארץ אשר אני מביא אתכם שמה
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când voi a veni into the țară whither I a aduce you

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה באכלכם מלחם הארץ תרימו תרומה ליהוה
verses.english: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: atunci it va fi, că, când voi eat of the bread of the țară, voi va a aduce ca jertfă up an heave prinos lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראשית עריסתיכם חלה תרימו תרומה כתרומת גרן כן תרימו אתה
verses.english: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough [for] an heave offering: as [ye do] the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.romanian: voi va a aduce ca jertfă up a cake of the întâi of vostru dough [căci] an heave prinos: as [voi a face] the heave prinos of the threshingfloor, astfel va voi heave it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מראשית עריסתיכם תתנו ליהוה תרומה לדרתיכם
verses.english: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the LORD an heave offering in your generations.
verses.romanian: Of the întâi of vostru dough voi va a da lui DOMNUL an heave prinos in vostru generations.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכי תשגו ולא תעשו את כל המצות האלה אשר דבר יהוה אל משה
verses.english: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the LORD hath spoken unto Moses
verses.romanian: și dacă voi au erred, și nu observed toți these porunci, care DOMNUL sunt spoken lui Moise

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את כל אשר צוה יהוה אליכם ביד משה למן היום אשר צוה יהוה והלאה לדרתיכם
verses.english: [Even] all that the LORD hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the LORD commanded [Moses], and henceforward among your generations;
verses.romanian: [Even] toți că DOMNUL sunt commanded you by the mână of Moise, din the zi că DOMNUL commanded [Moise], și henceforward între vostru generations;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אם מעיני העדה נעשתה לשגגה ועשו כל העדה פר בן בקר אחד לעלה לריח ניחח ליהוה ומנחתו ונסכו כמשפט ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת
verses.english: Then it shall be, if [ought] be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the LORD, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.romanian: atunci it va fi, dacă [ought] fi committed by ignorance fără the cunoștință of the obște, că toți the obște va a aduce ca jertfă unu young bullock căci a burnt prinos, căci a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL, cu lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos, după the manner, și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר הכהן על כל עדת בני ישראל ונסלח להם כי שגגה היא והם הביאו את קרבנם אשה ליהוה וחטאתם לפני יהוה על שגגתם
verses.english: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it [is] ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their ignorance:
verses.romanian: și the preot va a face an atonement căci toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, și it va fi iertat them; căci it [este] ignorance: și they va a aduce lor prinos, a jertfă a făcut by foc lui DOMNUL, și lor păcat prinos înainte DOMNUL, căci lor ignorance:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסלח לכל עדת בני ישראל ולגר הגר בתוכם כי לכל העם בשגגה
verses.english: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people [were] in ignorance.
verses.romanian: și it va fi iertat toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, și the străin că sojourneth între them; seeing toți the popor [erau] in ignorance.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם נפש אחת תחטא בשגגה והקריבה עז בת שנתה לחטאת
verses.english: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.romanian: și dacă vreun suflet păcat prin ignorance, atunci he va a aduce a she țap of the întâi an căci a păcat prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכפר הכהן על הנפש השגגת בחטאה בשגגה לפני יהוה לכפר עליו ונסלח לו
verses.english: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the LORD, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.romanian: și the preot va a face an atonement căci the suflet că sinneth ignorantly, când he sinneth by ignorance înainte DOMNUL, to a face an atonement căci him; și it va fi iertat him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: האזרח בבני ישראל ולגר הגר בתוכם תורה אחת יהיה לכם לעשה בשגגה
verses.english: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, [both for] him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.romanian: voi va au unu lege căci him că sinneth prin ignorance, [both căci] him că este born între the copiii lui Israel, și căci the străin că sojourneth între them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנפש אשר תעשה ביד רמה מן האזרח ומן הגר את יהוה הוא מגדף ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מקרב עמיה
verses.english: But the soul that doeth [ought] presumptuously, [whether he be] born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.romanian: dar the suflet că doeth [ought] presumptuously, [whether he fi] born in the țară, sau a străin, the same reproacheth DOMNUL; și că suflet va fi cut off din între lui popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי את דבר יהוה בזה ואת מצותיו הפר הכרת תכרת הנפש ההיא עונה בה
verses.english: Because he hath despised the word of the LORD, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity [shall be] upon him.
verses.romanian: pentru că he sunt despised the cuvânt of DOMNUL, și sunt broken lui poruncă, că suflet va utterly fi cut off; lui iniquity [va fi] upon him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו בני ישראל במדבר וימצאו איש מקשש עצים ביום השבת
verses.english: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.romanian: și în timp ce the copiii lui Israel erau in the pustie, they found a om că gathered sticks upon the sabbath zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריבו אתו המצאים אתו מקשש עצים אל משה ואל אהרן ואל כל העדה
verses.english: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.romanian: și they că found him gathering sticks a adus him lui Moise și Aaron, și lui toți the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויניחו אתו במשמר כי לא פרש מה יעשה לו
verses.english: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.romanian: și they a pune him in ward, pentru că it era nu declared ce trebuie să fi done to him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה מות יומת האיש רגמו אתו באבנים כל העדה מחוץ למחנה
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, The om va fi negresit a pune to death: toți the obște va piatră him cu pietre fără the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויוציאו אתו כל העדה אל מחוץ למחנה וירגמו אתו באבנים וימת כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și toți the obște a adus him fără the tabără, și stoned him cu pietre, și he a murit; as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם ועשו להם ציצות על כנפי בגדיהם לדרתם ונתנו על ציצית הכנף פתיל תכלת
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și bid them că they a face them fringes in the borders of lor garments throughout lor generations, și că they a pune upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו לכם לציצות וראיתם אתם וזכרתם את כל מצות יהוה ועשיתם אתם ולא תתורו אחרי לבבכם ואחרי עיניכם אשר אתם זנים אחריהם
verses.english: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the LORD, and do them; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.romanian: și it va fi lui you căci a fringe, că voi poate a privi upon it, și a-și aduce aminte toți the porunci of DOMNUL, și a face them; și că voi a căuta nu după vostru own inimă și vostru own eyes, după care voi use to a merge a whoring:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למען תזכרו ועשיתם את כל מצותי והייתם קדישים לאלהיכם
verses.english: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.romanian: că voi poate a-și aduce aminte, și a face toți meu porunci, și fi sfânt lui vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אני יהוה אלהיכם אשר הוצאתי אתכם מארץ מצרים להיות לכם לאלהים אני יהוה אלהיכם
verses.english: I [am] the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I [am] the LORD your God.
verses.romanian: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu, care a adus you out of the țară of Egypt, to fi vostru Dumnezeu: I [am] DOMNUL vostru Dumnezeu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח קרח בן יצהר בן קהת בן לוי ודתן ואבירם בני אליאב ואון בן פלת בן ראובן
verses.english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, son of Reuben, took [men]:
verses.romanian: acum Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, și Dathan și Abiram, the fiii lui Eliab, și On, the son of Peleth, son of Reuben, a luat [oameni]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקמו לפני משה ואנשים מבני ישראל חמשים ומאתים נשיאי עדה קריאי מועד אנשי שם
verses.english: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.romanian: și they s-a ridicat up înainte Moise, cu certain of the copiii lui Israel, doi sută și cincizeci căpetenii of the adunare, famous in the obște, oameni of renown:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקהלו על משה ועל אהרן ויאמרו אליהם רב לכם כי כל העדה כלם קדישים ובתוכם יהוה ומדוע תתנשאו על קהל יהוה
verses.english: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, [Ye take] too much upon you, seeing all the congregation [are] holy, every one of them, and the LORD [is] among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
verses.romanian: și they gathered înșiși together împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron, și a spus lui them, [voi a lua] too much upon you, seeing toți the obște [sunt] sfânt, fiecare unu al lor, și DOMNUL [este] între them: de aceea atunci lift voi up yourselves deasupra the obște of DOMNUL?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע משה ויפל על פניו
verses.english: And when Moses heard [it], he fell upon his face:
verses.romanian: și când Moise a auzit [it], he a căzut upon lui față:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר אל קרח ואל כל עדתו לאמר בקר ויודע יהוה את אשר לו ואת הקדוש יקריב אליו ואת אשר יבחר בו יקריב אליו
verses.english: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who [are] his, and [who is] holy; and will cause [him] to come near unto him: even [him] whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.romanian: și he a vorbit lui Korah și lui toți lui company, saying, Even to morrow DOMNUL va shew care [sunt] lui, și [care este] sfânt; și va cause [him] to a veni lângă lui him: even [him] pe care he sunt chosen va he cause to a veni lângă lui him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת עשו קחו לכם מחתות קרח וכל עדתו
verses.english: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.romanian: This a face; a lua you censers, Korah, și toți lui company;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותנו בהן אש ושימו עליהן קטרת לפני יהוה מחר והיה האיש אשר יבחר יהוה הוא הקדוש רב לכם בני לוי
verses.english: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be [that] the man whom the LORD doth choose, he [shall be] holy: [ye take] too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.romanian: și a pune foc în el, și a pune tămâie in them înainte DOMNUL to morrow: și it va fi [că] the om pe care DOMNUL doth choose, he [va fi] sfânt: [voi a lua] too much upon you, voi fiii lui Levi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל קרח שמעו נא בני לוי
verses.english: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui Korah, a auzi, I pray you, voi fiii lui Levi:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המעט מכם כי הבדיל אלהי ישראל אתכם מעדת ישראל להקריב אתכם אליו לעבד את עבדת משכן יהוה לעמד לפני העדה לשרתם
verses.english: [Seemeth it but] a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.romanian: [Seemeth it dar] a mic thing lui you, că the Dumnezeu of Israel sunt separated you din the obște of Israel, to a aduce you lângă to însuși to a face the service of the Cortul of DOMNUL, și to a sta înainte the obște to minister lui them?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקריב אתך ואת כל אחיך בני לוי אתך ובקשתם גם כהנה
verses.english: And he hath brought thee near [to him], and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.romanian: și he sunt a adus te lângă [to him], și toți tău brethren the fiii lui Levi cu te: și a căuta voi the priesthood de asemenea?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לכן אתה וכל עדתך הנועדים על יהוה ואהרן מה הוא כי תלנו עליו
verses.english: For which cause [both] thou and all thy company [are] gathered together against the LORD: and what [is] Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.romanian: căci care cause [both] tu și toți tău company [sunt] gathered together împotriva DOMNUL: și ce [este] Aaron, că voi a cârti împotriva him?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח משה לקרא לדתן ולאבירם בני אליאב ויאמרו לא נעלה
verses.english: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.romanian: și Moise sent to a chema Dathan și Abiram, the fiii lui Eliab: care a spus, We va nu a veni up:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: המעט כי העליתנו מארץ זבת חלב ודבש להמיתנו במדבר כי תשתרר עלינו גם השתרר
verses.english: [Is it] a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.romanian: [este it] a mic thing că tu ai a adus us up out of a țară că floweth cu milk și honey, to a ucide us in the pustie, except tu a face thyself altogether a căpetenie peste us?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אף לא אל ארץ זבת חלב ודבש הבאתנו ותתן לנו נחלת שדה או כרם העיני האנשים ההם תנקר לא נעלה
verses.english: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.romanian: mai mult tu ai nu a adus us into a țară că floweth cu milk și honey, sau given us moștenire of fields și vineyards: wilt tu a pune out the eyes of these oameni? we va nu a veni up.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר למשה מאד ויאמר אל יהוה אל תפן אל מנחתם לא חמוד אחד מהם נשאתי ולא הרעתי את אחד מהם
verses.english: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.romanian: și Moise era foarte wroth, și a spus lui DOMNUL, Respect nu tu lor prinos: I au nu taken unu ass din them, neither au I hurt unu al lor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל קרח אתה וכל עדתך היו לפני יהוה אתה והם ואהרן מחר
verses.english: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui Korah, fi tu și toți tău company înainte DOMNUL, tu, și they, și Aaron, to morrow:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וקחו איש מחתתו ונתתם עליהן קטרת והקרבתם לפני יהוה איש מחתתו חמשים ומאתים מחתות ואתה ואהרן איש מחתתו
verses.english: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each [of you] his censer.
verses.romanian: și a lua fiecare om lui censer, și a pune tămâie in them, și a aduce voi înainte DOMNUL fiecare om lui censer, doi sută și cincizeci censers; tu de asemenea, și Aaron, fiecare [al vostru] lui censer.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחו איש מחתתו ויתנו בהן אש וישמו עליהן קטרת ויעמדו פתח אהל מועד ומשה ואהרן
verses.english: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.romanian: și they a luat fiecare om lui censer, și a pune foc in them, și laid tămâie pe el, și a stat in the door of the Cortul of the obște cu Moise și Aaron.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקהל עליהם קרח את כל העדה אל פתח אהל מועד וירא כבוד יהוה אל כל העדה
verses.english: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.romanian: și Korah gathered toți the obște împotriva them lui the door of the Cortul of the obște: și the slavă of DOMNUL appeared lui toți the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הבדלו מתוך העדה הזאת ואכלה אתם כרגע
verses.english: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.romanian: Separate yourselves din între this obște, că I poate a mistui them in a moment.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפלו על פניהם ויאמרו אל אלהי הרוחות לכל הבשר האיש האחד יחטא ועל כל העדה תקצף
verses.english: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.romanian: și they a căzut upon lor fețe, și a spus, O Dumnezeu, the Dumnezeu of the duhuri of toți flesh, va unu om păcat, și wilt tu fi wroth cu toți the obște?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל העדה לאמר העלו מסביב למשכן קרח דתן ואבירם
verses.english: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the obște, saying, Get you up din about the Cortul of Korah, Dathan, și Abiram.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקם משה וילך אל דתן ואבירם וילכו אחריו זקני ישראל
verses.english: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.romanian: și Moise s-a ridicat up și a mers lui Dathan și Abiram; și the elders of Israel followed him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר אל העדה לאמר סורו נא מעל אהלי האנשים הרשעים האלה ואל תגעו בכל אשר להם פן תספו בכל חטאתם
verses.english: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.romanian: și he a vorbit lui the obște, saying, a pleca, I pray you, din the tents of these wicked oameni, și touch nimic of ale lor, lest voi fi a mistuit in toți lor sins.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעלו מעל משכן קרח דתן ואבירם מסביב ודתן ואבירם יצאו נצבים פתח אהליהם ונשיהם ובניהם וטפם
verses.english: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.romanian: astfel they gat up din the Cortul of Korah, Dathan, și Abiram, on fiecare side: și Dathan și Abiram a venit out, și a stat in the door of lor tents, și lor wives, și lor sons, și lor little copii.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה בזאת תדעון כי יהוה שלחני לעשות את כל המעשים האלה כי לא מלבי
verses.english: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for [I have] not [done them] of mine own mind.
verses.romanian: și Moise a spus, prin aceasta voi va a cunoaște că DOMNUL sunt sent me to a face toți these lucrări; căci [I au] nu [done them] of al meu own mind.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם כמות כל האדם ימותון אלה ופקדת כל האדם יפקד עליהם לא יהוה שלחני
verses.english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; [then] the LORD hath not sent me.
verses.romanian: dacă these oameni a muri the common death of toți oameni, sau dacă they fi visited după the visitation of toți oameni; [atunci] DOMNUL sunt nu sent me.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בריה יברא יהוה ופצתה האדמה את פיה ובלעה אתם ואת כל אשר להם וירדו חיים שאלה וידעתם כי נאצו האנשים האלה את יהוה
verses.english: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that [appertain] unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar dacă DOMNUL a face a new thing, și the pământ open ei mouth, și swallow them up, cu toți că [appertain] lui them, și they a merge down quick into the pit; atunci voi va understand că these oameni au provoked DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי ככלותו לדבר את כל הדברים האלה ותבקע האדמה אשר תחתיהם
verses.english: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that [was] under them:
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece, as he had a făcut an end of speaking toți these cuvinte, că the ground clave asunder că [era] sub them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותפתח הארץ את פיה ותבלע אתם ואת בתיהם ואת כל האדם אשר לקרח ואת כל הרכוש
verses.english: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that [appertained] unto Korah, and all [their] goods.
verses.romanian: și the pământ opened ei mouth, și swallowed them up, și lor houses, și toți the oameni că [appertained] lui Korah, și toți [lor] goods.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירדו הם וכל אשר להם חיים שאלה ותכס עליהם הארץ ויאבדו מתוך הקהל
verses.english: They, and all that [appertained] to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.romanian: They, și toți că [appertained] to them, a mers down alive into the pit, și the pământ closed upon them: și they perished din între the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל ישראל אשר סביבתיהם נסו לקולם כי אמרו פן תבלענו הארץ
verses.english: And all Israel that [were] round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up [also].
verses.romanian: și toți Israel că [erau] de jur împrejur them fled at the a striga al lor: căci they a spus, Lest the pământ swallow us up [de asemenea].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואש יצאה מאת יהוה ותאכל את חמשים ומאתים איש מקרבי הקטרת
verses.english: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.romanian: și acolo a venit out a foc din DOMNUL, și a mistuit the doi sută și cincizeci oameni că a adus ca jertfă tămâie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אמר אל אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן וירם את המחתות מבין השרפה ואת האש זרה הלאה כי קדשו
verses.english: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui Elazar the son of Aaron the preot, că he a lua up the censers out of the burning, și scatter tu the foc yonder; căci they sunt hallowed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את מחתות החטאים האלה בנפשותם ועשו אתם רקועי פחים צפואי למזבח כי הקריבום לפני יהוה ויקדשו והיו לאות לבני ישראל
verses.english: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates [for] a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: The censers of these sinners împotriva lor own suflete, let them a face them broad plates [căci] a învelitoare of the altar: căci they a adus ca jertfă them înainte DOMNUL, de aceea they sunt hallowed: și they va fi a sign lui the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן את מחתות הנחשת אשר הקריבו השרופים וירקעום צפואי למזבח
verses.english: And Eleazar son of Aaron the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad [plates for] a covering of the altar:
verses.romanian: și Elazar son of Aaron the preot a luat the brasen censers, wherewith they că erau burnt had a adus ca jertfă; și they erau a făcut broad [plates căci] a învelitoare of the altar:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זכרון לבני ישראל למען אשר לא יקרב איש זר אשר לא מזרע אהרן הוא להקטיר קטרת לפני יהוה ולא יהיה כקרח וכעדתו כאשר דבר יהוה ביד משה לו
verses.english: [To be] a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which [is] not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.romanian: [To fi] a memorial lui the copiii lui Israel, că no străin, care [este] nu of the seed of Aaron, a veni lângă to a aduce ca jertfă tămâie înainte DOMNUL; că he fi nu as Korah, și as lui company: as DOMNUL a spus to him by the mână of Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילנו כל עדת בני ישראל ממחרת על משה ועל אהרן לאמר אתם המתם את עם יהוה
verses.english: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar on the morrow toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel a cârtit împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron, saying, voi au killed the popor of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בהקהל העדה על משה ועל אהרן ויפנו אל אהל מועד והנה כסהו הענן ויראה כבוד יהוה
verses.english: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece, când the obște era gathered împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron, că they a privit toward the Cortul of the obște: și, iată, the nor covered it, și the slavă of DOMNUL appeared.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא משה ואהרן אל פני אהל מועד
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron a venit înainte the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הרמו מתוך העדה הזאת ואכלה אתם כרגע ויפלו על פניהם
verses.english: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.romanian: Get you up din între this obște, că I poate a mistui them as in a moment. și they a căzut upon lor fețe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל אהרן קח את המחתה ותן עליה אש מעל המזבח ושים קטרת והלך מהר אל העדה וכפר עליהם כי יצא הקצף מלפני יהוה החל הנגף
verses.english: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui Aaron, a lua a censer, și a pune foc în el din off the altar, și a pune on tămâie, și a merge quickly lui the obște, și a face an atonement căci them: căci acolo este mânie gone out din DOMNUL; the urgie este begun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח אהרן כאשר דבר משה וירץ אל תוך הקהל והנה החל הנגף בעם ויתן את הקטרת ויכפר על העם
verses.english: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.romanian: și Aaron a luat as Moise commanded, și ran into the mijloc of the obște; și, iată, the urgie era begun între the popor: și he a pune on tămâie, și a făcut an atonement căci the popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעמד בין המיתים ובין החיים ותעצר המגפה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל בני ישראל ויתנו אליו כל נשיאיהם מטה לנשיא אחד מטה לנשיא אחד לבית אבותם שנים עשר מטות ומטה אהרן בתוך מטותם
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויוצא משה את כל המטות מלפני יהוה אל כל בני ישראל ויראו ויקחו איש מטהו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו בני ישראל אל משה לאמר הן גוענו אבדנו כלנו אבדנו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הקרוב הקרב אל משכן יהוה יומת האם תמנו לגוע
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל אהרן אתה ובניך ובית אביך אתך תשאו את עון המקדש ואתה ובניך אתך תשאו את עון כהנתכם
