verses.english: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Aaron, tu și tău sons și tău tată's house cu te va bear the iniquity of the loc sfânt: și tu și tău sons cu te va bear the iniquity of vostru priesthood.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגם את אחיך מטה לוי שבט אביך הקריב אתך וילוו עליך וישרתוך ואתה ובניך אתך לפני אהל העדות
verses.english: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee [shall minister] before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.romanian: și tău brethren de asemenea of the seminție of Levi, the seminție of tău tată, a aduce tu cu te, că they poate fi joined lui te, și minister lui te: dar tu și tău sons cu te [va minister] înainte the Cortul of witness.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרו משמרתך ומשמרת כל האהל אך אל כלי הקדש ואל המזבח לא יקרבו ולא ימותו גם הם גם אתם
verses.english: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.romanian: și they va a păzi tău charge, și the charge of toți the Cortul: numai they va nu a veni nigh the vessels of the loc sfânt și the altar, că neither they, nor voi de asemenea, a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונלוו עליך ושמרו את משמרת אהל מועד לכל עבדת האהל וזר לא יקרב אליכם
verses.english: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.romanian: și they va fi joined lui te, și a păzi the charge of the Cortul of the obște, căci toți the service of the Cortul: și a străin va nu a veni nigh lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמרתם את משמרת הקדש ואת משמרת המזבח ולא יהיה עוד קצף על בני ישראל
verses.english: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și voi va a păzi the charge of the loc sfânt, și the charge of the altar: că acolo fi no mânie vreun mai mult upon the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואני הנה לקחתי את אחיכם הלוים מתוך בני ישראל לכם מתנה נתנים ליהוה לעבד את עבדת אהל מועד
verses.english: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you [they are] given [as] a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și I, iată, I au taken vostru brethren the leviți din între the copiii lui Israel: to you [they sunt] given [as] a gift căci DOMNUL, to a face the service of the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתה ובניך אתך תשמרו את כהנתכם לכל דבר המזבח ולמבית לפרכת ועבדתם עבדת מתנה אתן את כהנתכם והזר הקרב יומת
verses.english: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the veil; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office [unto you as] a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.romanian: de aceea tu și tău sons cu te va a păzi vostru preot's office căci fiecare thing of the altar, și în the văl; și voi va a sluji: I au given vostru preot's office [lui you as] a service of gift: și the străin că cometh nigh va fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל אהרן ואני הנה נתתי לך את משמרת תרומתי לכל קדשי בני ישראל לך נתתים למשחה ולבניך לחק עולם
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Aaron, iată, I de asemenea au given te the charge of al meu heave prinoase of toți the hallowed things of the copiii lui Israel; lui te au I given them by reason of the anointing, și to tău sons, by an rânduială căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זה יהיה לך מקדשי הקדשים מן האש כל קרבנם לכל מנחתם ולכל חטאתם ולכל אשמם אשר יאשמו לי קדש קדשים לך הוא ולבניך
verses.english: This shall be thine of the most holy things of me, [reserved] from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, with which they are guilty unto me, [shall be] most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.romanian: This va fi al tău of the preasfânt things al meu, [reserved] din the foc: fiecare oblation of ale lor, fiecare meat prinos of ale lor, și fiecare păcat prinos of ale lor, și fiecare trespass prinos of ale lor, cu care they sunt guilty lui me, [va fi] preasfânt căci te și căci tău sons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בקדש הקדשים תאכלנו כל זכר יאכל אתו קדש יהיה לך
verses.english: In the most holy [place] shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.romanian: In the preasfânt [place] shalt tu eat it; fiecare male va eat it: it va fi sfânt lui te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה לך תרומת מתנם לכל תנופת בני ישראל לך נתתים ולבניך ולבנתיך אתך לחק עולם כל טהור בביתך יאכל אתו
verses.english: And this [is] thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.romanian: și this [este] al tău; the heave prinos of lor gift, cu toți the wave prinoase of the copiii lui Israel: I au given them lui te, și to tău sons și to tău daughters cu te, by a poruncă căci ever: fiecare unu că este curat in tău house va eat of it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל חלב יצהר וכל חלב תירש ודגן ראשיתם אשר יתנו ליהוה לך נתתים
verses.english: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the LORD, them have I given thee.
verses.romanian: toți the best of the a fierbe, și toți the best of the wine, și of the wheat, the firstfruits al lor care they va a aduce ca jertfă lui DOMNUL, them au I given te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בכורי כל אשר בארצם אשר יביאו ליהוה לך יהיה כל טהור בביתך יאכלנו
verses.english: [And] whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the LORD, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat [of] it.
verses.romanian: [și] whatsoever este întâi ripe in the țară, care they va a aduce lui DOMNUL, va fi al tău; fiecare unu că este curat in al tău house va eat [of] it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל חרם בישראל לך יהיה
verses.english: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.romanian: fiecare thing devoted in Israel va fi al tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל פטר רחם לכל בשר אשר יקריבו ליהוה באדם ובבהמה יהיה לך אך פדה תפדה את בכור האדם ואת בכור הבהמה הטמאה תפדה
verses.english: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the LORD, [whether it be] of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.romanian: fiecare thing că openeth the matrix in toți flesh, care they a aduce lui DOMNUL, [whether it fi] of oameni sau beasts, va fi al tău: nevertheless the întâi-născut of om shalt tu negresit redeem, și the firstling of necurat beasts shalt tu redeem.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ופדיו מבן חדש תפדה בערכך כסף חמשת שקלים בשקל הקדש עשרים גרה הוא
verses.english: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which [is] twenty gerahs.
verses.romanian: și those că sunt to fi redeemed din a lună old shalt tu redeem, după al tău estimation, căci the money of cinci shekels, după the shekel of the loc sfânt, care [este] douăzeci gerahs.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך בכור שור או בכור כשב או בכור עז לא תפדה קדש הם את דמם תזרק על המזבח ואת חלבם תקטיר אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they [are] holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat [for] an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: dar the firstling of a vacă, sau the firstling of a oaie, sau the firstling of a țap, tu vei nu redeem; they [sunt] sfânt: tu vei sprinkle lor blood upon the altar, și shalt a arde lor fat [căci] an prinos a făcut by foc, căci a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובשרם יהיה לך כחזה התנופה וכשוק הימין לך יהיה
verses.english: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.romanian: și the flesh al lor va fi al tău, as the wave breast și as the right shoulder sunt al tău.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל תרומת הקדשים אשר ירימו בני ישראל ליהוה נתתי לך ולבניך ולבנתיך אתך לחק עולם ברית מלח עולם הוא לפני יהוה לך ולזרעך אתך
verses.english: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the LORD, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it [is] a covenant of salt for ever before the LORD unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.romanian: toți the heave prinoase of the sfânt things, care the copiii lui Israel a aduce ca jertfă lui DOMNUL, au I given te, și tău sons și tău daughters cu te, by a poruncă căci ever: it [este] a legământ of salt căci ever înainte DOMNUL lui te și to tău seed cu te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל אהרן בארצם לא תנחל וחלק לא יהיה לך בתוכם אני חלקך ונחלתך בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I [am] thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Aaron, tu vei au no moștenire in lor țară, neither shalt tu au vreun part între them: I [am] tău part și al tău moștenire între the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולבני לוי הנה נתתי כל מעשר בישראל לנחלה חלף עבדתם אשר הם עבדים את עבדת אהל מועד
verses.english: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, [even] the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și, iată, I au given the copiii lui Levi toți the al zecelea in Israel căci an moștenire, căci lor service care they a sluji, [even] the service of the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא יקרבו עוד בני ישראל אל אהל מועד לשאת חטא למות
verses.english: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.romanian: Neither trebuie the copiii lui Israel de acum înainte a veni nigh the Cortul of the obște, lest they bear păcat, și a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבד הלוי הוא את עבדת אהל מועד והם ישאו עונם חקות עולם לדרתיכם ובתוך בני ישראל לא ינחלו נחלה
verses.english: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.romanian: dar the leviți va a face the service of the Cortul of the obște, și they va bear lor iniquity: [it va fi] a poruncă căci ever throughout vostru generations, că între the copiii lui Israel they au no moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי את מעשר בני ישראל אשר ירימו ליהוה תרומה נתתיו ללוים לנחלה על כן אמרתי להם בתוך בני ישראל לא ינחלו נחלה
verses.english: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer [as] an heave offering unto the LORD, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.romanian: dar the tithes of the copiii lui Israel, care they a aduce ca jertfă [as] an heave prinos lui DOMNUL, I au given to the leviți to a moșteni: de aceea I au a spus lui them, între the copiii lui Israel they va au no moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל הלוים תדבר ואמרת אליהם כי תקחו מאת בני ישראל את המעשר אשר נתתי לכם מאתם בנחלתיכם והרמתם ממנו את תרומת יהוה מעשר מן המעשר
verses.english: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, [even] a tenth [part] of the tithe.
verses.romanian: astfel a vorbi lui the leviți, și a spune lui them, când voi a lua of the copiii lui Israel the tithes care I au given you din them căci vostru moștenire, atunci voi va a aduce ca jertfă up an heave prinos of it căci DOMNUL, [even] a al zecelea [part] of the tithe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונחשב לכם תרומתיכם כדגן מן הגרן וכמלאה מן היקב
verses.english: And [this] your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though [it were] the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.romanian: și [this] vostru heave prinos va fi reckoned lui you, as though [it erau] the corn of the threshingfloor, și as the fulness of the winepress.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כן תרימו גם אתם את תרומת יהוה מכל מעשרתיכם אשר תקחו מאת בני ישראל ונתתם ממנו את תרומת יהוה לאהרן הכהן
verses.english: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD's heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.romanian: astfel voi de asemenea va a aduce ca jertfă an heave prinos lui DOMNUL of toți vostru tithes, care voi receive of the copiii lui Israel; și voi va a da al acestuia DOMNUL's heave prinos to Aaron the preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מכל מתנתיכם תרימו את כל תרומת יהוה מכל חלבו את מקדשו ממנו
verses.english: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the LORD, of all the best thereof, [even] the hallowed part thereof out of it.
verses.romanian: Out of toți vostru gifts voi va a aduce ca jertfă fiecare heave prinos of DOMNUL, of toți the best al acestuia, [even] the hallowed part al acestuia out of it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרת אליהם בהרמכם את חלבו ממנו ונחשב ללוים כתבואת גרן וכתבואת יקב
verses.english: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.romanian: de aceea tu vei a spune lui them, când voi au heaved the best al acestuia din it, atunci it va fi a numărat lui the leviți as the increase of the threshingfloor, și as the increase of the winepress.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואכלתם אתו בכל מקום אתם ובתיכם כי שכר הוא לכם חלף עבדתכם באהל מועד
verses.english: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it [is] your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și voi va eat it in fiecare place, voi și vostru households: căci it [este] vostru reward căci vostru service in the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תשאו עליו חטא בהרמכם את חלבו ממנו ואת קדשי בני ישראל לא תחללו ולא תמותו
verses.english: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.romanian: și voi va bear no păcat by reason of it, când voi au heaved din it the best of it: neither va voi pollute the sfânt things of the copiii lui Israel, lest voi a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și lui Aaron, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זאת חקות התורה אשר צוה יהוה לאמר דבר אל בני ישראל ויקחו אליך פרה אדמה תמימה אשר אין בה מום ואשר לא עלה עליה עול
verses.english: This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein [is] no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.romanian: This [este] the rânduială of the lege care DOMNUL sunt commanded, saying, a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, că they a aduce te a red vițea fără spot, wherein [este] no blemish, și upon care never a venit yoke:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתם אתה אל אלעזר הכהן והוציא אתה אל מחוץ למחנה ושחט אתה לפניו
verses.english: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and [one] shall slay her before his face:
verses.romanian: și voi va a da ei lui Elazar the preot, că he poate a aduce ei forth fără the tabără, și [unu] va a înjunghia ei înainte lui față:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח אלעזר הכהן מדמה באצבעו והזה אל נכח פני אהל מועד מדמה שבע פעמים
verses.english: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.romanian: și Elazar the preot va a lua al ei blood cu lui finger, și sprinkle al ei blood directly înainte the Cortul of the obște șapte times:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושרף את הפרה לעיניו את עורה ואת בשרה ואת דמה על פרשה ישרף
verses.english: And [one] shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.romanian: și [unu] va a arde the vițea in lui sight; ei skin, și ei flesh, și ei blood, cu ei dung, va he a arde:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח הכהן עץ ארז ואזוב ושני תולעת והשליך אל תוך שרפת הפרה
verses.english: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast [it] into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.romanian: și the preot va a lua cedar lemn, și hyssop, și scarlet, și cast [it] into the mijloc of the burning of the vițea.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכבס בגדיו הכהן ורחץ את בשרו במים ואחר יבוא אל המחנה וטמא הכהן עד הערב
verses.english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: atunci the preot va a spăla lui clothes, și he va bathe lui flesh in apă, și afterward he va a veni into the tabără, și the preot va fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והשרף אתה יכבס בגדיו במים ורחץ את בשרו במים וטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.romanian: și he că burneth ei va a spăla lui clothes in apă, și bathe lui flesh in apă, și va fi necurat until the even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואסף איש טהור את אפר הפרה והניח מחוץ למחנה במקום טהור והיתה לעדת בני ישראל למשמרת למי נדה חטאת היא
verses.english: And a man [that is] clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay [them] up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it [is] a purification for sin.
verses.romanian: și a om [că este] curat va gather up the ashes of the vițea, și lay [them] up fără the tabără in a curat place, și it va fi a păzit căci the obște of the copiii lui Israel căci a apă of separation: it [este] a purification căci păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכבס האסף את אפר הפרה את בגדיו וטמא עד הערב והיתה לבני ישראל ולגר הגר בתוכם לחקות עולם
verses.english: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.romanian: și he că gathereth the ashes of the vițea va a spăla lui clothes, și fi necurat until the even: și it va fi lui the copiii lui Israel, și lui the străin că sojourneth între them, căci a poruncă căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הנגע במת לכל נפש אדם יטמא שבעת ימים
verses.english: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.romanian: He că toucheth the dead body of vreun om va fi necurat șapte zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והוא יתחטא בו ביום השלישי וביום השביעי וטהר ואם לא יתחטא ביום השלישי וביום השביעי לא יטהר
verses.english: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day and he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.romanian: He va purify însuși cu it on the al treilea zi, și on the al șaptelea zi și he va fi curat: dar dacă he purify nu însuși the al treilea zi, atunci the al șaptelea zi he va nu fi curat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הנגע במת בנפש אדם אשר ימות ולא יתחטא את משכן יהוה טמא ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מישראל כי מי נדה לא זרק עליו טמא יהיה עוד טמאתו בו
verses.english: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness [is] yet upon him.
verses.romanian: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of vreun om că este dead, și purifieth nu însuși, defileth the Cortul of DOMNUL; și că suflet va fi cut off din Israel: pentru că the apă of separation era nu sprinkled upon him, he va fi necurat; lui uncleanness [este] yet upon him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזאת התורה אדם כי ימות באהל כל הבא אל האהל וכל אשר באהל יטמא שבעת ימים
verses.english: And this [is] the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that [is] in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.romanian: și this [este] the lege, când a om dieth in a cort: toți că a veni into the cort, și toți că [este] in the cort, va fi necurat șapte zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל כלי פתוח אשר אין צמיד ופתיל עליו טמא הוא
verses.english: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: și fiecare open vessel, care sunt no învelitoare bound upon it, [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר יגע על פני השדה בחלל חרב או במת או בעצם אדם או בקבר יטמא שבעת ימים
verses.english: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.romanian: și whosoever toucheth unu că este ucis cu a sword in the open fields, sau a dead body, sau a bone of a om, sau a grave, va fi necurat șapte zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקחו לטמא מעפר שרפת החטאת ונתנו עליו מים חיים אל כלי
verses.english: And for an unclean [person] they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.romanian: și căci an necurat [person] they va a lua of the ashes of the burnt vițea of purification căci păcat, și running apă va fi a pune thereto in a vessel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולקח אזוב וטבל במים איש טהור והזה על האהל ועל הכלים ועל הנפשות אשר היו שם ועל הנגע בעצם או בחלל או במת או בקבר
verses.english: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip [it] in the water, and sprinkle [it] upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.romanian: și a curat person va a lua hyssop, și dip [it] in the apă, și sprinkle [it] upon the cort, și upon toți the vessels, și upon the persons că erau acolo, și upon him că touched a bone, sau unu ucis, sau unu dead, sau a grave:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והזה הטהור על הטמא ביום השלישי וביום השביעי וחטאו ביום השביעי וכבס בגדיו ורחץ במים וטהר בערב
verses.english: And the clean [person] shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.romanian: și the curat [person] va sprinkle upon the necurat on the al treilea zi, și on the al șaptelea zi: și on the al șaptelea zi he va purify însuși, și a spăla lui clothes, și bathe însuși in apă, și va fi curat at even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והאיש אשר יטמא ולא יתחטא ונכרתה הנפש ההיא מתוך הקהל כי את מקדש יהוה טמא מי נדה לא זרק עליו טמא הוא
verses.english: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he [is] unclean.
verses.romanian: dar the om că va fi necurat, și va nu purify însuși, că suflet va fi cut off din între the obște, pentru că he sunt pângărit the loc sfânt of DOMNUL: the apă of separation sunt nu been sprinkled upon him; he [este] necurat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה לכם לחקות עולם ומזה מי הנדה יכבס בגדיו והנגע במי הנדה יטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.romanian: și it va fi a perpetual poruncă lui them, că he că sprinkleth the apă of separation va a spăla lui clothes; și he că toucheth the apă of separation va fi necurat until even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל אשר יגע בו הטמא יטמא והנפש הנגעת תטמא עד הערב
verses.english: And whatsoever the unclean [person] toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth [it] shall be unclean until even.
verses.romanian: și whatsoever the necurat [person] toucheth va fi necurat; și the suflet că toucheth [it] va fi necurat until even.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבאו בני ישראל כל העדה מדבר צן בחדש הראישון וישב העם בקדש ותמת שם מרים ותקבר שם
verses.english: Then came the children of Israel, [even] the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.romanian: atunci a venit the copiii lui Israel, [even] the întreg obște, into the pustie of Zin in the întâi lună: și the popor abode in Kadesh; și Miriam a murit acolo, și era buried acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא היה מים לעדה ויקהלו על משה ועל אהרן
verses.english: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.romanian: și acolo era no apă căci the obște: și they gathered înșiși together împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירב העם עם משה ויאמרו לאמר ולוי גוענו בגוע אחינו לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
verses.romanian: și the popor chode cu Moise, și a vorbit, saying, ar Dumnezeu că we had a murit când nostru brethren a murit înainte DOMNUL!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמה הבאתם את קהל יהוה אל המדבר הזה למות שם אנחנו ובעירנו
verses.english: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.romanian: și de ce au voi a adus up the obște of DOMNUL into this pustie, că we și nostru cattle trebuie să a muri acolo?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמה העליתנו ממצרים להביא אתנו אל המקום הרע הזה לא מקום זרע תאנה גפן ורמון ומים אין לשתות
verses.english: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it [is] no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither [is] there any water to drink.
verses.romanian: și de aceea au voi a făcut us to a veni up out of Egypt, to a aduce us in lui this evil place? it [este] no place of seed, sau of figs, sau of vines, sau of pomegranates; neither [este] acolo vreun apă to drink.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא משה ואהרן מפני הקהל אל פתח אהל מועד ויפלו על פניהם וירא כבוד יהוה אליהם
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron a mers din the presence of the adunare lui the door of the Cortul of the obște, și they a căzut upon lor fețe: și the slavă of DOMNUL appeared lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח את המטה והקהל את העדה אתה ואהרן אחיך ודברתם אל הסלע לעיניהם ונתן מימיו והוצאת להם מים מן הסלע והשקית את העדה ואת בעירם
verses.english: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.romanian: a lua the rod, și gather tu the adunare together, tu, și Aaron tău frate, și a vorbi voi lui the rock înainte lor eyes; și it va a da forth lui apă, și tu vei a aduce forth to them apă out of the rock: astfel tu vei a da the obște și lor beasts drink.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה את המטה מלפני יהוה כאשר צוהו
verses.english: And Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.
verses.romanian: și Moise a luat the rod din înainte DOMNUL, as he commanded him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקהלו משה ואהרן את הקהל אל פני הסלע ויאמר להם שמעו נא המרים המן הסלע הזה נוציא לכם מים
verses.english: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.romanian: și Moise și Aaron gathered the obște together înainte the rock, și he a spus lui them, a auzi acum, voi rebels; trebuie we fetch you apă out of this rock?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירם משה את ידו ויך את הסלע במטהו פעמים ויצאו מים רבים ותשת העדה ובעירם
verses.english: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts [also].
verses.romanian: și Moise lifted up lui mână, și cu lui rod he a lovit the rock twice: și the apă a venit out abundantly, și the obște drank, și lor beasts [de asemenea].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן יען לא האמנתם בי להקדישני לעיני בני ישראל לכן לא תביאו את הקהל הזה אל הארץ אשר נתתי להם
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și Aaron, pentru că voi believed me nu, to a sfinți me in the eyes of the copiii lui Israel, de aceea voi va nu a aduce this obște into the țară care I au given them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הם מי מריבה אשר רבו בני ישראל את יהוה ויקדש בם ויאמר משה אדני יהוה אתה החלת להראות את עבדך את גדלך ואת ידך החזקה אשר מי אל בשמים ובארץ אשר יעשה כמעשיך וכגבורתיך אעברה נא ואראה את הארץ הטובה אשר בעבר הירדן ההר הטוב הזה והלבנון ויאמר יהוה אל משה רב לך אל תוסף דבר אלי עוד בדבר הזה עלה אל ראש הפסגה ושא עיניך ימה וצפונה ותימנה ומזרחה וראה בעיניך כי לא תעבר את הירדן הזה וצוי את יהושע בן נון וחזקהו ואמצהו כי הוא יעבר לפני העם הזה והוא ינחל אתם את הארץ אשר תראה וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר רב לכם סוב את ההר הזה פנו לכם צפונה ואת העם צוי לאמר אתם עברים בגבול אחיכם בני עשו הישבים בשעיר וייראו מכם ונשמרתם מאד אל תתגרו בם כי לא אתן לכם מארצם ירשה עד מדרך כף רגל כי ירשה לעשו נתתי את הר שעיר אכל תשברו מאתם בכסף ואכלתם וגם מים תכירו מאתם בכסף ושתיתם
verses.english: This [is] the water of Meribah, because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them. b) And Moses said: LORD, you began to show servant of you greatness and the strong hand. Who will do in heavens and in the earth that which you would do as deeds of you and as forces of you. Let me cross over, please, and I shall see the earth good which is across the Jordan, this good mountain and Lebanon. And the LORD said to Moses: enough of you to talk to me about this. Rise to the top of the Pisgah, and lift your eyes toward the west, and the north and the south and the east, and see you with your eyes, as not you are going to cross this Jordan. And command with Joshua son of Nun, and strengthen him and encourage him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see. And the LORD said to Moses to say: multitudes of you should turn around this mountain and face the north. And as it was commanded, say to the ones crossing over in the boundary brothers of you, sons of Esau, the ones dwelling in Seir. And they will fear you and you will be very careful as not to anger them, as I will not give you the land which he occupies, not even as much as of a foot. As to Esau I gave the mountain Seir. Purchase from them food that you need to eat, and for the water to drink you shall pay with silver.
verses.romanian: This [este] the apă of Meribah, pentru că the copiii lui Israel strove cu DOMNUL, și he era a sfințit in them. b) și Moise a spus: LORD, you began to show slujitor al vostru greatness și the puternic mână. care va a face in ceruri și in the pământ că care you ar a face as deeds al vostru și as forces al vostru. Let me cross peste, please, și I va a vedea the pământ bun care este across the Jordan, this bun munte și Lebanon. și DOMNUL a spus to Moise: enough al vostru to talk to me about this. a se ridica to the top of the Pisgah, și lift vostru eyes toward the west, și the north și the south și the east, și a vedea you cu vostru eyes, as nu you sunt going to cross this Jordan. și command cu Iosua son of Nun, și strengthen him și encourage him: căci he va a merge peste înainte this popor, și he va cause them to a moșteni the țară care tu vei a vedea. și DOMNUL a spus to Moise to a spune: multitudes al vostru trebuie să a se întoarce around this munte și față the north. și as it era commanded, a spune to the ones crossing peste in the boundary frați al vostru, fiii lui Esau, the ones dwelling in Seir. și they va fear you și you va fi foarte careful as nu to mânie them, as I va nu a da you the țară care he occupies, nu even as much as of a foot. As to Esau I a dat the munte Seir. Purchase din them food că you need to eat, și căci the apă to drink you va pay cu argint.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח משה מלאכים מקדש אל מלך אדום כה אמר אחיך ישראל אתה ידעת את כל התלאה אשר מצאתנו
verses.english: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.romanian: și Moise sent messengers din Kadesh lui the rege of Edom, astfel spune tău frate Israel, tu knowest toți the travail că sunt befallen us:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירדו אבתינו מצרימה ונשב במצרים ימים רבים ויריעו לנו המצרים ולאבתינו
verses.english: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.romanian: cum nostru părinți a mers down into Egypt, și we au dwelt in Egypt a long time; și the Egyptians vexed us, și nostru părinți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונצעק אל יהוה וישמע קולנו וישלח מלאך ויוציאנו ממצרים והנה אנחנו בקדש עיר קצה גבולך
verses.english: And when we cried unto the LORD, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we [are] in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.romanian: și când we a strigat lui DOMNUL, he a auzit nostru glas, și sent an angel, și sunt a adus us forth out of Egypt: și, iată, we [sunt] in Kadesh, a cetate in the uttermost of tău border:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נעבר נא בארצך לא נעבר בשדה ובכרם ולא נשתה מי בור דרך המלך נלך לא נסור ימין ושמאל עד אשר נעבר גבולך
verses.english: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink [of] the water of the wells: we will go by the king's [high] way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.romanian: Let us a trece, I pray te, prin tău country: we va nu a trece prin the fields, sau prin the vineyards, neither va we drink [of] the apă of the wells: we va a merge by the rege's [high] cale, we va nu a se întoarce to the right mână nor to the left, until we au a trecut tău borders.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליו אדום לא תעבר בי פן בחרב אצא לקראתך
verses.english: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.romanian: și Edom a spus lui him, tu vei nu a trece by me, lest I a veni out împotriva te cu the sword.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו אליו בני ישראל במסלה נעלה ואם ממימיך נשתה אני ומקני ונתתי מכרם רק אין דבר ברגלי אעבר
verses.english: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without [doing] any thing [else], go through on my feet.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a spus lui him, We va a merge by the high cale: și dacă I și meu cattle drink of tău apă, atunci I va pay căci it: I va numai, fără [doing] vreun thing [else], a merge prin on meu feet.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר לא תעבר ויצא אדום לקראתו בעם כבד וביד חזקה
verses.english: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.romanian: și he a spus, tu vei nu a merge prin. și Edom a venit out împotriva him cu much popor, și cu a puternic mână.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימאן אדום נתון את ישראל עבר בגבולו ויט ישראל מעליו
verses.english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.romanian: astfel Edom refused to a da Israel passage prin lui border: de aceea Israel s-a întors away din him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מקדש ויבאו בני ישראל כל העדה הר ההר
verses.english: And the children of Israel, [even] the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel, [even] the întreg obște, au călătorit din Kadesh, și a venit lui mount Hor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה ואל אהרן בהר ההר על גבול ארץ אדום לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise și Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the țară of Edom, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יאסף אהרן אל עמו כי לא יבוא אל הארץ אשר נתתי לבני ישראל על אשר מריתם את פיי למי מריבה
verses.english: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.romanian: Aaron va fi gathered lui lui popor: căci he va nu enter into the țară care I au given lui the copiii lui Israel, pentru că voi s-a răzvrătit împotriva meu cuvânt at the apă of Meribah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: קח את אהרן ואת אלעזר בנו והעל אתם הר ההר
verses.english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.romanian: a lua Aaron și Elazar lui son, și a aduce them up lui mount Hor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והפשטת את אהרן את בגדיו והלבשתם את אלעזר בנו ואהרן יאסף וימת שם
verses.english: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered [unto his people], and he shall die there.
verses.romanian: și strip Aaron of lui garments, și a pune them upon Elazar lui son: și Aaron va fi gathered [lui lui popor], și he va a muri acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה כאשר צוה יהוה ויעלהו אל הר ההר לעיני כל העדה
verses.english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.romanian: și Moise a făcut as DOMNUL commanded: și they a mers up into mount Hor in the sight of toți the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפשט משה את אהרן את בגדיו וילבש אתם את אלעזר בנו וימת אהרן שם בראש ההר וירד משה ואלעזר מן ההר
verses.english: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.romanian: și Moise stripped Aaron of lui garments, și a pune them upon Elazar lui son; și Aaron a murit acolo in the top of the mount: și Moise și Elazar a venit down din the mount.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויראו כל העדה כי גוע אהרן ויבכו את אהרן שלשים יום כל בית ישראל
verses.english: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, [even] all the house of Israel.
verses.romanian: și când toți the obște a văzut că Aaron era dead, they mourned căci Aaron treizeci zile, [even] toți the house of Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע הכנעני מלך ערד ישב הנגב כי בא ישראל דרך האתורים וילחם בישראל וישב ממנו שבי
verses.english: And [when] king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took [some] of them prisoners.
verses.romanian: și [când] rege Arad the Canaanite, care dwelt in the south, a auzit tell că Israel a venit by the cale of the spies; atunci he a luptat împotriva Israel, și a luat [some] al lor prisoners.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידר ישראל נדר ליהוה ויאמר אם נתון תתן את העם הזה בידי וחרמתי את עריהם
verses.english: And Israel vowed a vow unto the LORD, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.romanian: și Israel a făgăduit a juruință lui DOMNUL, și a spus, dacă tu wilt într-adevăr deliver this popor into meu mână, atunci I va utterly destroy lor cetăți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע יהוה בקול ישראל ויתן את הכנעני בידו ויחרם אתם ואת עריהם ויקרא שם המקום חרמה
verses.english: And the LORD hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites in his hand; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL hearkened to the glas of Israel, și delivered up the Canaanites in lui mână; și they utterly destroyed them și lor cetăți: și he a chemat the name of the place Hormah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהר ההר דרך ים סוף לסבב את ארץ אדום ותקצר נפש העם בדרך
verses.english: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.romanian: și they au călătorit din mount Hor by the cale of the Red mare, to compass the țară of Edom: și the suflet of the popor era much discouraged pentru că of the cale.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר העם באלהים ובמשה למה הוצאתנו ממצרים למות במדבר כי אין לחם ואין מים ונפשנו קצה בלחם הקלקל
verses.english: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for [there is] no bread, neither [is there any] water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.romanian: și the popor a vorbit împotriva Dumnezeu, și împotriva Moise, de aceea au voi a adus us up out of Egypt to a muri in the pustie? căci [acolo este] no bread, neither [este acolo vreun] apă; și nostru suflet loatheth this light bread.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח יהוה בעם את הנחשים השרופים וינשכו את העם וימת עם רב מישראל
verses.english: And the LORD sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL sent fiery serpents între the popor, și they bit the popor; și much popor of Israel a murit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא העם אל משה ויאמרו חטאנו כי דברנו ביהוה ובך התפלל אל יהוה ויסר מעלינו את הנחש ויתפלל משה בעד העם
verses.english: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the LORD, and against thee; pray unto the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.romanian: de aceea the popor a venit to Moise, și a spus, We au sinned, căci we au spoken împotriva DOMNUL, și împotriva te; pray lui DOMNUL, că he a lua away the serpents din us. și Moise prayed căci the popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה עשה לך שרוף ושים אתו על הנס והיה כל הנשך וראה אתו וחי
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, a face te a fiery serpent, și a așeza it upon a pole: și it va a veni to a trece, că fiecare unu că este bitten, când he looketh upon it, va a trăi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה נחש נחשת וישמהו על הנס והיה אם נשך הנחש את האיש והביט אל נחש הנחשת וחי
verses.english: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.romanian: și Moise a făcut a serpent of brass, și a pune it upon a pole, și it a venit to a trece, că dacă a serpent had bitten vreun om, când he beheld the serpent of brass, he a trăit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו בני ישראל ויחנו באבות
verses.english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a așeza forward, și pitched in Oboth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מאבות ויחנו בעיי העברים במדבר אשר על פני מואב מזרח השמש ויאמר יהוה אל משה אל תצור את מואב ואל תתגר בם כי לא אתן לך מארצו ירשה כי לבני לוט נתתי את ער ירשה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: משם נסעו ויחנו בנחל זרד וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר אתה עבר היום את גבול מואב את ער וקרבת מול בני עמון אל תצורם ואל תתגר בם כי לא אתן מארץ בני עמון לך ירשה כי לבני לוט נתתיה ירשה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מנחל זרד ויחנו בעבר ארנן אשר על המדבר היוצא מגבול האמרי כי ארנן גבול מואב בין מואב ובין האמרי
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על כן יאמר בספר מלחמות יהוה את והב בסופה ואת הנחלים ארנן
verses.english: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the LORD, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon
verses.romanian: de aceea it este a spus in the book of the wars of DOMNUL, ce he a făcut in the Red mare, și in the brooks of Arnon

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר הנחילם ואשר נטה לשבת עיר ונשען לגבול מואב
verses.english: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.romanian: și at the stream of the brooks că goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, și lieth upon the border of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומשם בארה היא הבאר אשר אמר יהוה אל משה אספה לי את העם ואתן להם מים
verses.english: And from thence [they went] to Beer: that [is] the well whereof the LORD spake unto Moses, Gather the people together to me, and I will give them water.
verses.romanian: și din de acolo [they a mers] to Beer: că [este] the well whereof DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, Gather the popor together to me, și I va a da them apă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אז ישיר ישראל את השירה הזאת עלה באר ענו לה
verses.english: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.romanian: atunci Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing voi lui it:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: באר חפרוה שרים כרואה נדיבי העם במחקק ובמשענתם ממדבר מתנה
verses.english: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by [the direction of] the lawgiver, with their staves. From the wilderness [they went] to Mattanah:
verses.romanian: The căpetenii digged the well, the nobles of the popor digged it, by [the direction of] the lawgiver, cu lor staves. din the pustie [they a mers] to Mattanah:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וממתנה נחליאל ומנחליאל במות
verses.english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.romanian: și din Mattanah to Nahaliel: și din Nahaliel to Bamoth:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומבמות הגיא אשר בשדה מואב ראש הפסגה הנשקף על פני הישמון ויאמר יהוה אל משה קומו סעו ועברו את נחל ארנן ראה נתתי בידך את סיחון מלך חשבון האמרי ואת ארצו החל רש והתגר בו מלחמה היום הזה החל תת פחדך ויראתך על פני העמים תחת כל השמים אשר ישמעו את שמעך ורגזו וחלו מפניך
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח ישראל מלאכים אל סיחון מלך האמרי דברי שלום לאמר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אעברה בארצך בדרך המלך אלך לא אסור ימין ושמאל לא אטה בשדה ובכרם אכל בכסף תשבירני ואכלתי ומים בכסף תתן לי ושתיתי רק אעברה ברגלי כאשר עשו לי בני עשו הישבים בשעיר והמואבים הישבים בער
verses.english: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites with sayings of peace, saying
verses.romanian: și Israel sent messengers lui Sihon rege of the Amorites cu sayings of pace, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא נתן סיחון את ישראל עבר בגבולו ויאמר יהוה אל משה ראה החלתי תת לפניך את סיחון ואת ארצו החל רש לרשת את ארצו ויאסף סיחון את כל עמו ויצא לקראת ישראל המדברה ויבא יחצה וילחם בישראל
verses.english: Let me pass through thy land: in way of the king I shall go and not stray right or left. We will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; food with silver we shall buy to eat, and water with silver we shall purchase from you to drink. Only allow me to cross over as they allowed us sons of Esau, the ones dwelling in Seir, and Moabites that dwell in Ar, until we cross your boundary.
verses.romanian: Let me a trece prin tău țară: in cale of the rege I va a merge și nu stray right sau left. We va nu a se întoarce into the fields, sau into the vineyards; food cu argint we va buy to eat, și apă cu argint we va purchase din you to drink. numai allow me to cross peste as they allowed us fiii lui Esau, the ones dwelling in Seir, și Moabites că dwell in Ar, until we cross vostru boundary.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכהו ישראל ואת בניו ואת כל עמו לפי חרב ויירשו את ארצו מארנן עד יבק עד בני עמון כי עז גבול בני עמון
verses.english: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border. And the LORD said to Moses: see that I begin to give you Sihon and his land, so begin to possess and live in his land. But Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.romanian: și Sihon ar nu suffer Israel to a trece prin lui border. și DOMNUL a spus to Moise: a vedea că I begin to a da you Sihon și lui țară, astfel begin to a stăpâni și a trăi in lui țară. dar Sihon gathered toți lui popor together, și a mers out împotriva Israel into the pustie: și he a venit to Jahaz, și a luptat împotriva Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח ישראל את כל הערים האלה וישב ישראל בכל ערי האמרי בחשבון ובכל בנתיה
verses.english: And Israel smote him, and sons of him, and all of his with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon [was] strong.
verses.romanian: și Israel a lovit him, și fiii lui him, și toți of lui cu the edge of the sword, și possessed lui țară din Arnon lui Jabbok, even lui the copiii lui Ammon: căci the border of the copiii lui Ammon [era] puternic.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי חשבון עיר סיחון מלך האמרי היא והוא הנלחם במלך מואב הראישון ויקח את כל ארצו מידו עד ארנן
verses.english: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.romanian: și Israel a luat toți these cetăți: și Israel dwelt in toți the cetăți of the Amorites, in Heshbon, și in toți the villages al acestuia.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על כן יאמרו המשלים באי חשבון תבנה ותתכונן עיר סיחון
verses.english: For Heshbon [was] the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.romanian: căci Heshbon [era] the cetate of Sihon the rege of the Amorites, care had a luptat împotriva the former rege of Moab, și taken toți lui țară out of lui mână, even lui Arnon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אש יצאה מחשבון להבה מקרית סיחון אכלה עד מואב בעלי במות ארנן
verses.english: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.romanian: de aceea they că a vorbi in proverbs a spune, a veni into Heshbon, let the cetate of Sihon fi built și prepared:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אוי לך מואב אבדת עם כמוש נתן בניו פלטים ובנתיו בשבי למלך האמרי סיחון
verses.english: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed Ar of Moab, [and] the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.romanian: căci acolo este a foc gone out of Heshbon, a flame din the cetate of Sihon: it sunt a mistuit Ar of Moab, [și] the lords of the high places of Arnon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונירם אבדה חשבון עד דיבון ונשים עד הנפח אש על מידבא
verses.english: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.romanian: Woe to te, Moab! tu ești undone, O popor of Chemosh: he sunt given lui sons că escaped, și lui daughters, into captivity lui Sihon rege of the Amorites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישב ישראל בערי האמרי
verses.english: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which [reacheth] unto Medeba.
verses.romanian: We au shot at them; Heshbon este perished even lui Dibon, și we au laid them waste even lui Nophah, care [reacheth] lui Medeba.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח משה לרגל את יעזיר וילכדו בנתיה ויורישו את האמרי אשר שם
verses.english: Thus Israel dwelt in the cities of the Amorites.
verses.romanian: astfel Israel dwelt in the cetăți of the Amorites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפנו ויעלו דרך הבשן ויצא עוג מלך הבשן לקראתם הוא וכל עמו למלחמה אדרעי
verses.english: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that [were] there.
verses.romanian: și Moise sent to spy out Jaazer, și they a luat the villages al acestuia, și drove out the Amorites că [erau] acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה אל תירא אתו כי בידך נתתי אתו ואת כל עמו ואת ארצו ועשית לו כאשר עשית לסיחון מלך האמרי אשר ישב בחשבון
verses.english: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at Edrei.
verses.romanian: și they s-a întors și a mers up by the cale of Bashan: și Og the rege of Bashan a mers out împotriva them, he, și toți lui popor, to the battle at Edrei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכו אתו ואת כל עמו עד בלתי השאיר לו שריד ויירשו את ארצו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, Fear him nu: căci I au delivered him into tău mână, și toți lui popor, și lui țară; și tu vei a face to him as tu didst lui Sihon rege of the Amorites, care dwelt at Heshbon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו בני ישראל ויחנו בערבת מואב מעבר לירדן יריחו
verses.english: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan [by] Jericho.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a așeza forward, și pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan [by] Jericho.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא בלק בן צפור את כל אשר עשה ישראל לאמרי
verses.english: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.romanian: și Balak the son of Zippor a văzut toți că Israel had done to the Amorites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגר מואב מפני העם מאד כי רב הוא ויקץ מואב מפני בני ישראל
verses.english: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they [were] many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și Moab era sore afraid of the popor, pentru că they [erau] many: și Moab era distressed pentru că of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר מואב אל זקני מדין עתה ילחך הקהל הזה את כל סביבתינו כלחך השור את ירק השדה ובלק בן צפור מלך למואב בעת ההיא
verses.english: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all [that are] round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor [was] king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.romanian: și Moab a spus lui the elders of Midian, acum va this company lick up toți [că sunt] de jur împrejur us, as the bou licketh up the grass of the field. și Balak the son of Zippor [era] rege of the Moabites at că time.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח מלאכים אל בלעם בן בעור פתרה אשר על הנהר ארץ בני עמון לקרא לו לאמר הן עם יצא ממצרים והנה כסה את עין הארץ והוא ישב ממולי
verses.english: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which [is] by the river of the land of the children of Moav, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.romanian: He sent messengers de aceea lui Bilam the son of Beor to Pethor, care [este] by the râu of the țară of the copiii lui Moav, to a chema him, saying, iată, acolo este a popor a veni out din Egypt: iată, they cover the față of the pământ, și they abide peste împotriva me:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה לכה נא ארה לי את העם הזה כי עצום הוא ממני אולי אוכל נכה בו ואגרשנו מן הארץ כי ידעתי את אשר תברך מברך ואת אשר תאר ויאר
verses.english: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they [are] too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, [that] we may smite them, and [that] I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest [is] blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.romanian: a veni acum de aceea, I pray te, a blestema me this popor; căci they [sunt] too mighty căci me: peradventure I va prevail, [că] we poate a lovi them, și [că] I poate drive them out of the țară: căci I wot că he pe care tu blessest [este] binecuvântat, și he pe care tu cursest este cursed.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילכו זקני מואב וזקני מדין וקסמיהם בידם ויבאו אל בלעם וידברו אליו דברי בלק
verses.english: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.romanian: și the elders of Moab și the elders of Midian a plecat cu the rewards of divination in lor mână; și they a venit lui Bilam, și a vorbit lui him the cuvinte of Balak.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם לינו פה הלילה והשבתי אתכם דבר כאשר ידבר יהוה אלי וישבו שרי מואב עם בלעם
verses.english: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.romanian: și he a spus lui them, Lodge aici this noapte, și I va a aduce you cuvânt again, as DOMNUL va a vorbi lui me: și the căpetenii of Moab abode cu Bilam.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא אלהים אל בלעם ויאמר מה האנשים האלה עמך
verses.english: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men [are] these with thee?
verses.romanian: și Dumnezeu a venit lui Bilam, și a spus, ce oameni [sunt] these cu te?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל האלהים בלק בן צפור מלך מואב שלח אלי
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הן עם יצא ממצרים ויכס את עין הארץ ועתה לכה קבה לי אתו אולי אוכל להלחם בו וגרשתיו
verses.english: Behold, [there is] a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.romanian: iată, [acolo este] a popor a veni out of Egypt, care covereth the față of the pământ: a veni acum, a blestema me them; peradventure I va fi able to overcome them, și drive them out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אלהים אל בלעם לא תלך עמהם ולא תאר את העם כי ברוך הוא
verses.english: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; and thou shalt not curse the people: for they [are] blessed.
verses.romanian: și Dumnezeu a spus lui Bilam, tu vei nu a merge cu them; și tu vei nu a blestema the popor: căci they [sunt] binecuvântat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקם בלעם בבקר ויאמר אל שרי בלק לכו אל ארצכם כי מאן יהוה לתתי להלך עמכם
verses.english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the LORD refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.romanian: și Bilam s-a ridicat up in the dimineață, și a spus lui the căpetenii of Balak, Get you into vostru țară: căci DOMNUL refuseth to a da me leave to a merge cu you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקמו שרי מואב ויבאו אל בלק ויאמרו מאן בלעם הלך עמנו
verses.english: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenii of Moab s-a ridicat up, și they a mers lui Balak, și a spus, Bilam refuseth to a veni cu us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסף עוד בלק שלח שרים רבים ונכבדים מאלה
verses.english: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.romanian: și Balak sent yet again căpetenii, mai mult, și mai mult honourable than they.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבאו אל בלעם ויאמרו לו כה אמר בלק בן צפור אל נא תמנע מהלך אלי
verses.english: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.romanian: și they a venit to Bilam, și a spus to him, astfel spune Balak the son of Zippor, Let nimic, I pray te, hinder te din coming lui me:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי כבד אכבדך מאד וכל אשר תאמר אלי אעשה ולכה נא קבה לי את העם הזה
verses.english: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.romanian: căci I va promote te lui foarte mare honour, și I va a face whatsoever tu sayest lui me: a veni de aceea, I pray te, a blestema me this popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויען בלעם ויאמר אל עבדי בלק אם יתן לי בלק מלוא ביתו כסף או זהב לא אוכל אעבר את פי יהוה אלהי לעשות קטנה או גדלה
verses.english: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a răspuns și a spus lui the slujitori of Balak, dacă Balak ar a da me lui house full of argint și aur, I nu poate a merge beyond the cuvânt of DOMNUL meu Dumnezeu, to a face less sau mai mult.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה שבו נא בזה גם אתם הלילה ואדעה מה יסף יהוה דבר עמי
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא מלאך אלהים אל בלעם לילה ויאמר לו אם לקרא לך באו האנשים קום לך אתם ואך את הדבר אשר אדבר אליך אתו תעשה
verses.english: And messenger God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, [and] go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.romanian: și messenger Dumnezeu a venit lui Bilam at noapte, și a spus lui him, dacă the oameni a veni to a chema te, a se ridica up, [și] a merge cu them; dar yet the cuvânt care I va a spune lui te, că shalt tu a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקם בלעם בבקר ויחבש את אתנו וילך עם שרי מואב
verses.english: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.romanian: și Bilam s-a ridicat up in the dimineață, și saddled lui ass, și a mers cu the căpetenii of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף יהוה כי הלך הוא ויתיצב מלאך יהוה בדרך לשטן לו והוא רכב על אתנו ושני נעריו עמו
verses.english: And LORD's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the LORD stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants [were] with him.
verses.romanian: și LORD's mânie era kindled pentru că he a mers: și the angel of DOMNUL a stat in the cale căci an adversary împotriva him. acum he era riding upon lui ass, și lui doi slujitori [erau] cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותרא האתון את מלאך יהוה נצב בדרך וחרבו שלופה בידו ותט האתון מן הדרך ותלך בשדה ויך בלעם את האתון להטותה הדרך
verses.english: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.romanian: și the ass a văzut the angel of DOMNUL standing in the cale, și lui sword drawn in lui mână: și the ass s-a întors aside out of the cale, și a mers into the field: și Bilam a lovit the ass, to a se întoarce ei into the cale.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעמד מלאך יהוה במשעל הכרמים גדר מזה וגדר מזה
verses.english: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall [being] on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.romanian: dar the angel of DOMNUL a stat in a path of the vineyards, a wall [fiind] on this side, și a wall on că side.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותרא האתון את מלאך יהוה ותלחץ אל הקיר ותלחץ את רגל בלעם אל הקיר ויסף להכותה
verses.english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.romanian: și când the ass a văzut the angel of DOMNUL, she thrust însăși lui the wall, și crushed Bilam's foot împotriva the wall: și he a lovit ei again.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסף מלאך יהוה עבר ויעמד במקום צר אשר אין דרך לנטות ימין ושמאל
verses.english: And the angel of the LORD went further, and stood in a narrow place, where [was] no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.romanian: și the angel of DOMNUL a mers further, și a stat in a narrow place, where [era] no cale to a se întoarce either to the right mână sau to the left.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותרא האתון את מלאך יהוה ותרבץ תחת בלעם ויחר אף בלעם ויך את האתון במקל
verses.english: And when the ass saw the angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.romanian: și când the ass a văzut the angel of DOMNUL, she a căzut down sub Bilam: și Bilam's mânie era kindled, și he a lovit the ass cu a staff.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויפתח יהוה את פי האתון ותאמר אל בלעם מה עשיתי לך כי הכיתני זה שלש רגלים
verses.english: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL opened the mouth of the ass, și she a spus lui Bilam, ce au I done lui te, că tu ai smitten me these trei times?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם לאתון כי התעללתי בי לו יש חרב בידי כי עתה הרגתיך
verses.english: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui the ass, pentru că tu ai mocked me: I ar acolo erau a sword in al meu mână, căci acum ar I a ucide te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותאמר האתון אל בלעם הלוא אנכי אתנך אשר רכבת עלי מהודך עד היום הזה הסכן הסכנתי לעשות לך כה ויאמר לא
verses.english: And the ass said unto Balaam, [Am] not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since [I was] thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? And he said, Nay.
verses.romanian: și the ass a spus lui Bilam, [Am] nu I al tău ass, upon care tu ai ridden ever since [I era] al tău lui this zi? era I ever wont to a face astfel lui te? și he a spus, Nay.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגל יהוה את עיני בלעם וירא את מלאך יהוה נצב בדרך וחרבו שלופה בידו ויקד וישתחוי לאפיו
verses.english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.romanian: atunci DOMNUL opened the eyes of Bilam, și he a văzut the angel of DOMNUL standing in the cale, și lui sword drawn in lui mână: și he bowed down lui cap, și a căzut flat on lui față.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליו מלאך יהוה על מה הכית את אתנך זה שלש רגלים הנה אנכי יצאתי לשטנך כי הרע דרכך לנגדי
verses.english: And the angel of the LORD said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because [thy] way is perverse before me:
verses.romanian: și the angel of DOMNUL i-a spus lui him, de aceea hast tu smitten al tău ass these trei times? iată, I a mers out to withstand te, pentru că [tău] cale este perverse înainte me:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותראני האתון ותט מלפני זה שלש רגלים אולי נטתה מפני כי עתה גם אתך הכיתי ואתה החייתי
verses.english: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had smitten thee, and saved her alive.
verses.romanian: și the ass a văzut me, și s-a întors din me these trei times: unless she had s-a întors din me, negresit acum de asemenea I had smitten te, și saved ei alive.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל מלאך יהוה חטאתי כי לא ידעתי כי אתה נצב לקראתי בדרך ועתה אם רעה בעיניך אשובה לי
verses.english: And Balaam said unto the angel of the LORD, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui the angel of DOMNUL, I au sinned; căci I a cunoscut nu că tu stoodest in the cale împotriva me: acum de aceea, dacă it displease te, I va get me back again.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר מלאך יהוה אל בלעם לך עם האנשים ואפס את הדבר אשר אדבר אליך אתו תשמר לדבר וילך בלעם עם שרי בלק
verses.english: And the angel of the LORD said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt observe and speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.romanian: și the angel of DOMNUL i-a spus lui Bilam, a merge cu the oameni: dar numai the cuvânt că I va a vorbi lui te, că tu vei observe și a vorbi. astfel Bilam a mers cu the căpetenii of Balak.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע בלק כי בא בלעם ויצא לקראתו אל עיר מואב אשר על גבול ארנן אשר בקצה הגבול
verses.english: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which [is] in the border of Arnon, which [is] in the utmost coast.
verses.romanian: și când Balak a auzit că Bilam era a veni, he a mers out to meet him lui a cetate of Moab, care [este] in the border of Arnon, care [este] in the utmost coast.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלק אל בלעם הלוא שלח שלחתי אליך לקרא לך למה לא הלכת אלי האמנם לא אוכל כבדך
verses.english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.romanian: și Balak a spus lui Bilam, a făcut I nu earnestly send lui te to a chema te? de aceea camest tu nu lui me? am I nu able într-adevăr to promote te to honour?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל בלק הנה באתי אליך עתה היוכל אוכל דבר מאומה הדבר אשר ישים אלהים בפיי אתו אשמר לדבר
verses.english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I observe and speak.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui Balak, Lo, sunt a veni lui te: au I acum vreun power at toți to a spune vreun thing? the cuvânt că Dumnezeu putteth in meu mouth, că va I observe și a vorbi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילך בלעם עם בלק ויבאהו קרית חיצות
verses.english: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjath-huzoth.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a mers cu Balak, și they a venit lui Kirjath-huzoth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויזבח בלק בקר וצאן וישלח לבלעם ולשרים אשר אתו
verses.english: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that [were] with him.
verses.romanian: și Balak a adus ca jertfă oxen și oaie, și sent to Bilam, și to the căpetenii că [erau] cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי בבקר ויקח בלק את בלעם ויעלהו במות בעל וירא משם את קצה העם
verses.english: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost [part] of the people.
verses.romanian: și it a venit to a trece on the morrow, că Balak a luat Bilam, și a adus him up into the high places of Baal, că de acolo he ar putea a vedea the utmost [part] of the popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל בלק עשה לי בזה שבעה מזבחות והכן לי בזה שבעה פרים ושבעה אילים
verses.english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui Balak, Build me aici șapte altars, și prepare me aici șapte oxen și șapte rams.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש בלק כאשר דבר בלעם ויעל בלק ובלעם פר ואיל במזבח
verses.english: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on [every] altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.romanian: și Balak a făcut as Bilam had spoken; și Balak și Bilam a adus ca jertfă on [fiecare] altar a bullock și a berbec.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל בלק התיצב על עלתיך ואלכה אולי יקרא אלהים לקראתי ודבר מה יראני והגדתי לך וילך שפי
verses.english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the God will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui Balak, a sta by tău burnt prinos, și I va a merge: peradventure the Dumnezeu va a veni to meet me: și whatsoever he sheweth me I va tell te. și he a mers to an high place.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימצא מלאך אלהים את בלעם ויאמר אליו את שבעת המזבחות ערכתי ואעלה פר ואיל במזבח
verses.english: And messenger of God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon [every] altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.romanian: și messenger of Dumnezeu met Bilam: și he a spus lui him, I au prepared șapte altars, și I au a adus ca jertfă upon [fiecare] altar a bullock și a berbec.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישם מלאך יהוה דבר בפי בלעם ויאמר שוב אל בלק וכה תדבר
verses.english: And the messenger of the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.romanian: și the messenger of DOMNUL a pune a cuvânt in Bilam's mouth, și a spus, Return lui Balak, și astfel tu vei a vorbi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישב אליו והנה נצב על עלתיו הוא וכל שרי מואב
verses.english: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.romanian: și he returned lui him, și, lo, he a stat by lui burnt jertfă, he, și toți the căpetenii of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא משלו ויאמר מארם ינחני בלק מלך מואב מהררי קדם לכה ארה לי יעקב ולכה זעמה ישראל
verses.english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, [saying], Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.romanian: și he a luat up lui parable, și a spus, Balak the rege of Moab sunt a adus me din Aram, out of the munți of the east, [saying], a veni, a blestema me Jacob, și a veni, defy Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מה אקב לא קבו אל ומה אזעם לא זעם יהוה
verses.english: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, [whom] the LORD hath not defied?
verses.romanian: cum va I a blestema, pe care Dumnezeu sunt nu cursed? sau cum va I defy, [pe care] DOMNUL sunt nu defied?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי מראש צורים אראנו ומגבעות אשורנו הן עם לבדד ישכן ובגוים לא יתחשב
verses.english: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.romanian: căci din the top of the rocks I a vedea him, și din the hills I iată him: lo, the popor va dwell alone, și va nu fi reckoned între the neamuri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מי מנה עפר יעקב ומי ספר מרבע ישראל תמות נפשי מות ישירים ותהי אחריתי כמהו
verses.english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and who can number of the four parts of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.romanian: care poate numără the dust of Jacob, și care poate numărătoare of the patru parts of Israel? Let me a muri the death of the righteous, și let meu last end fi like lui!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלק אל בלעם מה עשית לי לקב איבי לקחתיך והנה ברכת ברוך
verses.english: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed [them] altogether.
verses.romanian: și Balak a spus lui Bilam, ce hast tu done lui me? I a luat te to a blestema al meu dușmani, și, iată, tu ai binecuvântat [them] altogether.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויען ויאמר הלוא את אשר ישים יהוה בפיי אתו אשמר לדבר
verses.english: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD hath put in my mouth?
verses.romanian: și he a răspuns și a spus, trebuie I nu a lua heed to a vorbi că care DOMNUL sunt a pune in meu mouth?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליו בלק לך נא אתי אל מקום אחר תראנו משם אפס קצהו תראה וכלו לא תראה וקבנו לי משם
verses.english: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.romanian: și Balak a spus lui him, a veni, I pray te, cu me lui another place, din whence tu mayest a vedea them: tu vei a vedea dar the utmost part al lor, și shalt nu a vedea them toți: și a blestema me them din de acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחהו שדה צפים אל ראש הפסגה ויבן שבעה מזבחות ויעל פר ואיל במזבח
verses.english: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on [every] altar.
verses.romanian: și he a adus him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, și built șapte altars, și a adus ca jertfă a bullock și a berbec on [fiecare] altar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אל בלק התיצב על עלתיך ואנכי אקרא כה
verses.english: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet [the LORD] yonder.
