verses.romanian: și he a spus lui Balak, a sta aici by tău burnt prinos, în timp ce I meet [DOMNUL] yonder.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרא מלאך יהוה אל בלעם וישם דבר בפיו ויאמר שוב אל בלק וכה תדבר
verses.english: And the messenger of the LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.romanian: și the messenger of DOMNUL met Bilam, și a pune a cuvânt in lui mouth, și a spus, a merge again lui Balak, și a spune astfel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא אליו והנה נצב על עלתיו ושרי מואב אתו ויאמר אליו בלק מה דבר יהוה
verses.english: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the LORD spoken?
verses.romanian: și când he a venit to him, iată, he a stat by lui burnt prinos, și the căpetenii of Moab cu him. și Balak a spus lui him, ce sunt DOMNUL spoken?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא משלו ויאמר קום בלק ושמעה האזינה עדי בנו צפור
verses.english: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.romanian: și he a luat up lui parable, și a spus, a se ridica up, Balak, și a auzi; hearken lui me, tu son of Zippor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא איש אל ויכזב ובן אדם ויתנחם ההוא אמר ולא יעשה דבר ולא יקימנה
verses.english: God [is] not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do [it]? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.romanian: Dumnezeu [este] nu a om, că he trebuie să lie; neither the son of om, că he trebuie să repent: sunt he a spus, și va he nu a face [it]? sau sunt he spoken, și va he nu a face it bun?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הן לברך לקחתי אברך ולא אשיבנה
verses.english: Behold, I have received [commandment] to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.romanian: iată, I au received [poruncă] to a binecuvânta: și he sunt binecuvântat; și I nu poate reverse it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא אביט און ביעקב ולא ראה עמל בישראל יהוה אלהיו עמו ותרועת מלך בו
verses.english: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the LORD his God [is] with him, and the shout of a king [is] among them.
verses.romanian: He sunt nu beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither sunt he seen perverseness in Israel: DOMNUL lui Dumnezeu [este] cu him, și the shout of a rege [este] între them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל מוציאם ממצרים כתועפת ראם לו
verses.english: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.romanian: Dumnezeu a adus them out of Egypt; he sunt as it erau the strength of an unicorn.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא נחש ביעקב ולא קסם בישראל כעת יאמר ליעקב ולישראל מה פעל אל
verses.english: Surely [there is] no enchantment against Jacob, neither [is there] any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.romanian: negresit [acolo este] no enchantment împotriva Jacob, neither [este acolo] vreun divination împotriva Israel: după this time it va fi a spus of Jacob și of Israel, ce sunt Dumnezeu wrought!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הן עם כלביה יקום וכאריה יתנשא לא ישכב עד יאכל טרף ודם חללים ישתה
verses.english: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat [of] the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.romanian: iată, the popor va a se ridica up as a mare lion, și lift up însuși as a young lion: he va nu lie down until he eat [of] the prey, și drink the blood of the ucis.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלק אל בלעם גם קב לא תקבנו וגם ברוך לא תברכנו
verses.english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.romanian: și Balak a spus lui Bilam, Neither a blestema them at toți, nor a binecuvânta them at toți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויען בלעם ויאמר אל בלק הלוא דברתי אליך לאמר כל הדבר אשר ידבר האלהים אתו אעשה
verses.english: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the LORD speaketh, that I must do?
verses.romanian: dar Bilam a răspuns și a spus lui Balak, Told nu I te, saying, toți că DOMNUL speaketh, că I trebuie a face?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלק אל בלעם לך נא אקחך אל מקום אחר אולי יישר בעיני האלהים וקבתו לי משם
verses.english: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.romanian: și Balak a spus lui Bilam, a veni, I pray te, I va a aduce te lui another place; peradventure it va please Dumnezeu că tu mayest a blestema me them din de acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח בלק את בלעם ראש הפעור הנשקף על פני הישמון
verses.english: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.romanian: și Balak a adus Bilam lui the top of Peor, că looketh toward Jeshimon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל בלק בנה לי בזה שבעה מזבחות והכן לי בזה שבעה פרים ושבעה אילים
verses.english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui Balak, Build me aici șapte altars, și prepare me aici șapte bullocks și șapte rams.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש בלק כאשר דבר בלעם ויעל פר ואיל על המזבח
verses.english: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken, and offered a bullock and a ram on [every] altar.
verses.romanian: și Balak a făcut as Bilam had spoken, și a adus ca jertfă a bullock și a berbec on [fiecare] altar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא בלעם כי טוב בעיני יהוה לברך את ישראל ולא הלך כפעם בפעם לקראת הנחשים וישת אל המדבר פניו
verses.english: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.romanian: și când Bilam a văzut că it pleased DOMNUL to a binecuvânta Israel, he a mers nu, as at other times, to a căuta căci enchantments, dar he a așeza lui față toward the pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא בלעם את עיניו וירא את ישראל שכן לשבטיו ותהי עליו רוח אלהים
verses.english: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding [in his tents] according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.romanian: și Bilam lifted up lui eyes, și he a văzut Israel abiding [in lui tents] după lor seminții; și the duh of Dumnezeu a venit upon him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא משלו ויאמר נאם בלעם בנו בעור ונאם הגבר שתם העין
verses.english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.romanian: și he a luat up lui parable, și a spus, Bilam the son of Beor sunt a spus, și the om al cărui eyes sunt open sunt a spus:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר מחזה שדה יחזה נפל וגלוי עין
verses.english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling [into a trance], but having his eye open:
verses.romanian: He sunt a spus, care a auzit the cuvinte of Dumnezeu, care a văzut the vision of the Almighty, falling [into a trance], dar having lui eye open:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מה טבו אהליך יעקב ומשכנתיך ישראל
verses.english: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, [and] thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.romanian: cum goodly sunt tău tents, O Jacob, [și] tău tabernacles, O Israel!

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כנחלים נטוי כגנות עלי נהר כאהלים נטה יהוה כארזים עלי מים
verses.english: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the LORD hath planted, [and] as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.romanian: As the valleys sunt they spread forth, as gardens by the râu's side, as the trees of lign aloes care DOMNUL sunt planted, [și] as cedar trees beside the ape.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יזל מים מדליו וזרעו במים רבים וירם מגוג מלכו ותתנשא מלכותו
verses.english: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed [shall be] in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.romanian: He va pour the apă out of lui buckets, și lui seed [va fi] in many ape, și lui rege va fi higher than Agag, și lui kingdom va fi exalted.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אל נחהו ממצרים כתועפת ראם לו יאכל גוים צריו ועצמתיהם יגרם וחציו ימחץ
verses.english: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce [them] through with his arrows.
verses.romanian: Dumnezeu a adus him forth out of Egypt; he sunt as it erau the strength of an unicorn: he va eat up the neamuri lui dușmani, și va break lor bones, și pierce [them] prin cu lui arrows.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כרע שכב כאריה וכלביה מי יקימנו מברכיך ברוך וארריך ארור
verses.english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed [is] he that blesseth thee, and cursed [is] he that curseth thee.
verses.romanian: He couched, he lay down as a lion, și as a mare lion: care va stir him up? binecuvântat [este] he că blesseth te, și cursed [este] he că curseth te.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף בלק אל בלעם ויספק את כפיו ויאמר בלק אל בלעם לקב איבי קראתי לך והנה ברכת ברוך זה שלש רגלים
verses.english: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed [them] these three times.
verses.romanian: și Balak's mânie era kindled împotriva Bilam, și he a lovit lui mâini together: și Balak a spus lui Bilam, I a chemat te to a blestema al meu dușmani, și, iată, tu ai altogether binecuvântat [them] these trei times.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה ברח לך אל מקומך אמרתי כבד אכבדך והנה מנעך יהוה מכבוד
verses.english: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the LORD hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.romanian: de aceea acum flee tu to tău place: I thought to promote te lui mare honour; dar, lo, DOMNUL sunt a păzit te back din honour.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר בלעם אל בלק הלוא גם אל מלאכיך אשר שלחת אלי דברתי לאמר
verses.english: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying
verses.romanian: și Bilam a spus lui Balak, a vorbit I nu de asemenea to tău messengers care tu sentest lui me, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם יתן לי בלק מלוא ביתו כסף או זהב לא אוכל לעבר את פי יהוה לעשות טובה או רעה מלבי אשר ידבר יהוה אלי אתו אדברה
verses.english: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the LORD, to do [either] good or bad of mine own mind; [but] what the LORD saith to me, that will I speak?
verses.romanian: dacă Balak ar a da me lui house full of argint și aur, I nu poate a merge beyond the poruncă of DOMNUL, to a face [either] bun sau bad of al meu own mind; [dar] ce DOMNUL spune to me, că va I a vorbi?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה הנני הלך לעמי לך ואעיצך את אשר יעשה העם הזה לעמך באחרית הימים
verses.english: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come [therefore, and] I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.romanian: și acum, iată, I a merge lui meu popor: a veni [de aceea, și] I va advertise te ce this popor va a face to tău popor in the latter zile.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא משלו ויאמר נאם בלעם בנו בעור ונאם הגבר שתם העין
verses.english: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.romanian: și he a luat up lui parable, și a spus, Bilam the son of Beor sunt a spus, și the om al cărui eyes sunt open sunt a spus:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נאם שמע אמרי אל וידע דעת עליון מחזה שדה יחזה נפל וגלוי עינים
verses.english: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, [which] saw the vision of the Almighty, falling [into a trance], but having his eyes open:
verses.romanian: He sunt a spus, care a auzit the cuvinte of Dumnezeu, și a cunoscut the cunoștință of the cel mai High, [care] a văzut the vision of the Almighty, falling [into a trance], dar having lui eyes open:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אראנו ולא עתה אשורנו ולא קרוב דרך כוכב מיעקב וקם שבט מישראל מחץ פתי מואב וקדקד כל בני שת
verses.english: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.romanian: I va a vedea him, dar nu acum: I va iată him, dar nu nigh: acolo va a veni a Star out of Jacob, și a Sceptre va a se ridica out of Israel, și va a lovi the corners of Moab, și destroy toți the copiii lui Sheth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה אדום ירשה והיה ירשה עשו איביו וישראל עשה חיל
verses.english: And Edom shall be a possession, Esau also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.romanian: și Edom va fi a moștenire, Esau de asemenea va fi a moștenire căci lui dușmani; și Israel va a face valiantly.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד מיעקב והאביד שריד מעיר
verses.english: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.romanian: Out of Jacob va a veni he că va au dominion, și va destroy him că remaineth of the cetate.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא את עמלק וישא משלו ויאמר ראשית גוים עמלק ואחריתו עד יאבד
verses.english: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek [was] the first of the nations; but his latter end [shall be] that he perish for ever.
verses.romanian: și când he a privit on Amalek, he a luat up lui parable, și a spus, Amalek [era] the întâi of the neamuri; dar lui latter end [va fi] că he perish căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא את הקיני וישא משלו ויאמר איתן מושבך ושים בסלע קנך
verses.english: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.romanian: și he a privit on the Kenites, și a luat up lui parable, și a spus, puternic este tău dwellingplace, și tu puttest tău nest in a rock.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אם יהיה לבער קין עד מאשור תושבך
verses.english: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.romanian: Nevertheless the Kenite va fi wasted, until Asshur va carry te away captive.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישא משלו ויאמר אוי מי יהיה משמו אל יוציאם מיד כתים
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יענו אשור ויענו עבר וגם הוא עד יאבד
verses.english: And ships [shall come] from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.romanian: și ships [va a veni] din the coast of Chittim, și va afflict Asshur, și va afflict Eber, și he de asemenea va perish căci ever.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקם בלעם וילך וישב למקומו וגם בלק הלך לדרכו
verses.english: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.romanian: și Bilam s-a ridicat up, și a mers și returned to lui place: și Balak de asemenea a mers lui cale.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישב ישראל בשטים ויחל העם לזנות אל בנות מואב
verses.english: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.romanian: și Israel abode in Shittim, și the popor began to commit curvie cu the fiicele lui Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקראנה לעם לזבחי אלהיהן ויאכל העם וישתחוי לאלהיהן
verses.english: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.romanian: și they a chemat the popor lui the jertfe of lor gods: și the popor a făcut eat, și bowed down to lor gods.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצמד מבני ישראל לבעל פעור ויחר אף יהוה בישראל
verses.english: And some sons of Israel joined themselves unto Baal-peor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
verses.romanian: și some fiii lui Israel joined înșiși lui Baal-peor: și the mânie of DOMNUL era kindled împotriva Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה אמר ויהרגו את האנשים הנצמדים לבעל פעור וישוב חרון אף יהוה מישראל
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses saying, Let them kill all mortals who joined themselves to Baal-peor, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise saying, Let them a ucide toți mortals care joined înșiși to Baal-peor, că the fierce mânie of DOMNUL poate fi s-a întors away din Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל שפטי ישראל הרגו איש את אנשיו הנצמדים לבעל פעור
verses.english: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baal-peor.
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui the judges of Israel, a înjunghia voi fiecare unu lui oameni că erau joined lui Baal-peor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנה איש מבני ישראל בא ויקרב אל אחיו את המדינית לעיני משה ולעיני כל עדת בני ישראל והם בכים פתח אהל מועד
verses.english: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who [were] weeping [before] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.romanian: și, iată, unu of the copiii lui Israel a venit și a adus lui lui brethren a Midianitish femeie in the sight of Moise, și in the sight of toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, care [erau] weeping [înainte] the door of the Cortul of the obște.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירא פינחס בן אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן ויקם מתוך העדה ויקח רמח בידו
verses.english: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw [it], he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.romanian: și când Pinhas, the son of Elazar, the son of Aaron the preot, a văzut [it], he s-a ridicat up din între the obște, și a luat a javelin in lui mână;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבא אחרי איש ישראל אל הקבה וידקר את שניהם את איש ישראל ואת האשה על קבתה ותעצר המגפה מעל בני ישראל
verses.english: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și he a mers după the om of Israel into the cort, și thrust both al lor prin, the om of Israel, și the femeie prin ei belly. astfel the urgie era stayed din the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו המיתים במגפה ארבעה ועשרים אלף
verses.english: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.romanian: și those că a murit in the urgie erau douăzeci și patru mie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: פינחס בן אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן השיב את חמתי מעל בני ישראל בקנאו את קנאתי בתוכם ולא כליתי את בני ישראל בקנאתי
verses.english: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.romanian: Pinhas, the son of Elazar, the son of Aaron the preot, sunt s-a întors meu mânie away din the copiii lui Israel, în timp ce he era zealous căci meu sake între them, că I a mistuit nu the copiii lui Israel in meu jealousy.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לכן אמר הנני נתן לו את בריתי שלום
verses.english: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.romanian: de aceea a spune, iată, I a da lui him meu legământ of pace:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיתה לו ולזרעו אחריו ברית כהנת עולם תחת אשר קנא לאלהיו ויכפר על בני ישראל
verses.english: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, [even] the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și he va au it, și lui seed după him, [even] the legământ of an everlasting priesthood; pentru că he era zealous căci lui Dumnezeu, și a făcut an atonement căci the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושם האיש ישראל המכה אשר הכה את המדינית זמרי בן סלוא נשיא בית אב לשמעוני
verses.english: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, [even] that was slain with the Midianitish woman, [was] Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.romanian: acum the name of the Israelite că era ucis, [even] că era ucis cu the Midianitish femeie, [era] Zimri, the son of Salu, a căpetenie of a căpetenie house între the Simeonites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושם האשה המכה המדינית כזבית בת צור ראש אמת בית אב במדין הוא
verses.english: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain [was] Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he [was] head over a people, [and] of a chief house in Midian.
verses.romanian: și the name of the Midianitish femeie că era ucis [era] Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he [era] cap peste a popor, [și] of a căpetenie house in Midian.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צררו את המדינים והכיתם אתם
verses.english: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.romanian: Vex the Midianites, și a lovi them:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי צררים הם לכם בנכליהם אשר נכלו לכם על דבר פעור ועל דבר כזבי בת נשיא מדין אחותם המכה ביום המגפה על דבר פעור
verses.english: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.romanian: căci they vex you cu lor wiles, wherewith they au beguiled you in the matter of Peor, și in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a căpetenie of Midian, lor soră, care era ucis in the zi of the urgie căci Peor's sake.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי אחר המגפה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה ואל אלעזר בן אהרן הכהן לאמר
verses.english: That the LORD said unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying
verses.romanian: că DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise și lui Elazar the son of Aaron the preot, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שאו את ראש כל עדת בני ישראל מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה לבית אבותם כל יצא צבא בישראל
verses.english: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.romanian: a lua the sum of toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel, din douăzeci ani old și upward, throughout lor părinți' house, toți că sunt able to a merge to război in Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה ואלעזר הכהן אתם בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו לאמר
verses.english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying
verses.romanian: și Moise și Elazar the preot a vorbit cu them in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה ובני ישראל היוצאים מארץ מצרים
verses.english: [Take the sum of the people], from twenty years old and upward; as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.romanian: [a lua the sum of the popor], din douăzeci ani old și upward; as DOMNUL commanded Moise și the copiii lui Israel, care a mers forth out of the țară of Egypt.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ראובן בכור ישראל ובני ראובן חנוך משפחת החנוכי לפלוא משפחת הפלואי
verses.english: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, [of whom cometh] the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.romanian: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the copiii lui Reuben; Hanoch, [of pe care cometh] the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לחצרון משפחת החצרוני לכרמי משפחת הכרמי
verses.english: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.romanian: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות הראובני ויהיו פקדיהם שלשה וארבעים אלף ושבע מאות ושלשים
verses.english: These [are] the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the Reubenites: și they că erau numărat al lor erau patruzeci și trei mie și șapte sută și treizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני פלוא אליאב
verses.english: The sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.romanian: The fiii lui Pallu; Eliab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני אליאב נמואל דתן ואבירם הוא דתן ואבירם קריאי העדה אשר הועדו על משה ועל אהרן בעדת קרח בהועדתם על יהוה
verses.english: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. This [is that] Dathan and Abiram, [which were] famous in the congregation, who advanced against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they congregated against the LORD:
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Eliab; Nemuel, Dathan, și Abiram. This [este că] Dathan și Abiram, [care erau] famous in the obște, care advanced împotriva Moise și împotriva Aaron in the company of Korah, când they congregated împotriva DOMNUL:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותפתח הארץ את פיה ותבלע אתם הארץ במות העדה באכל האש את קרח ואת חמשים ומאתים איש ויהיו לנוס
verses.english: And the earth opened her mouth, and the earth swallowed them up together with Korah, and when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.romanian: și the pământ opened ei mouth, și the pământ swallowed them up together cu Korah, și când că company a murit, ce time the foc devoured doi sută și cincizeci oameni: și they became a sign.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני קרח לא מתו
verses.english: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding the copiii lui Korah a murit nu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני שמעון למשפחות השמעוני לנמואל משפחת הנמואלי לימין משפחת הימיני ליכין משפחת היכיני
verses.english: The sons of Simeon the familiy of Simeonites: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
verses.romanian: The fiii lui Simeon the familiy of Simeonites: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לזרח משפחת הזרחי לשאול משפחת השאולי
verses.english: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.romanian: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות השמעוני שנים ועשרים אלף ומאתים
verses.english: These [are] the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the Simeonites, douăzeci și doi mie și doi sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני גד למשפחותם לצפון משפחת הצפוני לחגי משפחת החגי לשוני משפחת השוני
verses.english: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
verses.romanian: The copiii lui Gad după lor families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לאזני משפחת האזני לעדי משפחת העדי
verses.english: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Edi, the family of the Edites:
verses.romanian: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Edi, the family of the Edites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לארודי משפחת הארודי לארולי משפחת הארולי
verses.english: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.romanian: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות גד לפקדיהם ארבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the copiii lui Gad după those că erau numărat al lor, patruzeci mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני יהודה ער ואונן וימת ער ואונן בארץ כנען
verses.english: The sons of Judah [were] Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.romanian: The fiii lui Judah [erau] Er și Onan: și Er și Onan a murit in the țară of Canaan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו בני יהודה למשפחותם לשלה משפחת השלני לפרץ משפחת הפריצי לזרח משפחת הזרחי
verses.english: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Judah după lor families erau; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו בני פרץ לחצרון משפחת החצרוני לחמואל משפחת החמואלי
verses.english: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.romanian: și the fiii lui Pharez erau; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות יהודה לפקדיהם ששה ושבעים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of Judah după those că erau numărat al lor, threescore și sixteen mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני יששכר למשפחותם לתולע משפחת התולעי לפואה משפחת הפואי
verses.english: [Of] the sons of Issachar after their families: [of] Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
verses.romanian: [Of] the fiii lui Issachar după lor families: [of] Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לישוב משפחת הישובי לשמרון משפחת השמרוני
verses.english: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.romanian: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות יששכר לפקדיהם ארבעה וששים אלף ושלש מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of Issachar după those că erau numărat al lor, threescore și patru mie și trei sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני זבולן למשפחותם לסרד משפחת הסרדי לאלון משפחת האלוני ליחלאל משפחת היחלאלי
verses.english: [Of] the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.romanian: [Of] the fiii lui Zebulun după lor families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות זבולן לפקדיהם ששים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the Zebulunites după those că erau numărat al lor, threescore mie și cinci sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני יוסף למשפחותם מנשה ואפרים
verses.english: The sons of Joseph after their families [were] Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.romanian: The fiii lui Joseph după lor families [erau] Manasseh și Ephraim.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני מנשה למכיר משפחת המכירי ומכיר הוליד את גלעד משפחת הגלעדי
verses.english: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead [come] the family of the Gileadites.
verses.romanian: Of the fiii lui Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: și Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead [a veni] the family of the Gileadites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה בני גלעד איעזר משפחת האיעזרי וחלק משפחת החלקי
verses.english: These [are] the sons of Gilead: [of] Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the fiii lui Gilead: [of] Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשרואל משפחת האשרואלי ושכם משפחת השכמי
verses.english: And [of] Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and [of] Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
verses.romanian: și [of] Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: și [of] Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמידע משפחת השמידעי וחפר משפחת החפרי
verses.english: And [of] Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and [of] Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.romanian: și [of] Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: și [of] Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וצלפחד בן חפר לא היה לו בנים כי אם בנות ושם בנות צלפחד מחלה ונעה חגלה מלכה ותרצה
verses.english: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad [were] Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.romanian: și Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, dar daughters: și the names of the fiicele lui Zelophehad [erau] Mahlah, și Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, și Tirzah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות מנשה לפקדיהם שנים וחמשים אלף ושבע מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of Manasseh, și those că erau numărat al lor, cincizeci și doi mie și șapte sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה בני אפרים למשפחותם לשותלח משפחת השותלחי לבכר משפחת הבכרי לתחם משפחת התחמי
verses.english: And these [are] the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Taham, the family of the Tahamites.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the fiii lui Ephraim după lor families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Taham, the family of the Tahamites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה בני שותלח לעדן משפחת העדני
verses.english: These [are] the sons of Shuthelah: of Edan, the family of the Edanites.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the fiii lui Shuthelah: of Edan, the family of the Edanites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות בני אפרים לפקדיהם שנים ושלשים אלף וחמש מאות אלה בני יוסף למשפחותם
verses.english: These [are] the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These [are] the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the fiii lui Ephraim după those că erau numărat al lor, treizeci și doi mie și cinci sută. These [sunt] the fiii lui Joseph după lor families.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני בנימים למשפחותם לבלע משפחת הבלעי לאשבל משפחת האשבלי לאחירם משפחת האחירמי
verses.english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
verses.romanian: The fiii lui Benjamin după lor families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לשופם משפחת השופמי לחופם משפחת החופמי
verses.english: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.romanian: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לארד משפחת הארדי לנעמן משפחת הנעמני
verses.english: Of Ard, the family of the Ardites: [and] of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.romanian: Of Ard, the family of the Ardites: [și] of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה בני בנימים למשפחותם ופקדיהם חמשה וארבעים אלף ושש מאות
verses.english: These [are] the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them [were] forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the fiii lui Benjamin după lor families: și they că erau numărat al lor [erau] patruzeci și cinci mie și șase sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה בני דן למשפחותם לשוחם משפחת השוחמי אלה משפחות דן למשפחותם
verses.english: And these [are] the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These [are] the families of Dan after their families.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] the fiii lui Dan după lor families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These [sunt] the families of Dan după lor families.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל משפחות השוחמי ופקדיהם ארבעה וששים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, [were] threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: toți the families of the Shuhamites, după those că erau numărat al lor, [erau] threescore și patru mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני אשר למשפחותם לימנה משפחת הימני לישוה משפחת הישוי לבריעה משפחת הבריעי
verses.english: [Of] the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.romanian: [Of] the copiii lui Asher după lor families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לחבר משפחת החברי למלכיאל משפחת המלכיאלי
verses.english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.romanian: Of the fiii lui Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושם בת אשר שרח
verses.english: And the name of the daughter of Asher [was] Sarah.
verses.romanian: și the name of the daughter of Asher [era] Sarah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות בני אשר לפקדיהם שלשה וחמשים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; [who were] fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the fiii lui Asher după those că erau numărat al lor; [care erau] cincizeci și trei mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בני נפתלי למשפחותם ליחצאל משפחת היחצאלי לגוני משפחת הגוני
verses.english: [Of] the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.romanian: [Of] the fiii lui Naphtali după lor families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ליצר משפחת היצרי לשלום משפחת השלומי
verses.english: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.romanian: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות נפתלי למשפחותם ופקדיהם חמשה וארבעים אלף וארבע מאות
verses.english: These [are] the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them [were] forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of Naphtali după lor families: și they că erau numărat al lor [erau] patruzeci și cinci mie și patru sută.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי בני ישראל שש מאות אלף ואלף ושבע מאות ושלשים
verses.english: These [were] the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.romanian: These [erau] the numărat of the copiii lui Israel, șase sută mie și a mie șapte sută și treizeci.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לאלה תחלק הארץ בנחלה במספר שמות
verses.english: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.romanian: lui these the țară va fi divided căci an moștenire după the numărătoare of names.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לרב תרבה נחלתו ולמעט תמעיט נחלתו איש לפי פקדיו יתן נחלתו
verses.english: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.romanian: To many tu vei a da the mai mult moștenire, și to few tu vei a da the less moștenire: to fiecare unu va lui moștenire fi given după those că erau numărat al lui.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך בגורל יחלק את הארץ לשמות מטות אבתיכם יתנחלו
verses.english: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.romanian: Notwithstanding the țară va fi divided prin tragere la sorți: după the names of the seminții of lor părinți they va a moșteni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: על פי הגורל יחלק נחלתו בין רב למעט
verses.english: According to his lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.romanian: după lui lot va the moștenire al acestuia fi divided between many și few.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה פקדי הלוים למשפחותם לגרשון משפחת הגרשוני לקהת משפחת הקהתי למררי משפחת המררי
verses.english: And these [are] they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.romanian: și these [sunt] they că erau numărat of the leviți după lor families: of Gershon, the family of the gherșoniți: of Kohath, the family of the chehatiți: of Merari, the family of the merariți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה משפחות בני לוי משפחת הלבני ומשפחת החברוני ומשפחת המחלי ומשפחת הקרחי ומשפחת המושי וקהת הוליד את עמרם
verses.english: These [are] the families of the sons of Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the families of the fiii lui leviți: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. și Kohath begat Amram.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושם אשת עמרם יוכבד בת לוי אשר ילדה אתה ללוי במצרים ותלד לעמרם את אהרן ואת משה ואת מרים אחתם
verses.english: And the name of Amram's wife [was] Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom [her mother] bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.romanian: și the name of Amram's wife [era] Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, pe care [ei mamă] bare to Levi in Egypt: și she bare lui Amram Aaron și Moise, și Miriam lor soră.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויולד לאהרן את נדב ואת אביהוא את אלעזר ואת איתמר
verses.english: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.romanian: și lui Aaron era born Nadab, și Abihu, Elazar, și Ithamar.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימת נדב ואביהוא בהקריבם אש זרה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Nadab și Abihu a murit, când they a adus ca jertfă strange foc înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהיו פקדיהם שלשה ועשרים אלף כל זכר מבן חדש ומעלה כי לא התפקדו בתוך בני ישראל כי לא נתן להם נחלה בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și those că erau numărat al lor erau douăzeci și trei mie, toți males din a lună old și upward: căci they erau nu numărat între the copiii lui Israel, pentru că acolo era no moștenire given them între the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה פקדי משה ואלעזר הכהן אשר פקדו את בני ישראל בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו
verses.english: These [are] they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] they că erau numărat by Moise și Elazar the preot, care numărat the copiii lui Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובאלה לא היה איש מפקדי משה ואהרן הכהן אשר פקדו את בני ישראל במדבר סיני
verses.english: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.romanian: dar între these acolo era nu a om al lor pe care Moise și Aaron the preot numărat, când they numărat the copiii lui Israel in the pustie of Sinai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי אמר יהוה להם מות ימותו במדבר ולא נותר מהם איש כי אם כלב בן יפנה ויהושע בן נון
verses.english: For the LORD had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.romanian: căci DOMNUL had a spus al lor, They va negresit a muri in the pustie. și acolo era nu left a om al lor, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, și Iosua the son of Nun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותקרבנה בנות צלפחד בן חפר בן גלעד בן מכיר בן מנשה למשפחות מנשה בן יוסף ואלה שמות בנתיו מחלה ונעה חגלה מלכה ותרצה
verses.english: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these [are] the names of his daughters; Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.romanian: atunci a venit the fiicele lui Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: și these [sunt] the names of lui daughters; Mahlah, și Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, și Tirzah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותעמדנה לפני משה ולפני אלעזר הכהן ולפני הנשיאים וכל העדה פתח אהל מועד לאמר
verses.english: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, [by] the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying
verses.romanian: și they a stat înainte Moise, și înainte Elazar the preot, și înainte the căpetenii și toți the obște, [by] the door of the Cortul of the obște, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אבינו מת במדבר והוא לא היה בתוך העדה הנועדים על יהוה בעדת קרח כי בחטאו מת אבינו ובנים לא היה לו
verses.english: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and our father had no sons.
verses.romanian: nostru tată a murit in the pustie, și he era nu in the company al lor că gathered înșiși together împotriva DOMNUL in the company of Korah; dar a murit in lui own păcat, și nostru tată had no sons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למה יגרע שם אבינו מתוך משפחתו כי אין לו בן תנו לנו אחזת נחלה בתוך אחי אבינו
verses.english: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us [therefore] a possessions of a lot among the brethren of our father.
verses.romanian: de ce trebuie să the name of nostru tată fi done away din între lui family, pentru că he sunt no son? a da lui us [de aceea] a possessions of a lot între the brethren of nostru tată.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרב משה את משפטן לפני יהוה
verses.english: And Moses brought their cause before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Moise a adus lor cause înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כן בנות צלפחד דברות נתן תתן להן אחזת נחלה בתוך אחי אביהן והעברת את נחלת אביהן להן
verses.english: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.romanian: The fiicele lui Zelophehad a vorbi right: tu vei negresit a da them a moștenire of an moștenire între lor tată's brethren; și tu vei cause the moștenire of lor tată to a trece lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואל בני ישראל תדבר לאמר איש כי ימות ובן אין לו ונתתם את נחלתו לבתו
verses.english: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his daughter.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, saying, dacă a om a muri, și au no son, atunci voi va a da lui moștenire lui lui daughter.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אין לו בת ונתתם את נחלתו לאחיו
verses.english: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.romanian: și dacă he au no daughter, atunci voi va a da lui moștenire lui lui brethren.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אין לו אחים ונתתם את נחלתו לאחי אביו
verses.english: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.romanian: și dacă he au no brethren, atunci voi va a da lui moștenire lui lui tată's brethren.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם אין אחים לאביו ונתתם את נחלתו לשארו הקרוב אליו ממשפחתו ויירש אתו והיתה לבני ישראל לחקת משפט כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și dacă lui tată au no brethren, atunci voi va a da lui moștenire lui lui kinsman că este next to him of lui family, și he va a stăpâni it: și it va fi lui the copiii lui Israel a poruncă of judecată, as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר עלה אל הר העברים הזה וראה את הארץ אשר נתתי לבני ישראל
verses.english: And the LORD spoken unto Moses saying, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL spoken lui Moise saying, Get te up into this mount Abarim, și a vedea the țară care I au given lui the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וראית אתה ונאספת אל עמך גם אתה כאשר נאסף אהרן אחיך
verses.english: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.romanian: și când tu ai seen it, tu de asemenea shalt fi gathered lui tău popor, as Aaron tău frate era gathered.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר מריתם את פיי במדבר צן במריבת העדה להקדישני במים לעיניהם הם מי מריבת קדש מדבר צן
verses.english: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that [is] the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.romanian: căci voi s-a răzvrătit împotriva meu poruncă in the pustie of Zin, in the strife of the obște, to a sfinți me at the apă înainte lor eyes: că [este] the apă of Meribah in Kadesh in the pustie of Zin.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל יהוה לאמר
verses.english: And Moses spake unto the LORD, saying
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit lui DOMNUL, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: יפקד יהוה אלהי הרוחות לכל הבשר איש על העדה
verses.english: Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation
verses.romanian: Let DOMNUL, the Dumnezeu of the duhuri of toți flesh, a așeza a om peste the obște

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אשר יצא לפניהם ואשר יבוא לפניהם ואשר יוציאם ואשר יביאם ולא תהיה עדת יהוה כצאן אשר אין להם רעה
verses.english: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the LORD be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.romanian: care poate a merge out înainte them, și care poate a merge in înainte them, și care poate lead them out, și care poate a aduce them in; că the obște of DOMNUL fi nu as oaie care au no shepherd.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה קח לך את יהושע בן נון האיש אשר רוחו בו וסמכת את ידך עליו
verses.english: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom [is] the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a spus lui Moise, a lua te Iosua the son of Nun, a om in pe care [este] the duh, și lay al tău mână upon him;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והעמדת אתו לפני אלעזר הכהן ולפני כל העדה וצוית אתו לעיניהם
verses.english: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.romanian: și a așeza him înainte Elazar the preot, și înainte toți the obște; și a da him a charge in lor sight.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונתתה מהודך עליו ולמען ישמעון כל עדת בני ישראל
verses.english: And thou shalt put [some] of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a pune [some] of al tău honour upon him, că toți the obște of the copiii lui Israel poate fi obedient.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולפני אלעזר הכהן יעמד ושאל לו במשפט הארים לפני יהוה על פיהו יצא ועל פיהו יבוא הוא וכל בני ישראל אתו וכל העדה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה כאשר צוה יהוה אתו ויקח את יהושע ויעמדהו לפני אלעזר הכהן ולפני כל העדה
verses.english: And Moses did as the LORD commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.romanian: și Moise a făcut as DOMNUL commanded him: și he a luat Iosua, și a așeza him înainte Elazar the preot, și înainte toți the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסמך את ידו עליו ויצוהו כאשר דבר יהוה ביד משה ויאמר אליו עיניך הראות את אשר עשה יהוה לשני המלכים האלה כן יעשה יהוה לכל הממלכות אשר אתה עבר שמה לא תיראם כי יהוה אלהיכם הוא הנלחם לכם
verses.english: And he laid his hand upon him, and gave him a charge, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses. b) And he is saying to him: eyes of you saw that which the LORD did to two of these kings. So the LORD shall do to all kingdoms that are across there. Not you shall fear them as the LORD God will overcome them for you.
verses.romanian: și he laid lui mână upon him, și a dat him a charge, as DOMNUL commanded by the mână of Moise. b) și he este saying to him: eyes al vostru a văzut că care DOMNUL a făcut to doi of these regi. astfel DOMNUL va a face to toți kingdoms că sunt across acolo. nu you va fear them as DOMNUL Dumnezeu va overcome them căci you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם את קרבני לחמי לאשי ריח ניחחי תשמרו להקריב לי במועדיו
verses.english: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, [and] my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, [for] a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.romanian: Command the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, meu prinos, [și] meu bread căci meu jertfe a făcut by foc, [căci] a miros plăcut lui me, va voi observe to a aduce ca jertfă lui me in lor due season.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואמרת להם זה האש אשר תקריבו ליהוה כבשים בני שנה תמימם שנים ליום עלת תמיד
verses.english: And thou shalt say unto them, This [is] the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the LORD; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, [for] a continual burnt offerings.
verses.romanian: și tu vei a spune lui them, This [este] the prinos a făcut by foc care voi va a aduce ca jertfă lui DOMNUL; doi lambs of the întâi an fără spot zi by zi, [căci] a continual burnt prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את הכבש האחד תעשה בבקר ואת הכבש השני תעשה בין הערבים
verses.english: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.romanian: The unu miel shalt tu a aduce ca jertfă in the dimineață, și the other miel shalt tu a aduce ca jertfă at even;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשירת האיפה סלת למנחה בלולה בשמן רבעית ההין
verses.english: And a tenth [part] of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth [part] of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.romanian: și a al zecelea [part] of an ephah of făină căci a meat prinos, mingled cu the al patrulea [part] of an hin of beaten a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עלת תמיד העשויה בהר סיני לריח ניחח אשה ליהוה
verses.english: [It is] a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: [It este] a continual burnt prinos, care era ordained in mount Sinai căci a miros plăcut, a jertfă a făcut by foc lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסכו רבעית ההין לכבש האחד בקדש הסך נסך שכר ליהוה
verses.english: And the drink offering thereof [shall be] the fourth [part] of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy [place] shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the LORD [for] a drink offering.
verses.romanian: și the drink prinos al acestuia [va fi] the al patrulea [part] of an hin căci the unu miel: in the sfânt [place] shalt tu cause the puternic wine to fi poured lui DOMNUL [căci] a drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הכבש השני תעשה בין הערבים כמנחת הבקר וכנסכו תעשה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה
verses.english: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer [it], a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the other miel shalt tu a aduce ca jertfă at even: as the meat prinos of the dimineață, și as the drink prinos al acestuia, tu vei a aduce ca jertfă [it], a jertfă a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השבת שני כבשים בני שנה תמימם ושני עשרנים סלת מנחה בלולה בשמן ונסכו
verses.english: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.romanian: și on the sabbath zi doi lambs of the întâi an fără spot, și doi al zecelea deals of făină [căci] a meat prinos, mingled cu a fierbe, și the drink prinos al acestuia:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עלת שבת בשבת על עלת התמיד ונסכיהם
verses.english: [This is] the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: [This este] the burnt prinos of fiecare sabbath, beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובראשי חדשיכם תקריבו עלה ליהוה פרים בני בקר שנים ואיל אחד כבשים בני שנה שבעה תמימם
verses.english: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.romanian: și in the beginnings of vostru luni voi va a aduce ca jertfă a burnt prinos lui DOMNUL; doi young bullocks, și unu berbec, șapte lambs of the întâi an fără spot;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושלשה עשרנים סלת מנחה בלולה בשמן לפר האחד ושני עשרנים סלת מנחה בלולה בשמן לאיל האחד
verses.english: And three tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour [for] a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.romanian: și trei al zecelea deals of făină [căci] a meat prinos, mingled cu a fierbe, căci unu bullock; și doi al zecelea deals of făină [căci] a meat prinos, mingled cu a fierbe, căci unu berbec;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון סלת מנחה בלולה בשמן לכבש האחד עלה ריח ניחח אשה ליהוה
verses.english: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil [for] a meat offering unto one lamb; [for] a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: și a several al zecelea deal of făină mingled cu a fierbe [căci] a meat prinos lui unu miel; [căci] a burnt prinos de un miros plăcut, a jertfă a făcut by foc lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסכיהם חצי ההין יין לפר האחד ושלשית ההין לאיל ורביעית ההין לכבש האחד יין זאת עלת החדש בחדשו לחדשי השנה
verses.english: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto one bullock, and the third [part] of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth [part] of an hin unto one lamb: this [is] the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.romanian: și lor drink prinoase va fi half an hin of wine lui unu bullock, și the al treilea [part] of an hin lui a berbec, și a al patrulea [part] of an hin lui unu miel: this [este] the burnt prinos of fiecare lună throughout the luni of the an.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת ליהוה על עלת התמיד יעשו ונסכיהם
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the LORD shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci a păcat prinos lui DOMNUL va fi a adus ca jertfă, beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בחדש הראישון בארבעה עשר יום לחדש פסח ליהוה
verses.english: And in the fourteenth day of the first month [is] the passover of the LORD.
verses.romanian: și in the fourteenth zi of the întâi lună [este] the passover of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובחמשה עשר יום לחדש הזה חג שבעת ימים מצות תאכלו
verses.english: And in the fifteenth day of this month [is] the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.romanian: și in the fifteenth zi of this lună [este] the feast: șapte zile va unleavened bread fi eaten.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום הראישון מקרא קדש כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: In the first day [shall be] an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work [therein]:
verses.romanian: In the întâi zi [va fi] an sfânt convocation; voi va a face no manner of servile muncă [în el]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם אשה עלה ליהוה פרים בני בקר שנים ואיל אחד ושבעה כבשים בני שנה תמימם יהיו לכם
verses.english: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire [for] a burnt offering unto the LORD; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.romanian: dar voi va a aduce ca jertfă a jertfă a făcut by foc [căci] a burnt prinos lui DOMNUL; doi young bullocks, și unu berbec, și șapte lambs of the întâi an: they va fi lui you fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם סלת בלולה בשמן שלשה עשרנים לפר ושני עשרנים לאיל תעשו
verses.english: And their meat offering [shall be of] flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos [va fi of] făină mingled cu a fierbe: trei al zecelea deals va voi a aduce ca jertfă căci a bullock, și doi al zecelea deals căci a berbec;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון לכבש האחד לשבעת הכבשים
verses.english: And several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.romanian: și several al zecelea deal shalt tu a aduce ca jertfă căci fiecare miel, throughout the șapte lambs:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת לכפר עליכם
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos, to a face an atonement căci you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מלבד עלת הבקר אשר לעלת התמיד תעשו את אלה
verses.english: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which [is] for a continual burnt offering.
verses.romanian: voi va a aduce ca jertfă these beside the burnt prinos in the dimineață, care [este] căci a continual burnt prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאלה ליום תעשו שבעת הימים לחם אשה לריח ניחח ליהוה על עלת התמיד יעשו ונסכיהם
verses.english: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: după this manner voi va a aduce ca jertfă daily, throughout the șapte zile, the meat of the jertfă a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL: it va fi a adus ca jertfă beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השביעי מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.romanian: și on the al șaptelea zi voi va au an sfânt convocation; voi va a face no servile muncă.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ביום הבכרים בהקריבכם מנחה חדשה ליהוה בשבעתיכם מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: In the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the LORD, after your weeks [be out], ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.romanian: In the zi of the firstfruits, când voi a aduce a new meat prinos lui DOMNUL, după vostru weeks [fi out], voi va au an sfânt convocation; voi va a face no servile muncă:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם עלה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה פרים בני בקר שנים ואיל אחד כבשים בני שנה שבעה תמימם יהיו לכם
verses.english: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year; seven without a blemish they shell be to you.
verses.romanian: dar voi va a aduce ca jertfă the burnt prinos căci a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL; doi young bullocks, unu berbec, șapte lambs of the întâi an; șapte fără a blemish they shell fi to you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם סלת בלולה בשמן שלשה עשרנים לפר האחד ושני עשרנים לאיל האחד
verses.english: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, and two tenth deals unto one ram
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos of făină mingled cu a fierbe, trei al zecelea deals lui unu bullock, și doi al zecelea deals lui unu berbec

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון לכבש האחד לשבעת הכבשים
verses.english: And several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.romanian: și several al zecelea deal lui unu miel, throughout the șapte lambs;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת לכפר עליכם
verses.english: And one kid of the goats for sins, to make an atonement for you.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats căci sins, to a face an atonement căci you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה תעשו תמימם יהיו לכם ונסכיהם
verses.english: Ye shall offer [them] beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.romanian: voi va a aduce ca jertfă [them] beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, (they va fi lui you fără blemish) și lor drink prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובחדש השביעי באחד לחדש מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו יום תרועה יהיה לכם
verses.english: And in the seventh month, on the first [day] of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.romanian: și in the al șaptelea lună, on the întâi [zi] of the lună, voi va au an sfânt convocation; voi va a face no servile muncă: it este a zi of blowing the trâmbițe lui you.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשיתם עלה לריח ניחח ליהוה פר בן בקר אחד איל אחד כבשים בני שנה שבעה תמימם
verses.english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the LORD; one young bullock, one ram, [and] seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.romanian: și voi va a aduce ca jertfă a burnt prinos căci a miros plăcut lui DOMNUL; unu young bullock, unu berbec, [și] șapte lambs of the întâi an fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם סלת בלולה בשמן שלשה עשרנים לפר ושני עשרנים לאיל
verses.english: And their meat offering [shall be of] flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos [va fi of] făină mingled cu a fierbe, trei al zecelea deals căci a bullock, și doi al zecelea deals căci a berbec

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון לכבש האחד לשבעת הכבשים
verses.english: And tenth of a tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.romanian: și al zecelea of a al zecelea deal căci unu miel, throughout the șapte lambs:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת לכפר עליכם
verses.english: And one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats [căci] a păcat prinos, to a face an atonement căci you:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: מלבד עלת החדש ומנחתה ועלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה כמשפטם לריח ניחח אשה ליהוה
verses.english: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the LORD.
verses.romanian: Beside the burnt prinos of the lună, și lui meat prinos, și the daily burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lor drink prinoase, according lui lor manner, căci a miros plăcut, a jertfă a făcut by foc lui DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובעשור לחדש השביעי הזה מקרא קדש יהיה לכם ועניתם את נפשתיכם וכל מלאכה לא תעשו
verses.english: And ye shall have on the tenth [day] of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work [therein]:
verses.romanian: și voi va au on the al zecelea [zi] of this al șaptelea lună an sfânt convocation; și voi va afflict vostru suflete: voi va nu a face vreun muncă [în el]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם עלה ליהוה ריח ניחח פר בן בקר אחד איל אחד כבשים בני שנה שבעה תמימם יהיו לכם
verses.english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the LORD [for] a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, [and] seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.romanian: dar voi va a aduce ca jertfă a burnt prinos lui DOMNUL [căci] a miros plăcut; unu young bullock, unu berbec, [și] șapte lambs of the întâi an; they va fi lui you fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם סלת בלולה בשמן שלשה עשרנים לפר ושני עשרנים לאיל האחד
verses.english: And their meat offering [shall be of] flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos [va fi of] făină mingled cu a fierbe, trei al zecelea deals to a bullock, și doi al zecelea deals to unu berbec

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון לכבש האחד לשבעת הכבשים
verses.english: And several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.romanian: și several al zecelea deal căci unu miel, throughout the șapte lambs:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד חטאת הכפורים ועלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the păcat prinos of atonement, și the continual burnt prinos, și the meat prinos of it, și lor drink prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובחמשה עשר יום לחדש השביעי הזה מקרא קדש יהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו וחגתם חג ליהוה שבעת ימים
verses.english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the LORD seven days:
verses.romanian: și on the fifteenth zi of the al șaptelea lună voi va au an sfânt convocation; voi va a face no servile muncă, și voi va a păzi a feast lui DOMNUL șapte zile:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם עלה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה פרים בני בקר שלשה עשר אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם יהיו לכם
verses.english: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish to you:
verses.romanian: și voi va a aduce ca jertfă a burnt prinos, a jertfă a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL; thirteen young bullocks, doi rams, [și] fourteen lambs of the întâi an; they va fi fără blemish to you:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם סלת בלולה בשמן שלשה עשרנים לפר האחד לשלשה עשר הפרים ושני עשרנים לאיל האחד לשני האילים
verses.english: And their meat offering [shall be of] flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, and two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos [va fi of] făină mingled cu a fierbe, trei al zecelea deals lui fiecare bullock of the thirteen bullocks, și doi al zecelea deals to fiecare berbec of the doi rams

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועשרון עשרון לכבש האחד לארבעה עשר הכבשים ונסכיהם
verses.english: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs, and their libations:
verses.romanian: și a several al zecelea deal to fiecare miel of the fourteen lambs, și lor libations:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השני פרים בני בקר שנים עשר אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the second day [ye shall offer] twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.romanian: și on the al doilea zi [voi va a aduce ca jertfă] doisprezece young bullocks, doi rams, fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără spot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și the meat prinos al acestuia, și lor drink prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השלישי פרים עשתה עשר אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.romanian: și on the al treilea zi unsprezece bullocks, doi rams, fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără blemish;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום הרביעי פרים עשרה אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.romanian: și on the al patrulea zi zece bullocks, doi rams, [și] fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one kid of the goats [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu kid of the goats [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום החמישי פרים תשעה אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.romanian: și on the al cincilea zi nouă bullocks, doi rams, [și] fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără spot:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום הששי פרים שמנה אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.romanian: și on the al șaselea zi opt bullocks, doi rams, [și] fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.
