verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השביעי פרים שבעה אילים שנים כבשים בני שנה ארבעה עשר תמימם
verses.english: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, [and] fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.romanian: și on the al șaptelea zi șapte bullocks, doi rams, [și] fourteen lambs of the întâi an fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפרים לאילים ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullocks, căci the rams, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וביום השמיני עצרת תהיה לכם כל מלאכת עבדה לא תעשו
verses.english: And on the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work [therein]:
verses.romanian: și on the al optulea zi voi va au a solemn adunare: voi va a face no servile muncă [în el]:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקרבתם עלה אשה ריח ניחח ליהוה פר אחד איל אחד כבשים בני שנה שבעה תמימם
verses.english: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.romanian: dar voi va a aduce ca jertfă a burnt prinos, a jertfă a făcut by foc, de un miros plăcut lui DOMNUL: unu bullock, unu berbec, șapte lambs of the întâi an fără blemish:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומנחתם ונסכיהם לפר לאיל ולכבשים במספרם כמשפט
verses.english: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, [shall be] according to their number, after the manner:
verses.romanian: și lor meat prinos și lor drink prinoase căci the bullock, căci the berbec, și căci the lambs, [va fi] după lor numărătoare, după the manner:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושעיר עזים אחד לחטאת מלבד עלת התמיד ומנחתה ונסכיה
verses.english: And one goat [for] a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.romanian: și unu țap [căci] a păcat prinos; beside the continual burnt prinos, și lui meat prinos, și lui drink prinos.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה תעשו ליהוה במועדיכם לבד מנדריכם ונדבתיכם לעלתיכם ולמנחתיכם ולנסכיכם ולשלמיכם
verses.english: These [things] ye shall do unto the LORD in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.romanian: These [things] voi va a face lui DOMNUL in vostru a așeza feasts, beside vostru vows, și vostru freewill prinoase, căci vostru burnt prinoase, și căci vostru meat prinoase, și căci vostru drink prinoase, și căci vostru pace prinoase.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אל בני ישראל ככל אשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise told the copiii lui Israel după toți că DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל ראשי המטות לבני ישראל לאמר זה הדבר אשר צוה יהוה
verses.english: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This [is] the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit lui the capete of the seminții concerning the copiii lui Israel, saying, This [este] the thing care DOMNUL sunt commanded.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: איש כי ידר נדר ליהוה או השבע שבועה לאסר אסר על נפשו לא יחל דבריו ככל היוצא מפיו יעשה
verses.english: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.romanian: dacă a om juruință a juruință lui DOMNUL, sau swear an oath to bind lui suflet cu a bond; he va nu break lui cuvânt, he va a face după toți că proceedeth out of lui mouth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואשה כי תדר נדר ליהוה ואסרה אסר בבית אביה בנעריה
verses.english: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind [herself] by a bond, [being] in her father's house in her youth;
verses.romanian: dacă a femeie de asemenea juruință a juruință lui DOMNUL, și bind [însăși] by a bond, [fiind] in ei tată's house in ei youth;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמע אביה את נדריה ואסריה אשר אסרה על נפשה והחריש לה אביה וקמו כל נדריה ואסריה אשר אסרה על נפשה יקומו
verses.english: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.romanian: și ei tată a auzi ei juruință, și ei bond wherewith she sunt bound ei suflet, și ei tată va hold lui pace at ei: atunci toți ei vows va a sta, și fiecare bond wherewith she sunt bound ei suflet va a sta.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם הנא יניא אביה אתה ביום שמעו כל נדריה ואסריה אשר אסרה על נפשה לא יקומו ויהוה יסלח לה כי הניא אביה אתה
verses.english: But if her father forbid, disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.romanian: dar dacă ei tată forbid, disallow ei in the zi că he heareth; nu vreun al ei vows, sau al ei bonds wherewith she sunt bound ei suflet, va a sta: și DOMNUL va a ierta ei, pentru că ei tată disallowed ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם היו תהיה לאיש ונדריה עליה או מבטא שפתיה אשר אסרה על נפשה
verses.english: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.romanian: și dacă she had at toți an husband, când she a făgăduit, sau uttered ought out al ei lips, wherewith she bound ei suflet;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמע אישה ביום שמעו וחריש לה וקמו כל נדריה ואסריה אשר אסרה על נפשה יקומו
verses.english: And her husband heard [it], and held his peace at her in the day that he heard [it]: then all her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.romanian: și ei husband a auzit [it], și held lui pace at ei in the zi că he a auzit [it]: atunci toți ei vows va a sta, și ei bonds wherewith she bound ei suflet va a sta.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם ביום שמע אישה יניא אתה והפר את נדריה אשר עליה או מבטא שפתיה אשר אסרה על נפשה ויהוה יסלח לה
verses.english: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard [it]; then he shall make her vows which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.romanian: dar dacă ei husband disallowed ei on the zi că he a auzit [it]; atunci he va a face ei vows care she a făgăduit, și că care she uttered cu ei lips, wherewith she bound ei suflet, of niciun effect: și DOMNUL va a ierta ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונדר אלמנה וגרושה כל אשר אסרה על נפשה יקום עליה
verses.english: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.romanian: dar fiecare juruință of a widow, și al ei că este divorced, wherewith they au bound lor suflete, va a sta împotriva ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בית אישה נדרה או אסרה אסר על נפשה בשבועה
verses.english: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.romanian: și dacă she a făgăduit in ei husband's house, sau bound ei suflet by a bond cu an oath;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושמע אישה וחריש לה לא הניא אתה וקמו כל נדריה וכל אסריה אשר אסרה על נפשה יקומו
verses.english: And her husband heard [it], and held his peace at her, [and] disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.romanian: și ei husband a auzit [it], și held lui pace at ei, [și] disallowed ei nu: atunci toți ei vows va a sta, și fiecare bond wherewith she bound ei suflet va a sta.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם הפר יפיר אתם אישה ביום שמעו כל מוצא שפתיה לנדריה ולאסר נפשה לא יקומו אישה הפירם ויהוה יסלח לה
verses.english: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard [them; then] whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
verses.romanian: dar dacă ei husband sunt utterly a făcut them void on the zi he a auzit [them; atunci] whatsoever proceeded out al ei lips concerning ei vows, sau concerning the bond al ei suflet, va nu a sta: ei husband sunt a făcut them void; și DOMNUL va a ierta ei.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל נדר וכל שבועת אסר לענות נפש אישה יקימנו ואישה יפירנו
verses.english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.romanian: fiecare juruință, și fiecare binding oath to afflict the suflet, ei husband poate establish it, sau ei husband poate a face it void.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם החריש יחריש לה אישה מיום אל יום והקם את כל נדריה או את כל אסריה אשר עליה הקים אתם כי חריש לה ביום שמעו
verses.english: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which [are] upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard [them].
verses.romanian: dar dacă ei husband altogether hold lui pace at ei din zi to zi; atunci he establisheth toți ei vows, sau toți ei bonds, care [sunt] upon ei: he confirmeth them, pentru că he held lui pace at ei in the zi că he a auzit [them].

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם הפר יפיר אתם אחרי שמעו ונשא את עונו
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה החקים אשר צוה יהוה את משה בין איש לאשתו ובין אב לבתו בנעריה בבית אביה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: נקם נקמת בני ישראל מאת המדינים ואחר תאסף אל עמך
verses.english: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: and afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.romanian: Avenge the copiii lui Israel of the Midianites: și afterward shalt tu fi gathered lui tău popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר משה אל העם לאמר החליצו מאתכם אנשים לצבא ויהיו על מדין לתת נקמת יהוה במדין
verses.english: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
verses.romanian: și Moise a vorbit lui the popor, saying, Arm some of yourselves lui the război, și let them a merge împotriva the Midianites, și avenge DOMNUL of Midian.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלף למטה אלף למטה לכל מטות ישראל תשלחו לצבא
verses.english: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.romanian: Of fiecare seminție a mie, throughout toți the seminții of Israel, va voi send to the război.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וימסרו מאלפי ישראל אלף למטה שנים עשר אלף חלוצי צבא
verses.english: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of [every] tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.romanian: astfel acolo erau delivered out of the mii of Israel, a mie of [fiecare] seminție, doisprezece mie armed căci război.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישלח אתם משה אלף למטה לצבא אתם ואת פינחס בן אלעזר הכהן לצבא וכלי הקדש וחצצרות התרועה בידו
verses.english: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of [every] tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.romanian: și Moise sent them to the război, a mie of [fiecare] seminție, them și Pinhas the son of Elazar the preot, to the război, cu the sfânt instruments, și the trâmbițe to blow in lui mână.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצבאו על מדין כאשר צוה יהוה את משה ויהרגו כל זכר
verses.english: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.romanian: și they a purtat război împotriva the Midianites, as DOMNUL commanded Moise; și they slew toți the males.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת מלכי מדין הרגו על חלליהם את אוי ואת רקם ואת צור ואת חור ואת רבע חמשת מלכי מדין ואת בלעם בן בעור הרגו בחרב
verses.english: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; [namely], Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.romanian: și they slew the regi of Midian, beside the odihnă al lor că erau ucis; [namely], Evi, și Rekem, și Zur, și Hur, și Reba, cinci regi of Midian: Bilam de asemenea the son of Beor they slew cu the sword.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישבו בני ישראל את נשי מדין ואת טפם ואת כל בהמתם ואת כל מקניהם ואת כל חילם בזזו
verses.english: And the children of Israel took [all] the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel a luat [toți] the femei of Midian captives, și lor little ones, și a luat the spoil of toți lor cattle, și toți lor flocks, și toți lor goods.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת כל עריהם במושבתם ואת כל טירתם שרפו באש
verses.english: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.romanian: și they burnt toți lor cetăți wherein they dwelt, și toți lor goodly castles, cu foc.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקחו את כל השלל ואת כל המלקח באדם ובבהמה
verses.english: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, [both] of men and of beasts.
verses.romanian: și they a luat toți the spoil, și toți the prey, [both] of oameni și of beasts.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויביאו אל משה ואל אלעזר הכהן ואל כל עדת בני ישראל את השבי ואת המלקח ואת השלל אל המחנה אל ערבת מואב אשר על ירדן יריחו
verses.english: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto all of the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which [are] by Jordan [near] Jericho.
verses.romanian: și they a adus the captives, și the prey, și the spoil, lui Moise, și Elazar the preot, și lui toți of the obște of the copiii lui Israel, lui the tabără at the plains of Moab, care [sunt] by Jordan [lângă] Jericho.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא משה ואלעזר הכהן וכל נשיאי העדה לקראתם אל מחוץ למחנה
verses.english: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.romanian: și Moise, și Elazar the preot, și toți the căpetenii of the obște, a mers forth to meet them fără the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקצף משה על פקדי החיל שרי האלפים ושרי המאות הבאים מצבא המלחמה
verses.english: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, [with] the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.romanian: și Moise era wroth cu the officers of the oștire, [cu] the captains peste mii, și captains peste sute, care a venit din the battle.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם משה למה החיתם כל נקבה
verses.english: And Moses said unto them, Why have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui them, de ce au voi saved toți the femei alive?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הנה הנה היו לבני ישראל בדבר בלעם למסר מעל ביהוה על דבר פעור ותהי המגפה בעדת יהוה
verses.english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
verses.romanian: iată, these caused the copiii lui Israel, prin the counsel of Bilam, to commit trespass împotriva DOMNUL in the matter of Peor, și acolo era a urgie între the obște of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועתה הרגו כל זכר בטף וכל אשה ידעת איש למשכב זכר הרגו
verses.english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.romanian: acum de aceea a ucide fiecare male între the little ones, și a ucide fiecare femeie că sunt known om by lying cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל הטף בנשים אשר לא ידעו משכב זכר חיו לכם
verses.english: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.romanian: dar toți the femei copii, că au nu known a om by lying cu him, a păzi alive căci yourselves.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואתם חנו לכם מחוץ למחנה שבעת ימים כל הרג נפש וכל הנגע בחלל תתחטאו ביום השלישי וביום השביעי אתם ושביתכם
verses.english: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify [both] yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.romanian: și a face voi abide fără the tabără șapte zile: whosoever sunt killed vreun person, și whosoever sunt touched vreun ucis, purify [both] yourselves și vostru captives on the al treilea zi, și on the al șaptelea zi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל בגד וכל כלי עור וכל מעשה עזים וכל כלי עץ תתחטאו ויאמר משה אל אלעזר הכהן אמר אל אנשי הצבא הבאים למלחמה זאת חקת התורה אשר צוה יהוה אך את הזהב ואת הכסף ואת הנחשת ואת הברזל ואת הבדיל ואת העופרת כל דבר אשר יבוא באש תעבירו באש וטהר אך במי נדה יתחטא וכל אשר לא יבוא באש תעבירו במים וכבסתם בגדיכם ביום השביעי וטהרתם ואחר תבאו אל המחנה
verses.english: And purify all [your] raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' [hair], and all things made of wood. And he is saying Moses to Elazar the priest: say to mortals, the ones going to war this law which the LORD instructed. Gold, and silver and copper and iron and tin and lead, all that can pass through fire you pass through fire so that it may be clean. But everything which may not come through fire you shall cause to pass through water. You will rinse your garments on the seventh day, and you will be clean. And thereafter you may come into the camp.
verses.romanian: și purify toți [vostru] raiment, și toți că este a făcut of skins, și toți muncă of goats' [hair], și toți things a făcut of lemn. și he este saying Moise to Elazar the preot: a spune to mortals, the ones going to război this lege care DOMNUL instructed. aur, și argint și copper și fier și tin și lead, toți că poate a trece prin foc you a trece prin foc astfel că it poate fi curat. dar everything care poate nu a veni prin foc you va cause to a trece prin apă. You va rinse vostru garments on the al șaptelea zi, și you va fi curat. și după aceea you poate a veni into the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אלעזר הכהן אל אנשי הצבא הבאים למלחמה זאת חקת התורה אשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
verses.romanian: și Elazar the preot a spus lui the oameni of război care a mers to the battle, This [este] the rânduială of the lege care DOMNUL commanded Moise;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אך את הזהב ואת הכסף ואת הנחשת ואת הברזל ואת הבדיל ואת העופרת
verses.english: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, and the iron, and the tin, and the lead
verses.romanian: numai the aur, și the argint, the brass, și the fier, și the tin, și the lead

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל דבר אשר יבוא באש תעבירו באש וטהר אך במי נדה יתחטא וכל אשר לא יבוא באש תעבירו במים
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכבסתם בגדיכם ביום השביעי וטהרתם ואחר תבאו אל המחנה
verses.english: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.romanian: și voi va a spăla vostru clothes on the al șaptelea zi, și voi va fi curat, și afterward voi va a veni into the tabără.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שא את ראש המלקח השבי באדם ובבהמה אתה ואלעזר הכהן וראשי אבות העדה
verses.english: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, [both] of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.romanian: a lua the sum of the prey că era taken, [both] of om și of beast, tu, și Elazar the preot, și the căpetenie părinți of the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחצית את המלקח בין תפשי המלחמה היוצאים לצבא ובין כל העדה
verses.english: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.romanian: și divide the prey into doi parts; between them că a luat the război upon them, care a mers out to battle, și between toți the obște:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והרמת מכס ליהוה מאת אנשי המלחמה היוצאים לצבא אחת נפש מחמש מאות מן האדם ומן הבקר ומן החמרים ומן הצאן מכל הבהמה
verses.english: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, [both] of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep, and of all animals
verses.romanian: și levy a tribute lui DOMNUL of the oameni of război care a mers out to battle: unu suflet of cinci sută, [both] of the persons, și of the beeves, și of the asses, și of the oaie, și of toți animals

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ממחציתם תקח ונתתה לאלעזר הכהן את תרומת יהוה
verses.english: Take [it] of their half, and give [it] unto Eleazar the priest, [for] an heave offering of the LORD.
verses.romanian: a lua [it] of lor half, și a da [it] lui Elazar the preot, [căci] an heave prinos of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וממחצית בני ישראל תקח אחד אחז מן החמשים מן האדם ומן הבקר ומן החמרים ומן הצאן מכל הבהמה ונתתה אתם ללוים שמרי משמרת משכן יהוה
verses.english: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the flocks, and of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
verses.romanian: și of the copiii lui Israel's half, tu vei a lua unu portion of cincizeci, of the persons, și of the beeves, și of the asses, și of the flocks, și of toți manner of beasts, și a da them lui the leviți, care a păzi the charge of the Cortul of DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעש משה ואלעזר הכהן כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Elazar the preot a făcut as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי המלקח יתר הבז אשר בזזו עם הצבא צאן שש מאות אלף ושבעים אלף וחמשת אלפים
verses.english: And the booty, [being] the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep
verses.romanian: și the booty, [fiind] the odihnă of the prey care the oameni of război had caught, era șase sută mie și șaptezeci mie și cinci mie oaie

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקר שנים ושבעים אלף
verses.english: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves
verses.romanian: și threescore și doisprezece mie beeves

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחמרים אחד וששים אלף
verses.english: And threescore and one thousand asses
verses.romanian: și threescore și unu mie asses

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש אדם מן הנשים אשר לא ידעו משכב זכר כל נפש שנים ושלשים אלף
verses.english: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.romanian: și treizeci și doi mie persons in toți, of femei că had nu known om by lying cu him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותהי המחצה חלק היוצאים בצבא מספר צאן שלש מאות אלף ושלשים אלף ושבעת אלפים וחמש מאות
verses.english: And the half, [which was] the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.romanian: și the half, [care era] the portion al lor că a mers out to război, era in numărătoare trei sută mie și șapte și treizeci mie și cinci sută oaie:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי המכס ליהוה מן הצאן שש מאות חמשה ושבעים
verses.english: And the LORD's tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL's tribute of the oaie era șase sută și threescore și fifteen.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקר ששה ושלשים אלף ומכסם ליהוה שנים ושבעים
verses.english: And the beeves [were] thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD's tribute [was] threescore and twelve.
verses.romanian: și the beeves [erau] treizeci și șase mie; of care DOMNUL's tribute [era] threescore și doisprezece.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחמרים שלשים אלף וחמש מאות ומכסם ליהוה אחד וששים
verses.english: And the asses [were] thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD's tribute [was] threescore and one.
verses.romanian: și the asses [erau] treizeci mie și cinci sută; of care DOMNUL's tribute [era] threescore și unu.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש אדם ששה עשר אלף ומכסם ליהוה שנים ושלשים נפש
verses.english: And the persons [were] sixteen thousand; of which the LORD's tribute [was] thirty and two persons.
verses.romanian: și the persons [erau] sixteen mie; of care DOMNUL's tribute [era] treizeci și doi persons.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן משה את מכס תרומת יהוה לאלעזר הכהן כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: And Moses gave the tribute, [which was] the LORD's heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: și Moise a dat the tribute, [care era] DOMNUL's heave prinos, lui Elazar the preot, as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וממחצית בני ישראל אשר חצה משה מן האנשים הצבאים
verses.english: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred
verses.romanian: și of the copiii lui Israel's half, care Moise divided din the oameni că a purtat război

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותהי מחצית העדה מן הצאן שלש מאות אלף ושלשים אלף ושבעת אלפים וחמש מאות
verses.english: (Now the half [that pertained unto] the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand [and] seven thousand and five hundred sheep,)
verses.romanian: (acum the half [că pertained lui] the obște era trei sută mie și treizeci mie [și] șapte mie și cinci sută oaie,)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובקר ששה ושלשים אלף
verses.english: (And thirty and six thousand beeves,)
verses.romanian: (și treizeci și șase mie beeves,)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וחמרים שלשים אלף וחמש מאות
verses.english: (And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,)
verses.romanian: (și treizeci mie asses și cinci sută,)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונפש אדם ששה עשר אלף
verses.english: (And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.romanian: (și sixteen mie persons;)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה ממחצית בני ישראל את האחז אחד מן החמשים מן האדם ומן הבהמה ויתן אתם אל הלוים שמרי משמרת משכן יהוה כאשר צוה יהוה את משה
verses.english: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, [both] of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.romanian: Even of the copiii lui Israel's half, Moise a luat unu portion of cincizeci, [both] of om și of beast, și a dat them lui the leviți, care a păzit the charge of the Cortul of DOMNUL; as DOMNUL commanded Moise.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרבו אל משה הפקדים אשר לאלפי הצבא שרי האלפים ושרי המאות
verses.english: And the officers which [were] over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.romanian: și the officers care [erau] peste mii of the oștire, the captains of mii, și captains of sute, a venit lângă lui Moise:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו אל משה עבדיך נשאו את ראש אנשי המלחמה אשר בידנו ולא נפקד ממנו איש
verses.english: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which [are] under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.romanian: și they a spus lui Moise, tău slujitori au taken the sum of the oameni of război care [sunt] sub nostru charge, și acolo lacketh nu unu om of us.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונקריב את קרבן יהוה איש אשר מצא כלי זהב אצעדה וצמיד טבעת עגיל וכומז לכפר על נפשתינו לפני יהוה
verses.english: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
verses.romanian: We au de aceea a adus an oblation căci DOMNUL, ce fiecare om sunt gotten, of jewels of aur, chains, și bracelets, rings, earrings, și tablets, to a face an atonement căci nostru suflete înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה ואלעזר הכהן את הזהב מאתם כל כלי מעשה
verses.english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, [even] all wrought jewels.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Elazar the preot a luat the aur al lor, [even] toți wrought jewels.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויהי זהב התרומה אשר הרימו ליהוה ששה עשר אלף ושבע מאות וחמשים שקל מאת שרי האלפים ומאת שרי המאות
verses.english: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.romanian: și toți the aur of the prinos că they a adus ca jertfă up to DOMNUL, of the captains of mii, și of the captains of sute, era sixteen mie șapte sută și cincizeci shekels.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אנשי הצבא בזזו איש לו
verses.english: ([For] the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.romanian: ([căci] the oameni of război had taken spoil, fiecare om căci însuși.)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקח משה ואלעזר הכהן את הזהב מאת שרי האלפים והמאות ויביאו אתו אל אהל מועד זכרון לבני ישראל לפני יהוה
verses.english: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, [for] a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și Moise și Elazar the preot a luat the aur of the captains of mii și of sute, și a adus it into the Cortul of the obște, [căci] a memorial căci the copiii lui Israel înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומקנה רב היה לבני ראובן ולבני גד ולחצי שבט המנשה עצום מאד ויראו את ארץ יעזיר ואת ארץ גלעד והנה המקום מקום מקנה
verses.english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and half of the tribe of Manaseh had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place [was] a place for cattle;
verses.romanian: acum the copiii lui Reuben și the copiii lui Gad și half of the seminție of Manaseh had a foarte mare multitude of cattle: și când they a văzut the țară of Jazer, și the țară of Gilead, că, iată, the place [era] a place căci cattle;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבאו בני גד ובני ראובן וחצי שבט המנשה ויאמרו אל משה ואל אלעזר הכהן ואל נשיאי העדה לאמר
verses.english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben and the half tribe of Manaseh came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying
verses.romanian: The copiii lui Gad și the copiii lui Reuben și the half seminție of Manaseh a venit și a vorbit lui Moise, și to Elazar the preot, și lui the căpetenii of the obște, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: עטרות ודיבון ויעזיר ונמרה וחשבון ואלעלה ושבם ונבו ובעון
verses.english: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon
verses.romanian: Ataroth, și Dibon, și Jazer, și Nimrah, și Heshbon, și Elealeh, și Shebam, și Nebo, și Beon

verses.samaritan_hebrew: הארץ אשר הכה יהוה לפני עדת ישראל ארץ מקנה היא ולעבדיך מקנה
verses.english: [Even] the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, [is] a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.romanian: [Even] the country care DOMNUL a lovit înainte the obște of Israel, [este] a țară căci cattle, și tău slujitori au cattle:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו אם מצאנו חן בעיניך יתן את הארץ הזאת לעבדיך לאחזה ואל תעבירנו את הירדן
verses.english: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.romanian: de aceea, a spus they, dacă we au found har in tău sight, let this țară fi given lui tău slujitori căci a moștenire, și a aduce us nu peste Jordan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה לבני ראובן ולבני גד ולחצי שבט המנשה האחיכם יבאו למלחמה ואתם תשבו פה
verses.english: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben and to half tribe of Manaseh, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui the copiii lui Gad și to the copiii lui Reuben și to half seminție of Manaseh, va vostru brethren a merge to război, și va voi a ședea aici?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמה תניאו את לב בני ישראל מעבר אל הארץ אשר נתן להם יהוה
verses.english: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
verses.romanian: și de aceea discourage voi the inimă of the copiii lui Israel din going peste into the țară care DOMNUL sunt given them?

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כה עשו אבתיכם בשלחי אתם מקדש ברנע לראות את הארץ
verses.english: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.romanian: astfel a făcut vostru părinți, când I sent them din Kadesh-barnea to a vedea the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעלו עד נחל אשכול ויראו את הארץ ויניאו את לב בני ישראל לבלתי בא אל הארץ אשר נתן להם יהוה
verses.english: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
verses.romanian: căci când they a mers up lui the valley of Eshcol, și a văzut the țară, they discouraged the inimă of the copiii lui Israel, că they trebuie să nu a merge into the țară care DOMNUL had given them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף יהוה ביום ההוא וישבע לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD's anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL's mânie era kindled the same time, și he sware, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אם יראו האנשים העלים ממצרים מבן עשרים שנה ומעלה את האדמה אשר נשבעתי לאברהם ליצחק וליעקב כי לא מלאו אחרי
verses.english: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.romanian: negresit niciun of the oameni că a venit up out of Egypt, din douăzeci ani old și upward, va a vedea the țară care I sware lui Abraham, lui Isaac, și lui Jacob; pentru că they au nu wholly followed me:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בלתי כלב בן יפנה הקנזי ויהושע בן נון כי מלאו אחרי יהוה
verses.english: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
verses.romanian: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, și Iosua the son of Nun: căci they au wholly followed DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחר אף יהוה בישראל וינעם במדבר ארבעים שנה עד תם כל הדור העשה הרע בעיני יהוה
verses.english: And the LORD's anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL's mânie era kindled împotriva Israel, și he a făcut them wander in the pustie patruzeci ani, until toți the generation, că had done evil in the sight of DOMNUL, era a mistuit.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והנה קמתם תחת אבתיכם תרבות אנשים חטאים לספות עוד על חרון אף יהוה על ישראל
verses.english: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
verses.romanian: și, iată, voi sunt risen up in vostru părinți' stead, an increase of sinful oameni, to augment yet the fierce mânie of DOMNUL toward Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי תשובון מאחריו ויסף עוד להניחו במדבר ושחתם לכל העם הזה
verses.english: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.romanian: căci dacă voi a se întoarce away din după him, he va yet again leave them in the pustie; și voi va destroy toți this popor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויגשו אליו ויאמרו גדרות צאן נבנה למקנינו פה וערים לטפנו
verses.english: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.romanian: și they a venit lângă lui him, și a spus, We va build sheepfolds aici căci nostru cattle, și cetăți căci nostru little ones:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואנחנו נחלץ חשים לפני בני ישראל עד אשר אם הבאנום אל מקומם וישב טפנו בערי המבצר מפני ישבי הארץ
verses.english: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.romanian: dar we ourselves va a merge ready armed înainte the copiii lui Israel, until we au a adus them lui lor place: și nostru little ones va dwell in the fenced cetăți pentru că of the inhabitants of the țară.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לא נשוב אל בתינו עד התנחלו בני ישראל איש את נחלתו
verses.english: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.romanian: We va nu return lui nostru houses, until the copiii lui Israel au inherited fiecare om lui moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לא ננחל אתם מעבר לירדן והלאה כי באה נחלתנו אלינו מעבר לירדן מזרחה
verses.english: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.romanian: căci we va nu a moșteni cu them on yonder side Jordan, sau forward; pentru că nostru moștenire este fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר אליהם משה אם תעשון את הדבר הזה ואם תחלצו לפני יהוה למלחמה
verses.english: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui them, dacă voi va a face this thing, dacă voi va a merge armed înainte DOMNUL to război

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבר לכם כל חלוץ את הירדן לפני יהוה עד אורישו את איביו מפניו
verses.english: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him
verses.romanian: și va a merge toți al vostru armed peste Jordan înainte DOMNUL, until he sunt driven out lui dușmani din înainte him

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונכבשה הארץ לפני יהוה ואחר תשובון והייתם נקואים מיהוה ומישראל והיתה הארץ הזאת לכם לאחזה לפני יהוה
verses.english: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
verses.romanian: și the țară fi subdued înainte DOMNUL: atunci afterward voi va return, și fi guiltless înainte DOMNUL, și înainte Israel; și this țară va fi vostru moștenire înainte DOMNUL.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תעשון כן הנה חטאתם ליהוה ודעו חטאתיכם אשר תמצא אתכם
verses.english: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.romanian: dar dacă voi va nu a face astfel, iată, voi au sinned împotriva DOMNUL: și fi sure vostru păcat va find you out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: בנו לכם ערים לטפכם וגדרות לצאנכם והיוצא מפיכם תעשון
verses.english: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.romanian: Build you cetăți căci vostru little ones, și folds căci vostru oaie; și a face că care sunt proceeded out of vostru mouth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו בני ראובן ובני גד וחצי שבט המנשה אל משה לאמר עבדיך יעשו כאשר אדני מצוה
verses.english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and half of the tribe of Manaseh spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Gad și the copiii lui Reuben și half of the seminție of Manaseh a vorbit lui Moise, saying, tău slujitori va a face as meu lord commandeth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: טפנו ונשינו ומקנינו וכל בהמתנו יהיו שם בערי הגלעד
verses.english: Our little ones, and our wives, and our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.romanian: nostru little ones, și nostru wives, și nostru flocks, și toți nostru cattle, va fi acolo in the cetăți of Gilead:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ועבדיך יעברו כל חלוץ צבא לפני יהוה למלחמה כאשר אדני דבר
verses.english: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.romanian: dar tău slujitori va a trece peste, fiecare om armed căci război, înainte DOMNUL to battle, as meu lord spune.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו להם משה את אלעזר הכהן ואת יהושע בן נון ואת ראשי אבות המטות לבני ישראל
verses.english: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.romanian: astfel concerning them Moise commanded Elazar the preot, și Iosua the son of Nun, și the căpetenie părinți of the seminții of the copiii lui Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמר משה אליהם אם יעברו בני ראובן ובני גד וחצי שבט המנשה אתכם את הירדן כל חלוץ למלחמה לפני יהוה ונכבשה הארץ לפניכם ונתתם להם את ארץ הגלעד לאחזה
verses.english: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and half tribe of Manaseh will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.romanian: și Moise i-a spus lui them, dacă the copiii lui Gad și the copiii lui Reuben și half seminție of Manaseh va a trece cu you peste Jordan, fiecare om armed to battle, înainte DOMNUL, și the țară va fi subdued înainte you; atunci voi va a da them the țară of Gilead căci a moștenire:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא יעברו חלוצים אתכם ונאחזו בתוככם בארץ כנען
verses.english: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.romanian: dar dacă they va nu a trece peste cu you armed, they va au possessions între you in the țară of Canaan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויענו בני ראובן ובני גד וחצי שבט המנשה לאמר את אשר דבר יהוה אל עבדיך כן נעשה
verses.english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and half tribe of Manaseh answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Gad și the copiii lui Reuben și half seminție of Manaseh a răspuns, saying, As DOMNUL sunt a spus lui tău slujitori, astfel va we a face.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אנחנו נעבר חלוצים לפני יהוה ארץ כנען ואתנו אחזת נחלתנו מעבר לירדן
verses.english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan [may be] ours.
verses.romanian: We va a trece peste armed înainte DOMNUL into the țară of Canaan, că the moștenire of nostru moștenire on this side Jordan [poate fi] ale noastre.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן להם משה לבני ראובן ולבני גד ולחצי שבט המנשה בן יוסף את ממלכת סיחון מלך האמרי ואת ממלכת עוג מלך הבשן ארץ לעריה בגבולות ערי הארץ סביב
verses.english: And Moses gave unto them, [even] to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, [even] the cities of the country round about.
verses.romanian: și Moise a dat lui them, [even] to the copiii lui Gad, și to the copiii lui Reuben, și lui half the seminție of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon rege of the Amorites, și the kingdom of Og rege of Bashan, the țară, cu the cetăți al acestuia in the coasts, [even] the cetăți of the country de jur împrejur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויבנו בני גד את דיבון ואת עטרות ואת ערער
verses.english: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Gad built Dibon, și Ataroth, și Aroer

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת עטרות שפים ואת יעזיר ויגבהה
verses.english: And Atroth, Shopham, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah
verses.romanian: și Atroth, Shopham, și Jaazer, și Jogbehah

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת בית נמרה ואת בית הרן ערי מבצר וגדרות צאן
verses.english: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.romanian: și Beth-nimrah, și Beth-haran, fenced cetăți: și folds căci oaie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ובני ראובן בנו את חשבון ואת אלעלה ואת קריתים
verses.english: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Reuben built Heshbon, și Elealeh, și Kirjathaim

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת נבו ואת בעל מעון מוסבות שם ואת שבמה ויקראו בשמות את שמות הערים אשר בנו
verses.english: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.romanian: și Nebo, și Baal-meon, (lor names fiind changed,) și Shibmah: și a dat other names lui the cetăți care they builded.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וילכו בני מכיר בן מנשה גלעדה וילכדוה ויורישו את האמרי אשר בה
verses.english: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which [was] in it.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Machir the son of Manasseh a mers to Gilead, și a luat it, și dispossessed the Amorite care [era] in it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויתן משה את הגלעד למכיר בן מנשה וישב בה
verses.english: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.romanian: și Moise a dat Gilead lui Machir the son of Manasseh; și he dwelt în el.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאיר בן מנשה הלך וילכד את חותים ויקרא אתהן חות יאיר
verses.english: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.romanian: și Jair the son of Manasseh a mers și a luat the mic towns al acestuia, și a chemat them Havothjair.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונבח הלך וילכד את קנת ואת בנתיה ויקרא לה נבח בשמו
verses.english: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.romanian: și Nobah a mers și a luat Kenath, și the villages al acestuia, și a chemat it Nobah, după lui own name.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה מסעי בני ישראל אשר יצאו מארץ מצרים לצבאתם ביד משה ואהרן
verses.english: These [are] the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the călătorii of the copiii lui Israel, care a mers forth out of the țară of Egypt cu lor armies sub the mână of Moise și Aaron.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויכתב משה את מוצאיהם למסעיהם על פי יהוה ואלה מסעיהם למוצאיהם
verses.english: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these [are] their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.romanian: și Moise wrote lor goings out după lor călătorii by the poruncă of DOMNUL: și these [sunt] lor călătorii după lor goings out.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מרעמסס בחדש הראישון בחמשה עשר יום לחדש הראישון ממחרת הפסח יצאו בני ישראל ביד רמה לעיני כל מצרים
verses.english: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Rameses in the întâi lună, on the fifteenth zi of the întâi lună; on the morrow după the passover the copiii lui Israel a mers out cu an high mână in the sight of toți the Egyptians.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומצרים מקברים את אשר הכה יהוה בהם כל בכור ובאלהיהם עשה יהוה שפטים
verses.english: For the Egyptians buried all [their] firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
verses.romanian: căci the Egyptians buried toți [lor] întâi-născut, care DOMNUL had smitten între them: upon lor gods de asemenea DOMNUL executed judecăți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו בני ישראל מרעמסס ויחנו בסכות
verses.english: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.romanian: și the copiii lui Israel removed din Rameses, și pitched in Succoth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מסכות ויחנו באתם אשר בקצה המדבר
verses.english: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which [is] in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Succoth, și pitched in Etham, care [este] in the edge of the pustie.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מאתם וישבו על פי החירת אשר לפני בעל צפון ויחנו לפני מגדול
verses.english: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which [is] before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Etham, și s-a întors again lui Pi-hahiroth, care [este] înainte Baal-zephon: și they pitched înainte Migdol.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מפי החירת ויעברו בתוך הים המדברה וילכו דרך שלשת ימים במדבר אתם ויחנו במרה
verses.english: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din înainte Pi-hahiroth, și a trecut prin the mijloc of the mare into the pustie, și a mers trei zile' călătorie in the pustie of Etham, și pitched in Marah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממרה ויבאו אילים ובאילים שתים עשרה עינות מים ושבעים תמרים ויחנו שם
verses.english: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim [were] twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Marah, și a venit lui Elim: și in Elim [erau] doisprezece fountains of apă, și threescore și zece palm trees; și they pitched acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מאילים ויחנו על ים סוף
verses.english: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Elim, și a tăbărât by the Red mare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מים סוף ויחנו במדבר סין
verses.english: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.romanian: și they removed din the Red mare, și a tăbărât in the pustie of păcat.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממדבר סין ויחנו בדפקה
verses.english: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.romanian: și they a luat lor călătorie out of the pustie of păcat, și a tăbărât in Dophkah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מדפקה ויחנו באליש
verses.english: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Dophkah, și a tăbărât in Alush.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מאליש ויחנו ברפידים ולא היה שם מים לעם לשתות
verses.english: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Alush, și a tăbărât at Rephidim, where era no apă căci the popor to drink.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מרפידים ויחנו במדבר סיני
verses.english: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Rephidim, și pitched in the pustie of Sinai.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממדבר סיני ויחנו בקברות התאוה
verses.english: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.romanian: și they removed din the pustie of Sinai, și pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מקברות התאוה ויחנו בחצרות
verses.english: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Kibroth-hattaavah, și a tăbărât at Hazeroth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מחצרות ויחנו ברתמה
verses.english: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Hazeroth, și pitched in Rithmah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מרתמה ויחנו ברמונ פרץ
verses.english: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Rithmah, și pitched at Rimmon-parez.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מרמונ פרץ ויחנו בלבונה
verses.english: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Rimmon-parez, și pitched in Libnah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מלבונה ויחנו ברסה
verses.english: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Libnah, și pitched at Rissah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מרסה ויחנו בקהלתה
verses.english: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.romanian: și they au călătorit din Rissah, și pitched in Kehelathah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מקהלתה ויחנו בהר שפר
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהר שפר ויחנו בחרדה
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מחרדה ויחנו במקהלת
verses.english: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Haradah, și pitched in Makheloth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממקהלת ויחנו בתחת
verses.english: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Makheloth, și a tăbărât at Tahath.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מתחת ויחנו בתרח
verses.english: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Tahath, și pitched at Tarah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מתרח ויחנו במתקה
verses.english: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Tarah, și pitched in Mithcah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממתקה ויחנו בחשמונה
verses.english: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.romanian: și they a mers din Mithcah, și pitched in Hashmonah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מחשמונה ויחנו במסרות
verses.english: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Hashmonah, și a tăbărât at Moseroth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו ממסרות ויחנו בבני יעקן
verses.english: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Moseroth, și pitched in Bene-jaakan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מבני יעקן ויחנו בהר הגדגדה
verses.english: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Bene-jaakan, și a tăbărât at Hor-hagidgad.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהר הגדגדה ויחנו ביטבתה
verses.english: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.romanian: și they a mers din Hor-hagidgad, și pitched in Jotbathah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מיטבתה ויחנו בעברנה
verses.english: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Jotbathah, și a tăbărât at Ebronah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מעברנה ויחנו בעציונ גבר
verses.english: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Ebronah, și a tăbărât at Ezion-gaber.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מעציונ גבר ויחנו במדבר צן היא קדש
verses.english: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which [is] Kadesh.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Ezion-gaber, și pitched in the pustie of Zin, care [este] Kadesh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מקדש ויחנו בהר ההר בקצה ארץ אדום
verses.english: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Kadesh, și pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the țară of Edom.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויעל אהרן הכהן אל הר ההר על פי יהוה וימת שם בשנת הארבעים לצאת בני ישראל מארץ מצרים בחדש החמישי באחד לחדש
verses.english: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first [day] of the fifth month.
verses.romanian: și Aaron the preot a mers up into mount Hor at the poruncă of DOMNUL, și a murit acolo, in the fortieth an după the copiii lui Israel erau a veni out of the țară of Egypt, in the întâi [zi] of the al cincilea lună.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואהרן בן שלש ועשרים ומאת שנה במותו בהר ההר
verses.english: And Aaron [was] an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.romanian: și Aaron [era] an sută și douăzeci și trei ani old când he a murit in mount Hor.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וישמע הכנעני מלך ערד והוא ישב בנגב בארץ כנען בבוא בני ישראל
verses.english: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: și rege Arad the Canaanite, care dwelt in the south in the țară of Canaan, a auzit of the coming of the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהר ההר ויחנו בצלמונה
verses.english: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din mount Hor, și pitched in Zalmonah.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מצלמונה ויחנו בפינן
verses.english: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Zalmonah, și pitched in Punon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מפינן ויחנו באבות
verses.english: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Punon, și pitched in Oboth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מאבות ויחנו בעיי העברים בגבול מואב
verses.english: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Oboth, și pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מעיים ויחנו בדיבון גד
verses.english: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din Iim, și pitched in Dibon-gad.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מדיבון גד ויחנו בעלמונ דבלתימה
verses.english: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Dibon-gad, și a tăbărât in Almon-diblathaim.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מעלמונ דבלתימה ויחנו בהרי העברים לפני נבו
verses.english: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.romanian: și they removed din Almon-diblathaim, și pitched in the munți of Abarim, înainte Nebo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויסעו מהרי העברים ויחנו בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו
verses.english: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.
verses.romanian: și they a plecat din the munți of Abarim, și pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויחנו על הירדן מבית הישמות עד אבל שטים בערבת מואב
verses.english: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth [even] unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.romanian: și they pitched by Jordan, din Beth-jesimoth [even] lui Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי אתם עברים את הירדן אל ארץ כנען
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când voi sunt a trecut peste Jordan into the țară of Canaan;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והורשתם את כל ישבי הארץ מפניכם ואבדתם את כל משכיותם ואת כל צלמי מסכותם תאבידו ואת כל במתם תשמידו
verses.english: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.romanian: atunci voi va drive out toți the inhabitants of the țară din înainte you, și destroy toți lor pictures, și destroy toți lor molten images, și quite pluck down toți lor high places:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והורשתם את הארץ וישבתם בה כי לכם נתתי את הארץ לרשת אתה
verses.english: And ye shall dispossess [the inhabitants of] the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.romanian: și voi va dispossess [the inhabitants of] the țară, și dwell în el: căci I au given you the țară to a stăpâni it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתנחלתם את הארץ בגורל למשפחותיכם לרב תרבה את נחלתו ולמעט תמעיט את נחלתו על אשר יצא לו שם הגורל לו יהיה למטות אבתיכם תתנחלו
verses.english: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: [and] to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's [inheritance] shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.romanian: și voi va divide the țară prin tragere la sorți căci an moștenire între vostru families: [și] to the mai mult voi va a da the mai mult moștenire, și to the fewer voi va a da the less moștenire: fiecare om's [moștenire] va fi in the place where lui lot falleth; după the seminții of vostru părinți voi va a moșteni.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם לא תורישו את ישבי הארץ מפניכם והיה אשר תותירו מהם לשכים בעיניכם ולצנים בצדיכם וצררו אתכם על הארץ אשר אתם ישבים בה
verses.english: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them [shall be] pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.romanian: dar dacă voi va nu drive out the inhabitants of the țară din înainte you; atunci it va a veni to a trece, că those care voi let remain al lor [va fi] pricks in vostru eyes, și thorns in vostru sides, și va vex you in the țară wherein voi dwell.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה כאשר דמיתי לעשות להם כן אעשה לכם
verses.english: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.romanian: mai mult it va a veni to a trece, că I va a face lui you, as I thought to a face lui them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי אתם באים אל ארץ כנען זאת הארץ אשר תפל לכם בנחלה ארץ כנען לגבולתיה
verses.english: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this [is] the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, [even] the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.romanian: Command the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când voi a veni into the țară of Canaan; (this [este] the țară că va a cădea lui you căci an moștenire, [even] the țară of Canaan cu the coasts al acestuia:)

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיה לכם פאת נגבה ממדבר צן על ידי אדום והיה לכם גבול נגבה מקצה ים המלח קדמה
verses.english: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.romanian: atunci vostru south quarter va fi din the pustie of Zin along by the coast of Edom, și vostru south border va fi the outmost coast of the salt mare eastward:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסב לכם הגבול מנגב למעלה עקרבים ועבר צנה והיה תוצאיתו מנגב לקדש ברנע ויצא חצר אדר ועבר עצמונה
verses.english: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.romanian: și vostru border va a se întoarce din the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, și a trece on to Zin: și the going forth al acestuia va fi din the south to Kadesh-barnea, și va a merge on to Hazar-addar, și a trece on to Azmon:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונסב הגבול מעצמונה נחל מצרים והיה תוצאיתו הים
verses.english: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.romanian: și the border va fetch a compass din Azmon lui the râu of Egypt, și the goings out of it va fi at the mare.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וגבול ימה יהיה לכם הים הגדול יגבל זה יהיה לכם גבול ימה
verses.english: And [as for] the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.romanian: și [as căci] the western border, voi va even au the mare mare căci a border: this va fi vostru west border.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וזה יהיה לכם גבול צפונה מן הים הגדול תתאו לכם הר ההר
verses.english: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.romanian: și this va fi vostru north border: din the mare mare voi va point out căci you mount Hor:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומהר ההר תתאו לבוא חמתה והיה תוצאיתו הגבול צרדה
verses.english: From mount Hor ye shall point out [your border] unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.romanian: din mount Hor voi va point out [vostru border] lui the entrance of Hamath; și the goings forth of the border va fi to Zedad:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצא הגבול זפרנה והיה תוצאיתו חצר עינן זה יהיה לכם גבול צפונה
verses.english: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
verses.romanian: și the border va a merge on to Ziphron, și the goings out of it va fi at Hazar-enan: this va fi vostru north border.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והתאויתם לכם לגבול קדמה מחצר עינן שפמה
verses.english: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
verses.romanian: și voi va point out vostru east border din Hazar-enan to Shepham:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד הגבול משפמה הארבלה מקדם לעין וירד הגבול ומחה אל כתף ים כנרת קדמה
verses.english: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.romanian: și the coast va a merge down din Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; și the border va descend, și va reach lui the side of the mare of Chinnereth eastward:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וירד הגבול הירדנה והיה תוצאיתו ים המלח זאת תהיה לכם הארץ לגבולתיה סביב
verses.english: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.romanian: și the border va a merge down to Jordan, și the goings out of it va fi at the salt mare: this va fi vostru țară cu the coasts al acestuia de jur împrejur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו משה את בני ישראל לאמר זאת הארץ אשר תתנחלו אתה בגורל אשר צוה יהוה לתת לתשעת המטות וחצי המטה
verses.english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This [is] the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.romanian: și Moise commanded the copiii lui Israel, saying, This [este] the țară care voi va a moșteni prin tragere la sorți, care DOMNUL commanded to a da lui the nouă seminții, și to the half seminție:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי לקחו מטה בני הראובני לבית אבותם ומטה בני הגדי לבית אבותם וחצי מטה מנשה לקחו נחלתם
verses.english: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received [their inheritance]; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.romanian: căci the seminție of the copiii lui Reuben după the house of lor părinți, și the seminție of the copiii lui Gad după the house of lor părinți, au received [lor moștenire]; și half the seminție of Manasseh au received lor moștenire:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: שני המטות וחצי המטה לקחו נחלתם מעבר לירדן יריחו קדמה מזרחה
verses.english: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan [near] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.romanian: The doi seminții și the half seminție au received lor moștenire on this side Jordan [lângă] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה שמות האנשים אשר ינחלו לכם את הארץ אלעזר הכהן ויהושע בן נון
verses.english: These [are] the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the names of the oameni care va divide the țară lui you: Elazar the preot, și Iosua the son of Nun.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ונשיא אחד נשיא אחד ממטה תקחו לנחל את הארץ
verses.english: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.romanian: și voi va a lua unu căpetenie of fiecare seminție, to divide the țară by moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואלה שמות האנשים למטה יהודה כלב בן יפנה
verses.english: And the names of the men [are] these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.romanian: și the names of the oameni [sunt] these: Of the seminție of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה בני שמעון שמואל בן עמיהוד
verses.english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of the copiii lui Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה בנימים אלדד בן כסלן
verses.english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.romanian: Of the seminție of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: למטה בני דן נשיא בקי בן יגלי
verses.english: The prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.romanian: The căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: לבני יוסף למטה בני מנשה נשיא חנאל בן אפוד
verses.english: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.romanian: The căpetenie of the copiii lui Joseph, căci the seminție of the copiii lui Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמטה בני אפרים נשיא קמואל בן שפטן
verses.english: The prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.romanian: The căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמטה בני זבולן נשיא אליצפן בן פרנך
verses.english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמטה בני יששכר נשיא פלטאל בן עזן
verses.english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמטה בני אשר נשיא אחיוד בן שלמי
verses.english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולמטה בני נפתלי נשיא פדהאל בן עמיהוד
verses.english: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie of the seminție of the copiii lui Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה אשר צוה יהוה לנחל את בני ישראל בארץ כנען
verses.english: These [are they] whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.romanian: These [sunt they] pe care DOMNUL commanded to divide the moștenire lui the copiii lui Israel in the țară of Canaan.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: צוי את בני ישראל ונתנו ללוים מנחלת אחזתם ערים לשבת ומגרש לערים סביבתיהם תתנו ללוים
verses.english: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give [also] unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.romanian: Command the copiii lui Israel, că they a da lui the leviți of the moștenire of lor moștenire cetăți to dwell in; și voi va a da [de asemenea] lui the leviți suburbs căci the cetăți de jur împrejur them.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו הערים להם לשבת ומגרשיהן יהיו לבהמתם ולרכושם ולכל חיתם
verses.english: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.romanian: și the cetăți va they au to dwell in; și the suburbs al lor va fi căci lor cattle, și căci lor goods, și căci toți lor beasts.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומגרשי הערים אשר תתנו ללוים מקיר העיר החוצה אלף אמה סביב
verses.english: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, [shall reach] from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.romanian: și the suburbs of the cetăți, care voi va a da lui the leviți, [va reach] din the wall of the cetate și outward a mie cubits de jur împrejur.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומדתם מחוץ לעיר את פאת קדמה אלפים באמה ואת פאת נגבה אלפים באמה ואת פאת ימה אלפים באמה ואת פאת צפונה אלפים באמה והעיר בתוך זה יהיה לכם מגרשי הערים
verses.english: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city [shall be] in the midst: this shall be to you the suburbs of the cities.
verses.romanian: și voi va measure din fără the cetate on the east side doi mie cubits, și on the south side doi mie cubits, și on the west side doi mie cubits, și on the north side doi mie cubits; și the cetate [va fi] in the mijloc: this va fi to you the suburbs of the cetăți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואת הערים אשר תתנו ללוים את שש ערי המקלט אשר תתנו לנוס שם הרצח ועליהן תתנו ארבעים ושתים עיר
verses.english: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites [there shall be] six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.romanian: și între the cetăți care voi va a da lui the leviți [acolo va fi] șase cetăți căci refuge, care voi va appoint căci the manslayer, că he poate flee acolo: și to them voi va add patruzeci și doi cetăți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל הערים אשר תתנו ללוים ארבעים ושמנה עיר אתהן ואת מגרשיהן
verses.english: [So] all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites [shall be] forty and eight cities: them [shall ye give] with their suburbs.
verses.romanian: [astfel] toți the cetăți care voi va a da to the leviți [va fi] patruzeci și opt cetăți: them [va voi a da] cu lor suburbs.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והערים אשר תתנו מאחזת בני ישראל מאת הרב תרבו ומאת המעט תמעיטו איש כפי נחלתו אשר ינחל יתן מעריו ללוים
verses.english: And the cities which ye shall give [shall be] of the possession of the children of Israel: from [them that have] many ye shall give many; but from [them that have] few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.romanian: și the cetăți care voi va a da [va fi] of the moștenire of the copiii lui Israel: din [them că au] many voi va a da many; dar din [them că au] few voi va a da few: fiecare unu va a da of lui cetăți lui the leviți după lui moștenire care he inheriteth.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וידבר יהוה אל משה לאמר
verses.english: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
verses.romanian: și DOMNUL i-a vorbit lui Moise, saying

verses.samaritan_hebrew: דבר אל בני ישראל ואמרת אליהם כי אתם עברים את הירדן אל ארץ כנען
verses.english: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.romanian: a vorbi lui the copiii lui Israel, și a spune lui them, când voi fi a veni peste Jordan into the țară of Canaan;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והקריתם לכם ערים ערי מקלט תהיינה לכם ונס שמה הרצח מכה נפש בשגגה
verses.english: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.romanian: atunci voi va appoint you cetăți to fi cetăți of refuge căci you; că the slayer poate flee acolo, care killeth vreun person at unawares.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו לכם הערים למקלט מגאל ולא יומת הרצח עד עמדו לפני העדה למשפט
verses.english: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.romanian: și they va fi lui you cetăți căci refuge din the avenger; că the manslayer a muri nu, until he a sta înainte the obște in judecată.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והערים אשר תתנו שש ערי מקלט תהינה לכם
verses.english: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.romanian: și of these cetăți care voi va a da șase cetăți va voi au căci refuge.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: את שלש הערים תתנו מעבר לירדן ואת שלש הערים תתנו בארץ כנען ערי מקלט תהינה לבני ישראל
verses.english: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, [which] shall be cities of refuge.
verses.romanian: voi va a da trei cetăți on this side Jordan, și trei cetăți va voi a da in the țară of Canaan, [care] va fi cetăți of refuge.
