verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולגר ולתושב בתוכם תהיינה שש הערים האלה למקלט לנוס שמה כל מכה נפש בשגגה
verses.english: These six cities shall be a refuge, [both] for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.romanian: These șase cetăți va fi a refuge, [both] căci the copiii lui Israel, și căci the străin, și căci the străin care locuiește între them: că fiecare unu că killeth vreun person unawares poate flee acolo.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בכלי ברזל הכהו וימת רצח הוא מות יומת הרצח
verses.english: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: și dacă he a lovi him cu an instrument of fier, astfel că he a muri, he [este] a murderer: the murderer va negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם באבן יד אשר ימות בה הכהו וימת רצח הוא מות יומת הרצח
verses.english: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: și dacă he a lovi him cu throwing a piatră, wherewith he poate a muri, și he a muri, he [este] a murderer: the murderer va negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בכלי עץ יד אשר ימות בו הכהו וימת רצח הוא מות יומת הרצח
verses.english: And if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.romanian: și dacă he a lovi him cu an mână weapon of lemn, wherewith he poate a muri, și he a muri, he [este] a murderer: the murderer va negresit fi a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: גאל הדם הוא ימית את הרצח בפגעו בו הוא ימיתנו
verses.english: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.romanian: The revenger of blood însuși va a înjunghia the murderer: când he meeteth him, he va a înjunghia him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בשנאה יחדיפנו או השליך עליו בצדיה וימת
verses.english: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.romanian: dar dacă he thrust him of hatred, sau hurl at him by laying of wait, că he a muri;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או באיבה הכהו בידו וימת מות יומת המכה רצח הוא גאל הדם ימית את הרצח בפגעו בו
verses.english: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote [him] shall surely be put to death; [for] he [is] a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.romanian: sau in enmity a lovi him cu lui mână, că he a muri: he că a lovit [him] va negresit fi a pune to death; [căci] he [este] a murderer: the revenger of blood va a înjunghia the murderer, când he meeteth him.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם בפתע בלא איבה הדיפו או השליך עליו כל כלי בלא צדיה
verses.english: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait
verses.romanian: dar dacă he thrust him suddenly fără enmity, sau au cast upon him vreun thing fără laying of wait

verses.samaritan_hebrew: או בכל אבן אשר ימות בה בלא ראות ויפל עליו וימת והוא לא אויב לו ולא מבקש רעתו
verses.english: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing [him] not, and cast [it] upon him, that he die, and [was] not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.romanian: sau cu vreun piatră, wherewith a om poate a muri, seeing [him] nu, și cast [it] upon him, că he a muri, și [era] nu lui dușman, neither a căutat lui harm:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ושפטו העדה בין המכה ובין גאל הדם על המשפטים האלה
verses.english: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.romanian: atunci the obște va a judeca between the slayer și the revenger of blood după these judecăți:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והצילו העדה את המכה מיד גאל הדם והשיבו אתו העדה אל עיר מקלטו אשר נס שמה וישב בה עד מות הכהן הגדול אשר משח אתו בשמן הקדש
verses.english: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.romanian: și the obște va deliver the slayer out of the mână of the revenger of blood, și the obște va restore him to the cetate of lui refuge, whither he era fled: și he va abide in it lui the death of the high preot, care era anointed cu the sfânt a fierbe.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יצא יצא הרצח את גבול עיר מקלטו אשר ינוס שמה
verses.english: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.romanian: dar dacă the slayer va at vreun time a veni fără the border of the cetate of lui refuge, whither he era fled;

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ומצא אתו גאל הדם מחוץ לגבול עיר מקלטו ורצח גאל הדם את הרצח אין לו דם
verses.english: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.romanian: și the revenger of blood find him fără the borders of the cetate of lui refuge, și the revenger of blood a ucide the slayer; he va nu fi guilty of blood:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כי בעיר מקלטו ישב עד מות הכהן הגדול ואחרי מות הכהן הגדול ישוב הרצח אל ארץ אחזתו
verses.english: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.romanian: pentru că he trebuie să au remained in the cetate of lui refuge until the death of the high preot: dar după the death of the high preot the slayer va return into the țară of lui moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו אלה לכם לחקת משפט לדרתיכם בכל מושבתיכם
verses.english: So these [things] shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.romanian: astfel these [things] va fi căci a poruncă of judecată lui you throughout vostru generations in toți vostru dwellings.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כל מכה נפש לפי עדים ירצח את הרצח ועד אחד לא יענה בנפש למות
verses.english: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person [to cause him] to die.
verses.romanian: Whoso killeth vreun person, the murderer va fi a pune to death by the mouth of witnesses: dar unu witness va nu testify împotriva vreun person [to cause him] to a muri.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תקחו כפר לנפש רצח אשר הוא רשע למות כי מות יומת
verses.english: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which [is] guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.romanian: mai mult voi va a lua no satisfaction căci the life of a murderer, care [este] guilty of death: dar he va fi negresit a pune to death.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תקחו כפר לנוס אל עיר מקלטו לשוב לשבת בארץ עד מות הכהן הגדול
verses.english: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the great priest.
verses.romanian: și voi va a lua no satisfaction căci him că este fled to the cetate of lui refuge, că he trebuie să a veni again to dwell in the țară, until the death of the mare preot.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תחניפו את הארץ אשר אתם ישבים בה כי הדם הוא יחניף את הארץ ולארץ לא יכפר לדם אשר שפך בה כי אם בדם שפכו
verses.english: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye will dwell: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.romanian: astfel voi va nu pollute the țară wherein voi va dwell: căci blood it defileth the țară: și the țară nu poate fi a curățit of the blood că este shed în el, dar by the blood al lui că shed it.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תטמאו את הארץ אשר אתם ישבים בה אשר אני שכן בתוכה כי אני יהוה שכן בתוך בני ישראל
verses.english: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.romanian: a pângări nu de aceea the țară care voi va inhabit, wherein I dwell: căci I DOMNUL dwell între the copiii lui Israel.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויקרבו ראשי האבות למשפחות בני גלעד בן מכיר בן מנשה ממשפחות בני יוסף וידברו לפני משה ולפני הנשיאים ראשי האבות לבני ישראל
verses.english: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.romanian: și the căpetenie părinți of the families of the copiii lui Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the fiii lui Joseph, a venit lângă, și a vorbit înainte Moise, și înainte the căpetenii, the căpetenie părinți of the copiii lui Israel:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויאמרו את אדני צוה יהוה לתת את הארץ בנחלה בגורל לבני ישראל ואדני צוה ביהוה לתת את נחלת צלפחד אחינו לבנתיו
verses.english: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.romanian: și they a spus, DOMNUL commanded meu lord to a da the țară căci an moștenire prin tragere la sorți to the copiii lui Israel: și meu lord era commanded by DOMNUL to a da the moștenire of Zelophehad nostru frate lui lui daughters.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: והיו לאחד מבני שבטי בני ישראל לנשים ונגרעה נחלתן מנחלת אבתינו ונוספה על נחלת המטה אשר תהיינה להם ומגורל נחלתנו יגרע
verses.english: And if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.romanian: și dacă they fi married to vreun of the fiii lui the [other] seminții of the copiii lui Israel, atunci va lor moștenire fi taken din the moștenire of nostru părinți, și va fi a pune to the moștenire of the seminție whereunto they sunt received: astfel va it fi taken din the lot of nostru moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ואם יהיה היובל לבני ישראל ונוספה נחלתן על נחלת המטה אשר תהיינה להם ומנחלת מטה אבתינו יגרע נחלתן
verses.note: Samaritan verse division differs from the English translation source at this reference; the Alamo Polyglot's English column is not reliably aligned here, so no English is provided.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ויצו משה את בני ישראל על פי יהוה לאמר כן מטה בני יוסף דברים
verses.english: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.romanian: și Moise commanded the copiii lui Israel după the cuvânt of DOMNUL, saying, The seminție of the fiii lui Joseph sunt a spus well.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: זה הדבר אשר צוה יהוה לבנות צלפחד לאמר לטוב בעיניהם תהינה לנשים אך למשפחת מטה אביהן תהינה לנשים
verses.english: This [is] the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.romanian: This [este] the thing care DOMNUL doth command concerning the fiicele lui Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to pe care they think best; numai to the family of the seminție of lor tată va they marry.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תסוב נחלה לבני ישראל ממטה אל מטה כי איש בנחלת מטה אבתיו ידבקו בני ישראל
verses.english: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.romanian: astfel va nu the moștenire of the copiii lui Israel remove din seminție to seminție: căci fiecare unu of the copiii lui Israel va a păzi însuși to the moștenire of the seminție of lui părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: וכל בת ירשת נחלה ממטות בני ישראל לאחד ממשפחת מטה אביה תהיה לאשה למען יירשו בני ישראל איש את נחלת אבתיו
verses.english: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.romanian: și fiecare daughter, că possesseth an moștenire in vreun seminție of the copiii lui Israel, va fi wife lui unu of the family of the seminție al ei tată, că the copiii lui Israel poate enjoy fiecare om the moștenire of lui părinți.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ולא תסב נחלה ממטה אל מטה אחר כי איש בנחלתו ידבקו מטות בני ישראל
verses.english: Neither shall the inheritance remove from [one] tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.romanian: Neither va the moștenire remove din [unu] seminție to another seminție; dar fiecare unu of the seminții of the copiii lui Israel va a păzi însuși to lui own moștenire.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: כאשר צוה יהוה את משה כן עשו בנות צלפחד
verses.english: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.romanian: Even as DOMNUL commanded Moise, astfel a făcut the fiicele lui Zelophehad:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ותהיינה מחלה ונעה חגלה מלכה ותרצה בנות צלפחד לבני דדיהן לנשים
verses.english: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
verses.romanian: căci Mahlah, Tirzah, și Hoglah, și Milcah, și Noah, the fiicele lui Zelophehad, erau married lui lor tată's frați' sons:

verses.samaritan_hebrew: ממשפחות בני מנשה בן יוסף היו לנשים ותהי נחלתן על מטה משפחת אביהן
verses.english: [And] they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.romanian: [și] they erau married into the families of the fiii lui Manasseh the son of Joseph, și lor moștenire remained in the seminție of the family of lor tată.

verses.samaritan_hebrew: אלה המצות והמשפטים אשר צוה יהוה ביד משה אל בני ישראל בערבת מואב על ירדן יריחו
verses.english: These [are] the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.
verses.romanian: These [sunt] the porunci și the judecăți, care DOMNUL commanded by the mână of Moise lui the copiii lui Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan [lângă] Jericho.
